title: Cute, easy to walk in outside. Top ankle area is tight and rigid
text: I just bought a pair of the Sketchers knit shoes to wear around the house and I like them so much that I tried these for outdoor use. The shoe itself is not bad looking and has a reasonable amount of arch support built in. My issue is with the top, around the top of the foot and ankle. It's just tight and inflexible. After a week of wearing these, that top is still very tight - it hasn't really broken in or loosened up. I like that these are slip on, but there still should be some give in the tongue area.

title: Five Stars

[I do now.]) They also seem a tad tight in the heel when the foot goes down, but once in place, SHEER COMFORT!

title: Love the shoe, but beware long time Skechers wearer, it does run small
text: I have been wearing Skechers shoes since they were introduced to me back in 2001 by a family member working at a local shoe store at the mall. I love this premium slip on version as compared to the boxy looking laced up version, and the memory foam version of Skechers stuff that doesn't last. These are the old style slip ons, they are fantastic and will last much longer than their memory foam version. Can't find these at my local stores for years now, so I was thrilled to find them on Amazon. Got a black pair for the yard work and playing with my dogs, and a white pair for everyday wear. I live in these things all day long working from home for years now. Mistake I made ordering this one was that I forgot they really run small compared to the lace up ones, and I needed to order either the comfy wide version, or a 1/2 size larger than I usually wear. I'm keeping them and they are slowly getting more comfy, but at first putting them on they felt really super narrow near the toes and exceptionally tight. Advice, order a little larger than you usually wear. They are great and they are the solid version of the shoe, without the crappy memory foam that wears out super fast. I went thru a

title: I like the elastic slip-on convenience
text: This is my fourth or fifth pair of shoes of this model. I like the elastic slip-on convenience, but, although I knew the pair they were replacing had gotten pretty sloppy, I hadn't realized how sloppy till I tried to shoehorn my foot into the new pair. They are quite snug when new--roomy toe box, but plenty of arch and heel support. I have a high instep, making some shoes too tight around the middle of the foot, but these are quite comfortable--actually more so than a lace-up shoe. Update December 2020: I've just bought two more pairs of these shoes, having totally worn out the past two pairs. I had been using one for street walking and one for the gym, but when COVID closed gyms, the latter pair also hit the street, and both were falling apart. For some time I was unable to find this style in my size and feared I'd have to choose a different model, but luckily I finally found what I needed. I hope Skechers never discontinues this style!

title: Absolutely worth the money for a "no pain all day" shoe!
text: Absolutely beautiful, well constructed, stylish support! I fell in love with Skechers a few years back when I managed to snag a pair on clearance. Previously, I was hesitant to spend this much money on a shoe. I have a really bad back, 8 herniated discs and stenosis, and patellofemoral pain (runner's knee) so comfort is important, but SUPPORT is even more important. Without proper support, I can only last a few hours, and then I can't walk or stand up straight. These shoes are comfortable ALL day. They provide great support so I don't hurt at all, not my back, not my knees, I can stand up straight and walk and keep going! I also wear them while working out. My last pair lasted me 4 years. I rotate which shoes I am wearing which helps their longevity, but even still, FOUR YEARS! And I still wear those for yard work, they just popped a seam so they look a little disheveled, but the support is still good. I'm expecting the same from this new pair. I love them!

title: Toasty warm sheepskin slippers with durable sole
text: I'm married to a man with ice cube feet in the winter. He's usually in a pair of ultra-thick heavy wool socks once colder weather comes. No need for the wooly Sasquatch socks anymore, though. These sheepskin slippers are just the ticket for icy feet. The slip-on style is easy to slide feet into and the soft shearling fleece interior offers incredible warmth. The outer surface of the slippers is a thick suede which is so far very durable against scuffs. The cushioned memory foam insole is an added bonus for my husband. A daily long distance runner, he often suffers from tired and sore feet...so the cushioning offers some extra pampering. There's much to like about these slippers. But the best thing about them is how comfortable they are. The soles of the slippers offer traction against slipping and are durable and sturdy enough for the occasional traipse outside with our dogs. As other reviewers suggested, I ordered them a half size larger...and they fit perfectly. I do have one small gripe about the pair I received. text: Good shoe. Getting used to them, as I have been wearing New Balance. Wanted to try Propet for a. Change.

title: XXXX Wide Shoe
text: I have an in-shoe orthotic that goes from mid-calf to mid-foot for my left foot, so that any shoe that I wear when I am wearing the orthotic shoe has to be wide enough as well as long enough to accommodate the orthotic. I bought these shoes to wear over the orthotic, but only bought 1/2 half size larger in length than what I usually wear, but I should have bought it one whole size longer, although the width is good. Because the shoe is so much larger than my usual size, my right foot swam in it, so I am wearing my regular size shoe on my right. I have found that if I don't wear the orthotic I can wear my regular sized shoe on both feet, although that defeats the purpose of the orthotic. I am going to order a whole size larger that my usual size. I recommend this shoe for anyone who has problems with their feet.

title: Love this shoe
text: I have been purchasing and wearing this shoe for well over six years. I have fallen arches and this product has amazing arch support that completely elevates my foot pain.

title: Great Arch Support With All Day Comfort
text: These shoes have great arch support. I've worn them all day long without a problem. No breaking in time either. They are a little sloppy on the width, but I don't wear socks or peds. That might help them be snugger. I wear compression hose only. I need the width for the toe box though so it wouldn't work to get a narrower width.

title: Very comfortable
text: I chose half size shorter. I wear orthodics so it took 71/2, 4 E. I chose black for winter and white for summer.

title: Fast Delivery!
text: Super Fast Delivery.. However, had to return due to fit runs 1/2 size small in length

title: Good quality
text: Good sneaker for people who are on their feet for long periods of time. Comfortable Supportive

title: Propet Stability Walkers in Wide are WONDERFUL
text: I love the width. As a ex ballet dancer, the bones have a bit of an overgrowth on outside of little toes. That bunion type growth on outside of foot makes most walkers uncomfortable. Adding the width and a little more room on top of foot, adds to these stability walker. I wish it had more arch support but I can remedy this with a store bought insert. I love these shoes. Very happy

title: Excellent product
text: My husband has a very wide foot and Propet is the only brand of sneaker he finds comfortable. Due to some health issues, the Velcro strap is easier for him to use. I have ordered a second pair so he can change off and not wear the same pair till worn out! Excellent product and reasonable price.

title: Not as well made as my old New Balance.
text: The material is much thinner than both my pair of New Balance shoes. There isn't much arch support. I don't think I'd purchase these again.

title: Second pair for my husband!
text: My husband is a diabetic and foot care for diabetics is of utmost importance, this will be the second pair in as many years. I get him 1/2 size up in a wide width to make sure of enough room in the toe box. Also this way he can wear extra cushy sox! He really likes his Propets, especially now with the strap. Has worn them every day, feels they are very comfortable. Just hope Propet does not change these! Sometimes one finds a great shoe and just when you get to like them somebody goes and changes them! Please: If it works, don’t fix it!!

title: Well Done, Propet.
text: I use them for house-shoes. They have a Velcro latch, so they are quick to put on. And they are quite comfortable. There is nobody left that sells shoes in a 5e, except Propet. And, in short, I think Propet is the New 'new balance'. Their shoes are well constructed, and they sell my size. That description used to be for 'New Balance', but not anymore. That is my description for Propet. Well Done, Propet.

title: Great shoes
text: I'd never heard of this brand of shoe but after reading reviews, I thought I'd try a pair to see how they helped my foot problem. So far, I'm very pleased. They are comfortable and seem well made. I'll look for more deals with this brand of shoe.

title: Another great shoe from Propet!
text: My Husband was looking for a pair of shoes that didn't have laces. I suggested these shoes, as I have been buying this brand for about ten years and have always been satisfied. He keeps saying how much he likes these shoes. They are very comfortable and look good too. I highly recommend this product.

title: GREAT SHOE FOR WALKING AND COMFORT - THIRD PAIR in 7 years
text: This is the THIRD pair of these bought for hubby. He is 87 now and still walks MILES daily and loves these shoes. He has a hand problem, so the velcro straps are absolutely the perfect thing for him. These are very smart looking as well as comfortable and functional. Highly recommended by us.

title: Comfortable
text: These shoes are as advertized. They are both comfortable to wear and look excellent. I would recommend them to anyone looking for a medium priced everyday shoe.

title: Thankfully I Found These
text: I now have 4 pairs, fit comfort and wear are perfect. The price is more then worth it. Finally a shoe wide enough and adjusts to high archs on my large foot. Blends with sport to dress casual.

title: Good comfortable shoe but order one size larger
text: I ordered this for my father-in-law who is in assisted living. He needs a comfortable shoe that is easy to take on and off. The first pair I ordered was too short and too tight. I reordered a wider shoe one size larger and it fits well and is very comfortable.

title: Get bigger size
text: Had to return these. Thought I was surprising my husband with new shoes for his birthday. Nope. If I were to buy them again, would have to buy a size wider, and they dont MAKE a 8EEEE so, that was it for the shoes; sent back. I did have my refund in about ten days time, but rather a disappointment.

title: Comfort
text: My husband has Alzheimers and I was trying to buy him a pair of badly needed shoes that most looked like the ones he had. Bingo! These were perfect. I had bought Propet for myself in the past and were always happy with them. He is happy too.

title: Size 10 is actually a size 9-9.5
text: Very unhappy with this shoe. It stated that it was size 10 and my wife tried it for a while only to realize that it was too small and her feet started hurting. we compared the length to an Aetrex size 10 and the Propet is about 3/4 inch shorter. Aetrex are great, it's jut hard to find them in black. I would not buy another Propet.

title: Propet Men's Life Walker Strap Sneakers
text: My husband had his ankle finally fused. He was always a 11.5 wide. But from wearing the plastic brace for 1.5 yrs. and then finally ankle fusion, his foot has taken on a whole new shape. It is obviously much wider because now I have to order a 11.5 EEEEE. These sneakers are a godsend. He is finally back to work after almost 4 months and these sneakers is what he wears most days. He is a plumber and is on his feet most of the day. Thank you for making sure more customers have the choices that you have on your site. There is no store in the Buffalo, NY area to carry this wide of a shoe. Thanks again.

title: Nice shoes
text: I bought these for the man in my life. They look nice they are velcro and easy for him to put them on and off. They look like a Nike but they are much softer and lighter weight. I think they look very nice.They can be for any age ,they don't look out of date or just for a older man. I love the style and the color.

title: Perfect
text: Good, Good, Good....perfect fit,.nicely constructed and sooo comfortable. Could not be more pleased. Arrived promptly. Will be a favorite for a long time.

title: Too Sturdy and Not Wide Enough
text: I believe these popped up when I did a search for diabetic edema shoes. I ordered the widest width available and there was no way my husband could get into them. They are also very stiff which may be a plus for some people because they do seem very sturdy, but I had to return them.

title: Excellent Strap Slip-on Walking Shoe & they don't squeak on hard floors!
text: I love my new pair of Propet Men's Life Walker Strap Sneaker, Black. I bought my normal size, 11.5D, and they fit as expected. Very comfortable shoe. The straps are maybe 1/4 in too long, but I still give 5 stars. I can remove their insole and put in my own custom orthotic. They are not the most beautiful shoe in the world by any means, but I wanted comfort and a slip on strap shoe at a low price, so I'm very happy. If they last a year with my normal everyday wear, I'll be thrilled. Fifty dollar shoes don't last forever, I don't know what some people expect? The best thing may sound funny or silly to some, but I love that these don't squeak! I wear at work on hard floors, and I can never tell which shoes are going to squeak and which won't, so for me it's great that these don't squeak. If they don't wear well or a problem develops, will update and downgrade review, as always.

title: Dads first pair of tennis shoes at 73 years old.
text: Dad says they are comfortable and he loves that they have the velcro. I bought him the EEE because he dislikes tight shoes. He doesnt mind them being extra wide. He wears thick socks in the winter to keep his feet warm anyway.

title: Poor Quality
text: This shoe is similar to Model # M3715 but there is a world of difference This shoe #M3705 is made of lower quality leather that is more like plastic than leather. Spend the extra $15 and get M3715 You will be much happier.

title: Great fit for very wide feet
text: I'm a woman with very wide, flat feet, so buying shoes that fit comfortably is a struggle. These shoes fit me so well, it's as though the designer had molds of my feet to work with. I started with a white pair and just ordered black.

title: Great shoes
text: They have the same fit and comfort time after time. Their consistent, never had problem and they last a long time.

title: Great daily wear shoe
text: My husband is wearing these daily with no complaints. Glad to find an alternative for him.

title: Great sneaker
text: I purchased these sneakers for my husband. They fit well and the velcro straps are long enough to adjust as needed. The color, sport white, is very nice. So far we are very pleased.

title: Width Not As Expected
text: Size was not really the issue. Width was. Ordered it in EEEEE and thought it would give me the extra width that I needed. However, was disappointed as the shoe width was a little less wider than a shoe that I originally ordered in extra wide. A bit disappointing.

title: Repeat purchase
text: I'm pretty sure that Propet Life Walkers are possibly the most comfortable shoes available. I'm a large guy and if I don't have a great pair of shoes, my feet will hurt all day long. This is never an issue when I'm wearing Propet Life Walkers. They feel great and usually last a long time. Highly recommended.

title: Wide not really wide and velcro too short.
text: Well... I bought these based on a lot of good reviews, but I have to be honest - I really don't like these. I ordered a 15 extra (extra) wide as I have foot issues, and these were no wider than standard Xtra wide shoes I've had. They pinched in several areas and were uncomfortable. Also the top strap of velcro is FAR too short, as if you have a wide top-foot area and need to spread it open just a bit, there's not enough velcro to stretch over to the other side. Needs at least 2 more inches of it, especially in the top strap area. I have to return. Sorry.

title: good fit
text: Shoe fits really well..husband says it is a good fit..has had hip surgery and feet were swelling..will be a good shoe for walking..

title: fit great
text: comfortable, fit my high arch feet well. like the strap for a change from ties. nice to get black ones i like

title: Very comfortable feet friendly.
text: I’m a nurse. I’m on my feet all day. This shoe offers me good arch support plus meets the requirements of being being liquid friendly. That means that no bodily fluids can easily penetrate them...no fabric laces or fabric exterior trim. I also have wide feet. These shoes are comfortable for me.

title: my husband loves these
text: I love Sanuk! I have the yoga mat flip flops and they are Very comfortable!! I tried these on and they are like walking on clouds! Whoever you get these for, will love them. size up. my husband is a 11.5, got him the 12, and I am a 9.5, and I got a 10 in the yoga mats.

title: Sanuk fan for life
text: I've purchased 10 pairs of these for family and myself. Everyone loves them and thanks me for helping make their feet feel wonderful. Only thing I wish they would do it offer a little more in the way of an arch support. Then they'd be 100% perfect.

title: Super Cush!
text: These are soft and nice to walk on. Good price buying them online as opposed to in store. Been wearing them for a few weeks now and they are just starting to shape/indent to the foot a little. Not sure if this is good, bad, or indifferent but I kinda expect it. Otherwise the sandal feels great. If I have any problems, I'll add update the post! 2 1/2 Month Update: I wear these most weekends and they are holding up great. Still super cush and like new. They have indented slightly to the shape of my foot which I think makes them feel even better. Haven't gotten them wet yet because of some of the other reviews I've read about them not drying out. Keeping them as dry sandals and they seem like they will last a long time! Try them out!

title: So comfortable
text: These are the most comfortable sandals I have ever owned. They are a great value. Stylish and comfortable at a reasonable cost. I would highly recommend these. Returned a pair from a popular brand, got these and am very happy I did.

title: super comfy
text: I bought these for my husband because I have some and love them. He is now a fan as well. They are so so comfy. I highly recommend them.

title: They would last longer if I didn't have a dog...
text: Bought these as a gift for my friends birthday. Thank god they arrived, was the last day of the expected delivery. Cheap and worth it, thick padding that would normally last all year hard wearing everyday... Except for the fact the dog chews on them over the 100 toys laying around the house... Greyhound approved chew toy, as well as the only sandal worth wearing!

title: Not as comfortable as I thought
text: They are good for the price but I really thought they would be more comfortable, the cheap plastic type smell is still on them even after 2 weeks of owning then

title: Best flip flops ever!
text: Love these shoes. My first pair broke (the strip between the toes came out), which I've read is a common problem. But not a big enough deal to deter me from purchasing an identical pair. So comfortable that I can wear these all day.

title: They broke quickly...
text: Sanuk is usually a dependable brand, I consistently get them for my husband ave he loves them but this pair broke (came loose at the toe hold) the third time he wore them. I was so surprised! And he was up a creek as he had to walk a mile back to our camp from the beach BAREFOOT! Wasn't a tragedy but certainly was a big bummer.

title: ... had a previous pair of these and were my favorite until a friends dog chewed on one
text: I had a previous pair of these and were my favorite until a friends dog chewed on one. Ordered again but they don't fit like before. It's almost like the toe strap is in the wrong place. Super bummed because these are great sandals.

title: Five Stars
text: My favorite flip flops. Buy a new pair of the same each time they wear out. Extremely comfortable.

title: Comfortable and Durable.
text: My husband had a different pair of the beer cozy sandals for almost 4 years before the fabric strap in the toe started to wear and thin. These are extremely comfortable and maintained the padding well. Still look in great condition after 4 years of wear. Hoping to get the same amount of wear out of the new pair.

title: Best flip-flops ever
text: My husband loves the flip-flops. They wear great and are very comfortable. He had a pair in the past, so when he wanted new flip-flops, of course I ordered these because he likes them so much.

title: Soft footbed, no arch support
text: Soft footbed, however footbed doesn’t allow ventilation, when my foot sweats it’s prone to slide. Also the footbed is flat, I see different layers of material when I look at the insole which appears to have an arch, maybe when they are broken in I will feel the arch.

title: Great sandal to walk around in! avoid water.
text: I am a size 10. Get 1 size bigger. World's most comfortable sandal!!! This is my 4th pair in 4 years. I live in Arizona, so I wear these more than others. CAUTION: do NOT get wet! do NOT wear with wet feet! do NOT wear in the rain! Pros: MOST COMFORTABLE FLIP FLOP EVER Cons: Far from waterproof, so this is a "going out" sandal vs a beach or pool sandal.

title: Quite Comfy
text: Purchased for my 15yr old son...he has fallen in love with these shoes. He says they are extremely comfortable and is already getting a lot of use out of them even though we were only teased with warm weather for a few days.

title: Decent, but I got a blister right away.
text: I have fat feet, the large toe side of the strap digs into my skin, giving me a blister. I feel they need to be broken in, I do hope they will stretch out.

title: They are comfortable, they are more substantial looking than the flimsy ...
text: My husband loves these. They are comfortable, they are more substantial looking than the flimsy flip-flops he had been wearing, and they match practically everything. He has been wearing the same pair for almost a year, and there is still plenty of life left in them.

title: Sanuk is Thai for "FUN"
text: Owned two previous pairs of Sanuk sandals and they took me from "I'll never wear flip flops" to "I only wear flip flops in the summer". However, they don't make that style anymore, so I tried these out. They are very comfortable but also very different than my previous style. I don't think they are AS comfortable, but still very nice. They also fit a little bit smaller than the previous style.

title: Your feet will thank you!
text: I own this sandal in a few colors...they are well made and very comfortable. It is the only show I wear when I am waking for 6-8 hours at Disney World...they are that fantastic! These ran a little small, so instead of an 8, I required a 9 for the right fit. Try these...you will LOVE them!

title: Comfortable sandals for everyday use
text: This is my second pair of Sanuk sandals and I really like them. They are very comfortable seem well made. The strap part is a little tight when first worn but it stretches and loosens up after 2 or 3 times wearing them. I live in Florida and have had many sandals in my time and these are my favorites so far.

title: Five Stars
text: Fit great. Only had for a few days but feel like they will hold up great as everyday sandals

title: Looks great, comfortable and best price!
text: I ordered the Black/White Beer Cozy in 11. I usually wear a 10.5 in shoes and 10 in sandals. Glad I took the advice on some of the reviews and ordered 1 up and it fits perfectly. The foot bed on these sandals are extremely soft and very comfortable. Maybe the softest sandal I've ever owned, we'll see how it holds up this summer. The combination of the Black/White looks sweet and the wifey agrees. I'm already thinking about getting another pair and the price, the best around!

title: Sweet Comfy Flips
text: Great flips, comfy and well made. My one wish: more arch support, but these are adequate in this area as well.

title: comfortable on the bottom, snug on the top
text: The underside of the straps are a little rough on the top of the foot. Also pretty snug at first. I'm hoping that will smooth out and loosen up with wear. These are Sanuk flip flops so of course they are comfortable to walk in otherwise.

title: Simply Comfortable
text: These are great flip-flops. They have a lot of cushion, so be prepared to feel your feet sink into the flip-flop with each step. They do seem a little small, I would probably order a half-size larger than my normal shoe size. The camo pattern is understated, but you can still tell it's camouflage.

title: The best I've found
text: I got my first pair of these about six years ago, on my honeymoon in Hawaii. I still have them, and they've still got some years left it seems. They are soft, comfortable, and the best flip-flop type sandal I've ever found. I bought this second pair because I liked the first ones so much.

title: Comfort
text: I got them for my brother as a present and he told me 11 1/2 for his size. I went for the 12 because they don't come in half sizes and they were almost too small! He really loves them though!

title: The only sandals I wear now
text: I’m somewhat of a flip flop connoisseur, and these are the only ones I buy/own now. I’ve had rainbow sandals, crocs, etc. These are my favorites. I have three pairs now and wear them for everything. One pair at the mountain house, one pair at home, one pair at the beach house. I do home renovations in them, walk the dog, etc. feet never hurt. I forget I’m wearing them.

title: Very comfortable
text: bought them for my husband he had a pair before and really liked them so when they finally wore out I got him this pair. He wears them almost everyday and loves them

title: Keen sandal
text: I love these shoes. They are my pick for the summer. I have had three pairs that I have got through. My foot is unusual. It is a "C". Regular shoes are B and wide are D, so I can have trouble with finding the right shoe; but these fit me perfectly. They are very comfortable.

title: Love these sandals
text: Love these sandals. They do run about a half size small. I usually wear an 8 in all my shoes but had to send the first pair back and get an 8 1/2. Very comfortable.

title: Comfortable for short hikes & long walks, wet or dry.
text: I am glad I got them but I wear them less than I expected since they aren't terribly stylish. For fit and function they get top marks.

title: Smidge too short
text: I loved the sandalAnd I would have kept it, but it was a smidge too short. I wish it came in half sizes. My shoe size is 11 1/2 which most shoemakers do not carry

title: Slippery Keen
text: I love Keens for water aerobics. They keep me from slipping on pool floors. These, however are so slippery that I will never wear a hem in the pool again. They will be regulated to walks on the beach as the are not slippery in the sand. We have ordered a replacement pair and will let you know if they have the same problem. It is a different style so should know if it is the stupidity ke or some “improvement”.

title: keens make me happy
text: I've bought 8 pairs of Keens and will keep buying them. I like the way they feel like sneakers and look like shoes. I like the varieties offered. Sometimes buying on line is hard with sizes, but this was great.

title: True to size
text: Nice weight for walking and outdoor activities. Hugs the foot well. Good traction. Cons: My older pair were leather and when I wear without socks, my feet sweat on the newer pair because they are not. I prefer the leather for this reason. Also leather may be more giving when worn in.

title: Great fit, super comfortable and cool feet!
text: Got these sandals for work mostly. Love the fact that I don't have to have a perfect pedicure. They are super comfortable as I am on my feet 7.5 hours a day.

title: Perfect combination of comfort, sturdiness, and style
text: I own a pair just like these in purple that I've been wearing for at least 3 or 4 years. They are the perfect combination of comfort, sturdiness, and style. I love both the purple and the celestial blue.

title: Perfect Keens
text: These are my first Keens and they are awesome! There is zero break in time. On super hot days I noticed my feet sweating a little but not enough to reject the sandal shoe. I wear a size 6 regular pretty much across the board and these are truly spot on. Buy some! You won't regret! Promise

title: really love this sandal
text: Wow!! talk about comfort. I really, really love this sandal. I have never had a sandal feel and look wonderful. My toes are protected which is a great thing for me. I wore all day to a gathering and never once did they hurt my feet. No rubbing in any area. My feet didn't get hot either. I would recommend to everyone.

title: Love these!
text: These are my 3d pair! I bought the first for water aerobics; then decided to wear them as street shoes. Yesterday I wore them on an all day shopping trip. My back which usually starts hurting when I wear other "comfort" shoes did not complain all day. My diabetes coach is pleased with them also as they protect my toes yet give me the feel of sandals. I am looking forward to buying another color soon.

title: So close!
text: Sadly, I plan to pack these up and send them back. The outer left side comes up a little too high and runs on my ankle bone. The arch is good, the toe box is good. They fit as well as the pair of Keen Venice sandals I have in leather except for that one spot. I had hoped these would be exactly the same. I will keep my eyes open for the Venice in a black leather, just as I keep watching for my fall/winter Keen Voyageurs to appear in a black or gray. :-)

title: Love these shoes!
text: When I first tried these on I was worried as they were a little snug. After wearing them a few times they stretch and mold to your feet which is great. I wore these all over Disney World (10 miles a day) and didn't get blisters. They are great on rainy days as they have good grip and dry quickly. I will be getting more!

title: Love it so much I bought another pair!
text: Very comfortable... Only pair of sandals I took as an alternate when i was not hiking. Feet loved it even with blisters. Only complaint was it took a while to get it dry once it got wet. Would still recommend it for the comfort. I actually bought another pair for everyday use.

title: I bought the size I normally wear and had to ...
text: I bought the size I normally wear and had to return them for a larger size. The larger size pinched my toes too, so I sent them back and bought something else.

title: Sister got lucky
text: ended up giving shoes to my sister with (apparently) smaller feet than me and she loves them. I would have ordered the shoes again, half a size larger,but was concerned that the size I had ordered is the one that has fit for the last 30 years. May do if they go on sale,

title: Perfect
text: Just what I was looking for to wear this summer. Needed the support of a sneaker but not the heat from wearing sneakers in the heat.

title: Great walking sandal
text: when I first got these I found the toe area was hitting my toes as I walked , so they were a little small. However after wearing them a few days this stopped as they got more relaxed. They are very comfortable and I wore them every day in the summer. You can jog in them too . They are not great for hiking as the twigs and pebbles get in the shoe frequently .

title: Great color!
text: Fit perfectly. Everything I expected, and they were on sale. Even better. This is my second pair. I highly recommend this shoe; it's sturdy, versatile, and pretty.

title: Supportive
text: I have been wearing them around the house to see if they are indeed what I need to walk on the beaches in Hawaii and I found them to be comfortable and supportive. I would recommend them to anyone needing sandals for water activities such as canoeing and kayaking. They were recommended to me by a friend who also uses them.

title: Keens are comfort and style wrapped up in one
text: Been wearing Keens for many years now. This style is comfortable and supportive enough to wear all day. You can wear these with or without socks, which is an added feature I like. If you are looking for comfort PLUS style, go with Keens, you won't be sorry ;)

title: Excellent water sandal, tough to get on and off.
text: Good fit for my 5-1/2 Wide feet, comfortable to walk in, and protects my toes from coral/rocks when walking at the beach. The wide sole provides better stability in sand than bare feet; it's stiffer than a fashion sandal, more like a hiking boot sole. Sand rinses out easily and fit was not affected from getting wet. My only issue is getting them on and off. My feet have basically been rebuilt and are not flexible due to multiple pins and plates. The shoe opening doesn't have much "give" to it, so it was a struggle to get them on. Using a shoe horn, the loops provided, and a lot of tugging, I finally manage to work them over my heel. Someone with normal feet probably won't have the same problem.

title: Are these genuine keen sandals?
text: I am not sure these are genuine Keen sandals. The fit isn't quite the same, the color is different, and it doesn't seem to be the same quality.

title: I love wearing them because I am a serious walker and ...
text: This is my 4th pair of these shoes. I love wearing them because I am a serious walker and these are shoes I can walk in. Also, I walk on the beach and can get them wet and sandy and then wash them off.

title: I finally found my hiking sandals!
text: I have looked and looked for a good hiking sandal that could handle wet rocks, so common to trails in Oregon. I had tried three different pairs, which all failed, and then I found these. The first person I noticed wearing them was my aunt, who lives on the Rogue River. She said she loved hers. Then, just a week later, I was hiking to some waterfalls and noticed a fellow hiker climbing on the wet rocks without difficulty, so I asked her what kind of shoes she was wearing. She too had Keens. So then I did some online research and this is the style I settled on. As soon as they arrived I took them for a trial on a short and easy trail just to see how they felt. They were very comfortable. The next day I went on a true hike over various terrains...gravel path, dirt path, dry rocks, logs and wet rocks. They were awesome. They were comfortable the entire 7-mile hike, without rubbing or blisters. They were snug enough to keep my feet from slipping inside, yet not tight nor binding. The rubber toe cover was amazing, as twice I hit my toe quite hard on a rock and a tree root, and both times I felt nothing. I had no trouble with dirt and gravel getting inside. On that whole 7 miles, I only g

title: Keen Waterproof Sandals
text: These are great. I have them in 2 colours! They are comfortable, easy to get on and off, great in and out of the water and all surfaces. Good support too. For walking long distances in the woods to the beach, to an outdoor concert, to a meadow, on a raft, this is the one shoe fits all needs kind of shoe!

title: Comfortable and secure.
text: These are very comfortable walking in warm weather. You feel safe and secure. Have not used in water yet. They are also a little cute for what they are.

title: Size is not regular sizing, too small
text: I ordered the same size as two other pairs of Keenes that fit perfectly and they are a bit too short and the arch strap is really tight. I can't wear them.

title: Good quality shoes
text: These shoes are comfortable and made of good quality. Good price. Prompt delivery. Would use this seller again.

title: Great price!!!
text: My husband has worn this style for years. I have never gotten them for such a great price though! Will definitely purchase here again!

title: Comfortable
text: I actually had to return this shoe as it was cut a bit too small for my foot. However, it looked good and was comfortable. A half size up should do well for me.

title: Good Value

They go from salty, muddy puddles to the business office with a quick cleaning. They really are a great all-around shoe. ...except for the damned squeaking. It started as a mild nuisance. Maybe they just got a little wet, they'll dry off and be fine. The floors are just "squeaky-clean". Half an hour later and the noise is still there, no longer ignorable, reminding me of every footstep... Fast-forward to now, months later. I have a map in my head of all the routes I can take through the office without leaving carpet and suffering the dreadful stares from annoyed co-workers. I'm shopping for office-only shoes now. Sure, I'll be keeping this pair for anything where there's a chance of getting dirty, but they're absolutely intolerable for anyone who works in an office without carpets.

They are perfect. My only complaint is that the sole tends to wear out way before the rest of the shoe, probably because of where I am hiking with them. If you hike on well-maintained trails, no problem, but if you scrape them across rocks all day the soles are going to wear out fast. As a plus to the sole, and this might be a weird thing, I find that they don't track a lot of filth into the house. They don't get a lot of things stuck in them, and dog poo is easy to clean off! title: ONE OF MY TOP 3 SHOES. I WEAR THEM A FEW TIMES A WEEK AND THEY ARE DURABLE AND COMFORTABLE!
text: I haven't filled this review out and it must be a whole year since I bought them. I am wearing then right now and I wear them all the time! They are KEDS so they are reliable to withstand a lot of wear. I only buy the leather ones like this and they endure great. I love how they just slip on but still grip to my feet well, I don't ever have a problem with them being loose because of the elastic sides. If necessary, I clean them with a quality white rubber cleaning eraser, use a damp sponge to get off any residue from the sponge, and they are good as new. Yes, I've had them for over year now and they show signs of wear but the only wear sign is the crease where my toes bend like every other shoe does. I get the same pair again when years later I have finally worn them out and want a little more bounce in my step again and a fresh new shoe look!

title: Just as expected
text: I bought these shoes based on reviews I read about them here on Amazon. So thank you to everyone who submitted a review. Just as others said, they feel great right out of the box. I did not experience any rubbing, even in bare feet, and they fit perfectly. I have a wide foot with a narrow heel and these fit beautifully. Lots of support and very sturdy. I'm looking forward to wearing these on my upcoming Baltic cruise where I'll spend long days walking through European cities with cobblestone streets. I'm sure these will work well and I won't have to fuss with shoelaces. I may come back and update my review, if possible, after I've really put them to the test in northern Europe.

title: Not for high arch
text: The shoe description has missing information that it's not for a person with a high arch. What's more, according to the product description W on the label refers to womens. Yet in the normal world the W or XW means Wide With or extra with with. Therefore keep reading each word very carefully. I was fooled by the description @ Product Description which said "It also features three points of adjustability for enhanced fit and comfort." They are not adjustable as the fabric mesh does not allow for it. I needed to cut the fabric mesh top due to the high arch of foot cause otherwise I was not able to slide my foot in. Another issue is at the shoe hill. I do not know a person with rounded heels unless your foot ends in the shape of a potato. Not only did I need to cut the mesh at the top again but also had to add inside the heel protector as otherwise it hits hard on the skin. The size is true to it but be aware that the shoes does not come in the wide with size.

title: Great Shoes

title: Cute comfort for WIDE, curved feet only.
text: Excellect quality. Great grey/blue color. Brown works, but the grey combo is perkier. I would have kept them, but they are wide shoes that can be cinched for those with a low instep. Though I have a low instep, no amount of cinching will keep my foot from sliding side to side. Additionally, the outside edges curve out too wide at the ball of the foot...then they curve way towards the inside...like a half moon. Skechers use the same shape last on a lot of their shoes. They dont work for me because they force my straight foot into an unnatural curve. Another "no go" for me is that with my pronated ankles, these shoes seemed to cause my feet to cave in even more. Yes, wonderful to stand in, but, after wearing Keen boots, two pairs of socks and an extra pad, my foot/knee/hip/back pain has gone away. Plantar/Mortons/narrow/low instep/pronated ankles...have made me learn to be exceptionally cautious about my shoe purchases. These will go back so that someone with a wide, curved foot and normal arches and low to mid instep can enjoy their cuteness and comfort!

title: Good Looking But Hurt My Feet
text: These slippers look awesome and initially feel awesome, but I had to insert (2) complete pairs of Dr. Scholl's inserts into the slippers to make them reasonably comfortable. These slippers get an A+ for looks and a D- for comfort. They will cover your feet go out to get the mail or pick up the newspaper in chilly weather, but don't expect them to provide anything beyond that. Sorel could easily have supplied better quality that was totally focused on the need absolute plush comfort, but they failed. Definitely not worth the premium price.

title: not bad but...
text: I usually wear the Cabela's shearling slippers. I bought the last pair maybe 5 years ago, could be longer. When the stitching wore away in the back I decided to start looking for a new pair. I never wear slippers outside but I do wear them daily (cold ceramic tile floors in New England) so this time I decided to go for the rubber sole. I didn't want anything to thick but something that would help keep me from participating in the stair luge. I wear an 11 shoe but went up a size after reading all these helpful reviews and thankfully so. The 12's fit very well. upon arrival I tried them on and my initial impression was soft, snug, warm, but my ankles aren't covered anymore, wt? I do like the very thin rubber sole, it provides a great deal more traction for walking down hard wood stairs. I wouldn't go out in rain or snow wearing them but I could probably make a run to the mailbox without worry. They are definitely very comfortable so I considered my purchase a success. Well its been a few weeks now and I noticed that if I wear them for long periods on a lazy Saturday my feet sweat like I just played hockey for 2 hours. title: Comfortable
text: These are very comfortable. The only negative I can see at this point is the material used in the lining on the sole tends to loosen and gather. Sort of like its shedding. I hope it does not keep this up or I will have a bald pair of slippers by Christmas. Update review: It wasn't too long after writing this review (3 months) that the inserts were at the end of their usefulness. I wrote to Sorel because I could not find a replacement product on their site and I wanted them to know my disappointment with their choice of liner material. They responded back with "We recommend replacing the liners with Ugg or similar liners". So much for customer service from Sorel. I've worn Sorel boots for years and they held up very good. Not so with the liners with these slippers. The slippers are still in great shape. I recently ordered liners from Ugg. We'll see how they fit these slippers. I would not recommend these slippers due to the poor quality of the lining material. Sorry Sorel, you brought this upon yourself.

I didn't expect these to become my go-to pair of shoes - I normally opt for Vans, and shoes of that type. But I find myself wearing these whenever weather permits! title: Really like these boots
text: I've been a fan of Timberland's shoes for a while. This was my first pair of boots for them, though so I wasn't sure how they would feel compared to their other shoes. After wearing them for a few months now I'm a big fan, liking the rugged look and quality of them. The leather when you first get them is quite stiff, but after a day or two of just walking around it breaks in very nicely. It has a good thick, quality feel to it. The internal lining isn't very thick so these would be best for cool to moderate climates (not extreme colds). The bottom of the soul has good traction which is part of what I was looking for (I live in a area that's cool wet and slick for a good part of the year). If you need arch support in your shoes or like a very cushy soul though you'll want to add inserts to these (which I don't need, but would have liked to see in order to give the product 5 stars).

title: Good boots

title: Color Doesn’t Match Pictures
text: The Medium Brown shown in the picture is nothing like the two pairs that were sent to me. The boxes both say medium brown but are a solid brown. There’s no two tone color on them. The picture shown on a,axon is two tomed. In reality, they are one solid color and look nothing like advertised. title: Comfortable boots even after 15+ miles of combined walks.
text: Had these boots for a little over 2 weeks, here's what I think about them: - Shoe size matched the same size I wear for government issued boots: 10W. I did not have to order a size down like other reviews have noted. - I have flat feet and the boots are able to accommodate arch support soles with no spacing issues. Toe box is a little on narrow side but not much of a concern for me. - The leather on these is much softer than the typical work boots I wear, pretty sure they would tear easily if used in abrasive type work environments. - Without speed lacing eyelets on the ankle part of the boot you can expect to take longer to put on and take off boots. - Ankle support is pretty solid on these, pretty standard protection you can expect from any similar ankle high boots. I'm considering getting a local cobbler to add some to mine. - I wear these as a everyday type shoes and average about 10,000 steps a day. I really like how comfortable they feel even at the end of the day. There no break in period needed with these and my feet felt good even after day 1 of wearing them. - If they last more than a year then I'll definitely order another pair.

title: they look great, and break in even better
text: they look great, and break in even better. like most timbs tho, they seem to be flat footed. a little fatigueing after a while. i put in a new insole however, and now i can wear them all day without a problem

title: My fifth or sixth pair and unfortunately the last one...
text: It is the fifth or sixth time I have purchased this model over the last 10-15 years. It used to be the most comfortable boots ever, fresh, light, comfortable. But something has changed. I ordered it late last year and the first pair I received was very uncomfortable. There were stitches/leather-overlaps inside the boots that made an uncomfortable "bump" causing painful pressure on the top of my feet. And in addition there was poor stitching elsewhere on the boots. I returned the pair, thinking I had received a poor quality-controlled item. The replacement pair was slightly better (no poor stitching); however, the inside "bumps" in the upper part of the inside are still there -- not as pronounced as in the first pair but still annoying annoying and uncomfortable. This is a new thing; i never experienced this in my previous pairs. I have resolved to keep the pair since I already tried exchanging them once and will seek a way to reduce the thickness of these inside "bumps", through sandpapering or something. But I am still very unhappy with a $150 pair of boots that although they still look cool are not of the expected high quality. Looks like this will be my last Earthkeepers :(

title: Great Boots, the shipping well...
text: I love these boots, they fit great, keep your feet dry, very comfortable. Since I got them I can't take them off my feet! So the shipping... Well I bought these boots on a impulse with the intention of using them for my Halloween costume on Saturday night 10/26. I bought them on Friday, I paid for the upgraded shipping to have the item overnight to me... Well Saturday nights party came and when and I was Timberland Earthkeeperless.... The shoes ended up arriving that Monday 10/28. In the end I'm not devastated because they are awesome boots but Amazon guaranteed delivery by 8pm 10/26 and I paid for the upgraded shipping!

title: Not a good fit
text: Unlike my husbands previous experience with a different pair, he said these hurt to walk in. He said the toe area was not great and that the boots were too narrow, despite him having narrow feet. Unfortunately I'll have to find him something better for Christmas. If I find his last pair I'll update the ones he loved the fit of but did not last him long, I think the last pair weren't waterproof. But he explained the comfort he liked about them. Update: his last pair were (Timberland PRO Men's 26011 Direct Attach 8" Soft-Toe) he said those were really comfy but they tattered quick. I don't think they are waterproof. ☹️

title: good looking, comfortable
text: Waterproof, good looking, comfortable, light. They aren't for hiking but I took them on an 8 mile hike one day and they felt totally fine. The sole started to detach from the bottom from the boot after about 2 months of wear. It was mostly cosmetic but could have gotten more serious if I had neglected the problem for several weeks. I fixed the problem that weekend using some shoe repair glue. Easy fix so I wasn't too disappointed. I would give 4.5 stars if possible.

title: Slipperl-like Comfort
text: My Timerland Earthkeeper boots are well-made and comfortable. I returned the first pair I ordered in my usual size, 9.5W, because the boots were a little too big. I ordered a pair in 9W, which fit perfectly. The boots will not require a break-in period because they are flexible right out of the box. The stitching is even. I like wearing my new boots so much that I wear them at night when I am in my pajamas. I've worn these boots on long hikes, traversing loose sand, rocky outcrops, and steep hill sides. The soles grip loose surfaces well. I've haven't slipped on granite or basalt rocks. I recommend these boots because of the high quality, sturdy construction, and comfort.

title: Says they are the most comfortable boots he's owned
text: Sent to my son in Germany last year for Christmas. I don't think he's taken them off since. Says they are the most comfortable boots he's owned. Maybe this year in black! He's a size 11-12. Got him 11.5. Perfect with different thickness socks. Best part: shipped directly from amazon to Germany. He received them in a week! For $20.00. No customs duty. title: Comfy quality boots .... so far.
text: Hopefully these will last, because if they do, they are the best spent money on boots for comfort. The leather is supple, and the sticking looks to be nicely finished. The sole is multi layered and finished with a bottom layer that is very flexible. The fit, if you have the right size (approx half size too big at normal shoe size), is like a glove for your foot, and they allow you to crouch without cutting off circulation to your toes. Nice.

title: Stylish and sturdy
text: Purchased these boots for my daughter's boyfriend and he loves them for wearing outside of work as his work boots are filthy all the time. These are stylish.

title: A few nitpicks keep this from being 4 or 5 stars...
text: Ok, so first the good: They look great. They seem sturdy enough for my intended use. That is to say, daily wear and "casual" hiking. I have my doubts that they would hold up under very rugged conditions, but then again, I didn't buy them for any sort of aggressive hiking conditions. I'll wear my Merrells for that. The leather is surprisingly soft right out of the box. This was nice as the boots required almost no breaking in time, unlike almost all other leather boots I've bought. Within a few days of purchase, I wound up wearing them at an all day photo shoot. They were comfortable all day long and, most importantly, by the time I got home, my feet were not screaming at me. Now the nitpicks: Prior to purchase, I read a number of reviews complaining about the sizing. I'm glad I did. Based on what others said, I ordered a half-size smaller than normal (I went with a size 10, instead of my usual 10.5). Even then, the boots feel just a tad on the large size -- not enough to justify going down a half a size again, but just a touch more roomy in the toes than I'd like. If I were going to do any sort of aggressive hiking in these, I don't feel like I'd have a good feel for the trail due

title: Perfect show for fit and comfort

title: Danskos are great!
text: As a nurse, I'm on my feet ALL day. I used to wear Nike Shox to work, and after 5-6 hours my knees would hurt. As a brand new 22 year old nurse, I knew that couldn't be good. I switched to Dansko's to use up an Amazon gift card and I'm now on my 3rd pair! I can usually get 2 years out of them before the patent leather starts cracking where my toes bend. Advice: Try these on in a local store before you buy (so you know your size for sure!) Wear thinner socks with these shoes. They are meant to be tighter across the top of your foot and they wear like a clog so your heel doesn't hardly touch the backs at all Don't use alcohol-based cleaners to wipe these down. It will cause the leather to crack prematurely. Definitely worth the price!!

title: Great shoe... not slip resistant
text: These are really great shoes. I wear a size 9.5 - 10 and bought the size 40 and they fit as expected. These styles are meant to be loose in the heel and moves up and down while you walk. It takes some getting used to, but it is just the way of the shoe. I bought these to replace a pair that was eaten by an overly zealous teething German Shepherd puppy. Unfortunately, I am returning them because this specific style is NOT slip resistant. I assure you. I could tell as soon as I took them out of the box. I work in a restaurant and can't afford to risk wearing these on a wet surface. If you want a slip resistant dansko, read the company shoe descriptions carefully because not all styles are rated as slip resistant. I will be ordering the Dansko Professional XP style once my return is processed. That one is clearly stated to have a slip resistant bottom. If these weren't so expensive, I would keep these for every day and order the others for work, but my budget doesn't afford that. That's why I still give this shoe 5 stars, even though I have to exchange them.

title: Love this navy blueberry color - highly recommend

After just a few days of walking on sidewalks / streets the bottoms are already showing significant signs of wear. I can't imagine they'll last more than a single summer of regular walking, which is a shame at this price point. The bottom of the soles really should be rubber.

text: When a shoe is this bad, I always wonder if the company ever tried their own shoes before the mass produced them. This shoe was disappointing on several levels. First off, there is a spiffy Rocket Dog logo on the sole of the shoe, of which you WILL feel when you walk in them. I thought, no problem, I'll slip a sole insert into the shoe for extra padding. That did nothing for the discomfort. Second, the lightweight canvas heel cup comes down low and the rubber sole is a bit on the heavy side. This makes the heal cup slide up and down on the back of the heel; even without the sole insert. I'm sure that would cause a blister in no time at all. Lastly, the laces are ridiculously long, which gives them a bit of a clown look. It's really too bad, because they are so darned cute. My advice, save yourself the disappointment and don't buy these shoes.

text: It took two tries to get the right size in these, but I finally got it right. I normally wear 11C/D, but ended up having to go up to 11E to get these to fit comfortably. It's neutral enough I can wear it with my black trousers or my denim jeans and they look great. The sole has the "nubby" super-grippy stuff, plus a deeply ribbed texture under the heel, which means minimal slippage, important at my more advanced stage of life. And comfortable? Oh my, YES! They're about as close to perfect as I could hope. Cloud soft -- great for weekend running around. They don't provide the kind of support I would want for extensive walking/sight-seeing, but for casual wear doing normal day-to-day errands and relaxing around the house, they're just right. They may stretch a bit, but the tie is adjustable, so I should be able to compensate for that. VERY happy with these, and will probably purchase another pair in a different color.

First, there is a suede-like pad glued from the back of the moc to midway in the shoe. Why they would include a partial insole I don't know but this one ends at a very awkward place that rubs on the foot. I can't think of a benefit for it at all. So now, I'm thinking I have to buy a full size insole after ripping this one out-that's an added expense. Well, I won't be needing to do that after all. Imagine my surprise when I removed them after the first wearing to find my feet stained black from the dye used in the shoe. The tops of my toes, sides and bottoms of my feet were black. I didn't buy these to wear with socks. So now I feel I have a $45 pair of unusable moccasins. I threw the packaging out, and wore them for a day, inside and out before discovering all of this or I would return them. I counted on the Minnetonka name but I guess it just isn't the brand it used to be.

Some mocs I have found are a good fit for me because of this, but some have more "give" than others. This pair seems to fit a little big, even on days that my feet swell, so I don't usually choose to wear them if I know I will be going out for more than just a couple of hours, or if I expect to do lots of walking. The outside features are fine - stitching and sole looks good, etc. The pile lining doesn't compare to the sheepskin lining. I didn't really expect it to (duh!), but I wasn't expecting to need to add insoles on day 1 (otherwise there was zero fluff or support - it was like going barefoot). I was also surprised these run a little big (normally the new slippers are snug and need to be worn in a bit, but not these). I ordered a womens 6W (I normally wear either a 6W or 6.5W in various brands), and these are long on my foot (I can easily get a finger between my heel and the back of the shoe) and are plenty wide. I'll keep these and wear them out, but will go back to the pricier sheepskin option next time around. Different people like different fits and feels, so these may be your cup of tea - I just like the other
