title: Better than ballet shoes
text: If you or your child is learning multi-modes of dance...check with the instructor and see if jazz shoes are acceptable as opposed to ballet shoes. These are more durable and versatile.

title: good shoe though
text: I saw everyone's advice to order big but my daughter wears a 9 1/2 and we ordered a 10 and they are too large. We now have to order a 9 1/2. good shoe though.

title: Please order 1-2 sizes up
text: I am a shoe size 9 5'5 girl with a slightly wide foot. This has no problem with the width but... my feet... oh my feet... they hurt so terribly.

title: Three Stars
text: Shoe itself very nice, hard to gauge size, most likely will stretch to become more comfortable.

title: Order Larger Size
text: These are my daughter's second pair of jazz shoes and I followed past reviews and ordered a wide, 1.5 sizes larger than her street shoe size. They fit, but there is NO WIGGLE ROOM.

title: My normal street size fits
text: I know a lot of the dance shoes fit everyone different depending on whether you're a child or adult, whether you have a narrow, average, or wide foot, etc., but I went to a dance shop and tried these on (and bought them) and my street size fits perfectly. I have a narrow to average width foot. They make these in wide as well of course if you think you will need them.

title: They were a bit rumpled looking when they arrived, ...
text: They were a bit rumpled looking when they arrived, but they do the job. They came in the much needed wide width, without the hassle of special ordering through the dance store - and for less money.

title: Comfortable, Stable, Attractive!
text: Very comfortable and stable along with great looks. True to size. My only disappointment is the buckle strap is difficult since the punched holes don’t go all the way through, so you have to enlarge the holes you need to use. It is a very attractive shoe. So happy with them I bought another color!

title: Dancing shoe
text: The shoe looked nice, but was a bit wide for my narrow foot. I was afraid, with the high heel, that I might slip of and twist my ankle. It was easy to return. Thanks.

title: Excellent!
text: I took them out dancing once so far but will be using them every week. They are great! Comfortable. Didn't have blisters or anything.

title: Love the lower heel
text: I can’t wear a higher heel anymore, so the 1-1/2” heel on this shoe is makes it a perfect character shoes for the musical I am in.

title: Inside Soles Started Coming Loose Almost Immediately
text: Purchased for a student for a High School play. Capezio is historically an excellent brand but this young lady wore the shoes for only 6 shows before they started falling apart. The inside soles started coming loose after the second sole and were completely falling out by the sixth show. I know teen girls are not easy on clothing and shoes but I expected them to last longer. Might have been just a defective pair though. I'm not ready to give up on the Capezio brand yet.

title: Great for organ playing
text: I was told on the site the shoe ran small, so I ordered a 1/2 size larger (I normally wear a 9 but got a 9 1/2. Fit perfectly.

title: No problems so far.
text: Just what my thespian needed for the play. A little stiff, but I expect that will resolve.

title: Definitely a good deal
text: I'm so Happy with this purchase, received it just in time for the show! Shoes were a hit, great choice!

title: order half to one size up
text: I have to say the quality is really great. I ordered half size up, but still feel it a little bit small. I wear it daily at home before dancing, in order to make the shoes fit my feet better. However, I feel great and the shoes are fit as expected when I dance.

title: Surprisingly fantastic!
text: I wore these to a 1920s party- they were absolutely great! They were surprisingly comfortable and I walked and danced in them for hours! This is coming from a person who usually wears wonderfully supportive shoes like Keens or Chacos. Buy THEM!

title: Perfect shoes, perfect fit (if you know they run small)
text: These shoes are perfect. I have purchased Capezio shoes before and knew they run a little small. They are supposed to be a snug fit for theatre work. I normally get a 9 in shoes, but I know to get a 10 in character shoes. These are going to be perfect for my future auditions and theatre work.

title: Other than the lining on the inside coming out pretty easily, these shoes will last through dozens of ...
text: Other than the lining on the inside coming out pretty easily, these shoes will last through dozens of rehearsals and performances.

title: Elegant and Comfy
text: I loved the shoes, even prettier than advertised. Very comfy and beautiful. I'm a beginner dancer and for right now this is what I need. I'm very happy with it. Btw, i ordered half size bigger than my regular shoes.

title: Best Shoe
text: I love Capezio! Their shoes are amazing, and always fit true to size. I have worn these ones in 3 different musicals, and they still look like brand new. The wear and tear on these is great because they can really hold up!

title: Just enough heel!
text: Bought these for my mother who does not like dress shoes. She really enjoyed wearing these—she went up and down the stairs of her walk-up in them and did not complain about walking to the restaurant so I can only assume they are comfortable. I have my reservations on how long they will last, the materials do not look like they are long lasting.

title: Disappointed
text: I've ordered similar character shoes from other manufacturers and, as long as I size up, they fit beautifully. I wear a 6.5 street shoe, so ordered 7.5, as is my norm for a character shoe. They fit almost perfectly...perhaps a tad big but a 7 would probably have been too snug. My dissatisfaction is with the strap. I'm not even sure how to explain the problem: Even at the tightest supplied hole, it's way too loose. I added a hole as far over as I could, on each shoe....and it's still too loose and looks silly. I'll never be able to wear these...a real waste.

title: Snug- Size Up A Lot
text: I had to return my original purchase for a larger than normal size. The shoe is very bottom and short. I went up a size on my second purchase. It barely fit my daughter. Next time I will go up 1 1/2 -2 sizes. We have the same shoe brand for tap, and she wears a different size.

title: not good coushining. Though they are heels
text: Kids feet tend to hurt after practice, not good coushining. Though they are heels, so I didn't really expect them to be too comfortable.

title: Runs a little small, but super comfortable and good quality
text: I purchased these because my daughter was auditioning for a musical and had to do a dance number for the audition. Character shoes were suggested rather than flats or ballet shoes, so I ordered these. I ordered two sizes because I read reviews that they ran small and I wasn't sure. I ended up keeping the ones that were two sizes larger than her normal street shoe size. We honestly probably could have gone up another half size, but they were not uncomfortably tight, and we needed them sooner than another pair could be shipped, so we kept them. She loves them. They are so comfortable to wear that she wears them instead of her regular black dress shoes. I rated them a five because the price was good, the quality is great (even with her wearing them on a regular basis, they have held up...and she is tough on her shoes). I would recommend these to anyone...really...even just to wear to work...but primarily they are meant to be used for dancing. The only real drawback is (like all other dance shoes), they do run significantly small. Definitely buy two sizes up. On another note, customer service was awesome about accepting the return of the additional pair of shoes I ordered, and my refun

title: The 7 1/2 wide fits perfect. I love that the heel has a small ...
text: I wear between a 7 and a 7 1/2. I ordered both the 7 1/2 and the 8 wide based on reviews saying that they run small. The 7 1/2 wide fits perfect. I love that the heel has a small cut out so that when you bend your ankle the shoe doesn't cut into your heel. Pretty and functional for my Latin dance class.

title: Comes in wide!
text: Got the stelle, they where great, but a little narrow, so, when my dog ate them, I decided to spend a little more, and get these in wide. I have bad tailors bunions, so my feet are super wide, and even wide sized are a little narrow. These work great, and are super comfortable compared to the stelle. Still a little tight at the pinkie toe, but, that's what happens when you run the sides of you feet on the ground as a nervous habit. The stelle did have better arch support

title: Narrow in the toes, even at 1/2 size larger.
text: They are cute and stylish,. The dip at the hell seems likeit would make them more comfortable, but they were too narrow in the toes, even at 1/2 size larger than my normal.

title: Four Stars
text: Glad I listened to reviews and ordered a 1/2 size up. These are comfortable. Good choice and good price.

title: Order up ONE SIZE!
text: Ordered these shoes for my ballroom dancing lessons; the first pair I ordered were 7s, and WAY TOO SMALL! They fit like Size 6--so I ordered up to a Size 8, and they fit beautifully! The shoes are wonderfully comfortable for my dance lessons, and the arch support is great. Just order up ONE SIZE if you order them!

title: Go Bigger Than You Think
text: I love these shoes for a yearly competition but unless they are broken in well I would not advise using on a regular basis or for longer than a few hours. My shoe size is usually a 6 1/2 and I ordered a 7 but they were still a little tight. You may need to order even larger and use inserts to perfect the fit. They also slide on the bottoms, I use a simple slip proof cover for the sole that keeps me from sliding on carpet and tile.

title: Buyer BEWARE! This is the cheapest and gosh awful shoe I've ever ordered
text: Do not buy this it is from China and is very very cheaply put together. I'm returning it. I'm almost ready to stop using Amazon I think it should be called CHINAZon.

title: These shoes are made nice however they run VERY small
text: These shoes are made nice however they run VERY small. I ordered these for my daughter who is a size 7 but when they arrived, they were nearly two sizes too small.

title: Great shoe
text: Finally found a shoe that will fit. I tried several different sizes I usually wear a 10M but every character shoes was too tight and not comfortable. These are great gives enough room without slipping on the heal.

title: Horrible horrible horrible.
text: Horrible horrible horrible in every category. Did I mention they are horrible? well they are .

title: Classic, comfy, lightweight
text: Simple, classic and lightweight. I needed to pack a dress and shoes suitable for a wedding. Since I do carry-on only, the shoes needed to be lightweight and fit into a backpack along with all else for a two-week trip. Perfect!

title: (Size .5-1 sz up) I wish I purchased these 10 years ago!!!
text: I've been doing Zumba workouts weekly for 12 years now. I always went for regular trainers with pivots on the bottom because they were more stylish than these basic black (and kinda chunky) Capezios. The Zumba brand was good for several years, but I don't like the high top styles that they've been selling exclusively for the past few years. As soon as I put on these Capezios I knew that I should have been wearing these all along. Dancing is SO much easier!!! Also, the only sneak I could find with a pivot now is Ryka, and they really really suck even worse than they sucked 10 years ago. The sole started coming off within 4 wears. Disgusting. Don't throw your money down the drain, get these even if it means you need to buy another pair of sneakers for other athletic activites; it is worth it. You will be thrilled you did. Sizing: I am usually a 7.5 sneaker. After reading reviews I got an 8.5 and they fit perfectly. Maybe a little extra room in the toe box than I need but it has not been bothersome at all.

title: Great Shoe, but left black Marks
text: These shoes were great. I would say they ran small. So order up a size (maybe size and a half) BUT ... the biggest issue we had is that they left black skid marks EVERYWHERE across the wood floor. It was a real bummer, because they are very light weight- nice shoe. We had to obviously send them back. No one else has complained about that here, so not sure if it was just that pair or not.

title: Ordered 1.5 sizes larger than street size
text: These shoes last 3+ years. My daughter's are still going strong after 3+ years but are getting a small hole under the sole. Well worth the money. Nice feel to the arch in this shoe.

title: Not the same
text: I bought these years ago but I'm guessing they are now made by a different factory as they are tighter and not as comfortable. I've worn them a few times now, still tight and not that comfortable. A size up might have been better but like I said, I had a pair previously. They are good for hip hop and line dancing.

title: Narrow around the toes....
text: These are very nice dance shoes for my line dancing. They are very narrow , I am hoping they will stretch a little.

title: Good Dance Sneaker
text: The sizing in the product description--order a size to a size and a half larger than your street shoe was good. I am happy with a size up, but next time, I might go a size and a half, since I'm using them as street shoes... The width is maybe a tad narrower than average, but adjusts with the laces.

title: If you have wide feet, they are too tight
text: I love the shoes, but they are too tight near the beginning of the toes. If I order a larger size, I worry about them being too large. I like these shoes, and wish they had a wide.

title: Nice shoes but very wrong fit.
text: I have a long, narrow foot and usually wear a 11 12. Unfortunately the Capezio seemed to run a tad short but looks like i would have been a nice shoe for the price if it had fit.

title: NOT slip-on
text: I thought I'd looked carefully at the photos. Ordered them because wanted slip-ons that would be easy to remove. Not what I expected.

title: Dance shoes
text: I sent these back. Did not find them comfortable for zumba and felt like I would slip in them.

title: Old standby - love these dance sneakers
text: I have been wearing Capizio dance sneakers for years. I order a full size larger and they fit well. I use them for Zumba.

title: the shoe was fine but the fit was wrong
text: In appearance, the shoe was fine but the fit was wrong. I normally wear an 8M with not too wide a foot. I ordered a 9M which was too narrow and short and hurt my foot when i put it on. I sent the shoes back.

title: Four Stars
text: I read the other reviews and I ordered a size up accordingly, these fit properly.

title: Hurt my feet and not attractive
text: The toe is rather square and these were not comfortable at all. I had to return them. They really are not that attractive either, sorry to say...

title: These were purchased for my daughter. She performs Irish ...
text: These were purchased for my daughter. She performs Irish step dance and has a minor injury from over use in her hard shoes. These shoes allow her to create each individual sound in practice but with the reduced impact because of the cushioning, allowing her to heal her heel and still continue to practice. She knew what size to get because she had borrowed the shoes from another dancer.

title: snug
text: I took the advice of others and ordered a half size larger than my normal size. I'm a 6, but got the 6.5. My first thought was that they are bit snug. I had no way of knowing if the 7 would have been perfect, or too big. I kept them & still feel that they are too snug. I am sorry that I did not exchange them for a 7, but who would think that a person who wears size 6 all the time would need a 7!!!!

title: Perfect for cardio gym classes with great heel support and a flexible sole.
text: I would give these shoes 10 stars if I could! I take Zumba, Cardio Tai box and other classes at the gym, plus use weight machines. My regular cross trainers or running shoes were not working well because I didn't feel the best heel support and they often stuck to the gym floor. These solved both of those problems with plenty of heel support, a nice flexible split sole for dancing and kicks and easily glide on the floor without being too slippery. I used to come home and have a sore heel later in the day after an hour long class, but not anymore. I have been telling everyone how much I love these shoes!

title: Shoes not true to size
text: After reading the reviews I decided to order my Capezio shoes a size larger. I tried them on and they were still snug. I decided to wear them to my dance class to see if they stretched out a bit. They did and they now feel more comfortable.

title: Order 1-2 Sizes Larger!
text: These are good shoes. They seem very cushiony and supportive. I need them for Zumba. Usually I wear a size 6 in street shoes so I originally ordered a size 7. They were too small so I exchanged them for a size 7.5. Bad news, the size 7.5 were still too small since my big toes were still hitting the front end. I ended up ordering a size 8! Depending on your feet, you may even have to go 2 sizes larger like me. Finding the right size is trial and error. If there a dance store near you, I recommend you try them on at the store to find your right size. (This review was written by Mr. Pepper's wife)

title: Poor design
text: Terrible fit / design. These shoes didn't allow me to use the full range of motion in my foot - these fit more like actual sneakers than dance shoes. I returned and bought shoes from a more expensive competitor and I'm very happy now.

title: Good high arch support
text: These shoes are a replacement for some less expensive dance shoes I've worn for a year of line dancing lessons. I like the support they provide and after a few dance sessions they seems to be breaking in well. My only concern is that they are not as slick as my old shoes, and hope my knees will tolerate a stickier shoe. I wish they had the suede patch on the ball of the foot area to help with spins. They definitely run small. I wear 7 1/2 and tried the 8 but it was too small. The 8 1/2 fits well.

title: Size
text: I bought these for my wife and got 8.5, which is larger than her normal fit of 7.5 to 8. They seem about right. She likes them a lot for her zumba class. A key point to note when ordering this type of shoe is the lacing since it needs to be kept tight.

title: She loves them!
text: They do run small and if you don't read the other reviews and order bigger you will be disappointed. Maybe even go up another size even, She says they are a tight fit but they are still new and need to break in, But you don't want a loose dance shoe either!

title: Have fun and dance
text: This shoe ran a half size bigger my shoe size is an 8 I took an 81/2 my foot is a size 71/2 I love this shoe

title: Super exercise dance shoe
text: Love the shoe. Fits well, great support and I can flex my arch too. I did buy this one size larger as recommended by the reviewers, I wear a size 6 and ordered a 7. Super for Zumba.

title: Slide and glide
text: I use these shoes for Zumba and love them! They glide beautifully saving your feet, ankles, and knees. The only down fall is that it can be difficult to squat and lunge in since they do have a smooth sole. They also aren't ideal for wife feet

title: Nice shoes
text: I have a knee that hurt a little when doing Zumba. This gave more flexibility so no more pain! Highly recommend,

title: Size run small, buy larger
text: The shies run small had to purchase two size larger yo fit. Great for zuma and line dancing. Very light and provides needed support.

title: Not what I expected
text: I'm very new to Zumba, and needed the proper shoe before beginning my DVD workout on a berber-ish type carpeted area. After searching, I ordered this item in white; my street/dress shoe size is normally 8 1/2 W, depending on the style. After reading other reviews, I ordered this item in 10M. When I rece'd this, it pinched my feet, didn't feel comfortable & looked thick around the yoke/neck of the shoe (think corrective shoes); so, to compare, I ordered the DS24 Rockit Dansneaker to see how they differed. I sent the DS11 Fierce Dansneaker back, as the DS24 Rockit (in a 9 1/2) not only fit/felt, but looked better. As other reviewers noted, Zumba shoe laces need to be snug, but not require a "breaking in" period. Hope this review helped, its a nice shoe, but didn't work out for me.

title: The Absolute BEST
text: As a former dancer I loved to use these when teaching. Really saved your feet from wearing high heel shoes all the time. They provide excellent flexibility and you can wear them all day with comfort. I was a teacher for several years after leaving the competition floor. Now I have ordered them again to use in a job that keeps me on my feet for 4 hours at a time on hard floors. I needed black shoes and recalled how well these worked for me in the dance years. I love them! I would not recommend them for a hike in the woods etc. as they are flexible and soft in the arch, wouldn't want to step on a rock. :) I am happy I remembered these great shoes for this new job.. Thanks Capezio!

title: Capezio Women's Daily Ballet Shoe, Black, 7.5 M US...
text: Nice ballet slippers for comfortable use around the house and for dancing...They run a bit wide, and are a bit hard to adjust to foot width, but that could just be me...After a few wearings I DID notice a leathery smell, so I stopped wearing them, as stinky feet are NOT on my lits fo FAVORITE things!

title: Just what I needed
text: I bought these for 1860's dancing. They work well and my feet look like they should under the hoop skirt. There is just enough grip in the leather soles that I don't go sliding over the floor, either!

title: Great value for the price.
text: Fits my daughter well. I didn't have to go to the dance store, nor did I have to sew on the elastic!

title: Ordered 1 size bigger But these are small and Wide
text: My normal size is 9 and sometimes a 9 1/2 I have a narrow foot, so I ordered 10 N. I am not a Dancer, I want these to keep stickers off my feet in the yard at home. My toe rubs the end of the shoe, which may be what a dancer wants. But the shoe gaps open along the sides. When I pull the elastic bow, the shoe tightens up, but it also pulls the shoe shorter! So I guess if I had a size 13 N, I could make it work! So disappointing! If companies insist on making shoes run small, they need to at least offer larger sizes - - maybe even size 15????

title: Runs a little small.
text: Just as described. I wear a size 71/2 and I ordered a size 8. I would definitely go up to a size 8 1/2. They run a little small. Good quality.

title: NICE BALLET FLAT
text: I ORDERED UP A HALF SIZE LIKE I NORMALLY WOULD WITH A FLAT. THANKS TO OTHER REVIEWS, I DID NOT GET THE WIDE. I HAVE A WIDE FOOT, BUT THE MEDIUM WAS FINE. THEY ARE JUST AS I REMEMBERED WHEN I TOOK BALLET A CENTURY AGO. I PLAN TO WEAR THEM AS A HOUSE SHOE AND WHEN RUNNING QUICK ERRANDS. THE LEATHER IS THIN BUT THAT MADE THEM EASIER TO ADJUST. NICE FOR THE PRICE.

title: Cheaply made
text: Look like you've dance a million shows after a few days in class as a 3 year old...

title: Good quality for the price.
text: I knew what size to buy because my daughter wore holes in her last pair (not allowed to continue wearing hole-ly shoesin class) so I just reordered a half size bigger. She wears a 2.5 in street shoes, and the 4.5 has a little growing room. Nice to have the elastics sewn on already.

title: GET THEM LONGER!
text: I received my 9.5 N ballet shoes today. Before ordering, I measured my foot from tip of big toe to end of heel. Using that number, I decided to go a half size larger "just in case" some of the people who warned "too small" were talking about my kind of foot. Well, the shoes are even too small at half a size larger!! I always buy athletic shoes one whole size longer. If I buy these again, I will do that---so if you wear a 9, get a 10! The ballet shoes have the curved toe, and that design makes the big toe land on one of the short curved sides...well, mine anyway. Also, I have a very narrow heel, and they are too big in the heel...so too short and too wide a heel if you need a narrow size. However, I will keep them and maybe order a size 10N. Do measure your foot standing on a tape measurer, and to whatever size it says to get in the measurement instructions add one full size. I want to kick myself! : kkp

title: Tight through the ball of my foot.
text: These usually fit fine but this pair is really tight through the balls of my feet, right before my toes.

title: Too small on the toe box and all around a bad fit

title: Wearing Ballet Slippers as House Shoes
text: She loves the look and the softness of a quality ballet slipper around the house.

title: too tight

title: inexpensive ballet slippers
text: I purchased these ballet slippers as an every day shoe for around the house. I'm a runner and I want to strengthen my feet. These are the perfect solution! They are the perfect "barefoot" shoe.

title: Lovely Shoe

It's flexible, with a soft sole, and the strap on top and fits perfectly. It's a little wide but the ties can be tightened. I wear them around the house and they've held up great. Quality seems fine. Nothing loose or tearing.

title: Ballet shoes
text: Excellent leather slippers.From Amazon. Easy to wear and comfortable to dance in. You must try them. I gave them excellent reviews.

title: They run a half size smaller then street shoes
text: Love these Ballet shoes. They are a half size bigger then her steet shoes that are under armor. My daughter wears size 5 in street shoes and wears size 5.5 in ballet shoes

title: Pretty Accurate Fit
text: I wanted the black, but only pink was available in my size. The pink shoes are made of a softer, more pliable, leather than the black slippers; those ordering black might want to order a half size larger. If I were using these slippers for ballet, I would order a half size smaller. However, I found that ballet slippers are perfect for exercising on the Nordic Track and welcomed the looser fit. All in all, I have found the current sizing to be more accurate than Capezio slipper sizing in the past, I also appreciate the slippers coming with the elastic already sewn on.

title: Great Ballet Shoe
text: This is about the 6th pair of this style Capezio Ballet shoe I've bought in the past 4 years of dance. They are perfect for my 8 year old granddaughter and are easy to pull in the ties for the shoe to fit right. Would recommend this shoe for all young ballet students.

title: Bad quality ballet shoes
text: The soles peeled off basically one or two classes after I bought them. They are tight in the wrong places and are uncomfortable to wear in general. The toe area is especially uncomfortable and often hurts my nails.

title: I have bought ballet shoes from Capezio before for my granddaughter and she has never been disappointed in them
text: I bought these for my granddaughter who takes ballet classes. She loves them. I have bought ballet shoes from Capezio before for my granddaughter and she has never been disappointed in them. They fit true to size and she finds them very comfortable. I will buy ballet shoes from them again.

title: Great quality shoe
text: Our is experience has always been to order one size up on ballet shoes. My daughter wears a size 4 and we ordered size 5 and they fit perfect.

title: Effective - both practical and cost wise!
text: My daughter, for whatever reason, is rough on her shoes for dance - so, these were very effective from both a cost point of view and comfort / practicality. They run a little small to true size, at least that was our experience, but, my daughter likes them and says they are very comfortable to her, so I am happy with that. I will definitely purchase again if needed.

title: tight in the toe, regarless of size

title: Two Stars

title: These fit in your regular shoe size
text: I've been doing ballet-style workout DVDs at home lately, and wanted a pair of ballet shoes to use for those workouts so that I'd have better grip and support. I can't speak to how well these work for ballet classes, but I thought that my review might help others like me who are buying these for the same reason. Based on some reviews, I ended up ordering these at first one size larger than what I usually wear in my street shoes. The 8.5 that I bought (instead of my usual 7.5) were huge, but (thanks, Amazon, for your great return policy), I returned these and ordered a 7.5, which fit perfectly. The ribbon at the front of the shoe can be pulled tight to adjust the width of them, and they are very comfortable. They don't have a split sole on the bottom; instead, the sole is one long piece that stretches down the length of the shoe. If you're looking for some at-home ballet-style workouts, I also recommend Mary Helen Bowers' [[ASIN:B008F283J0 Ballet Beautiful: Total Body Workout]] and [[ASIN:B009FFHWRU Ballet Beautiful: Body Blast]] and Leah Sarago's four workouts, especially her newest one [[ASIN:B00AHP15L6 Ballet Body Signature Series: Total Body]]. All of these are a lot of fun to d

title: These work fine
text: After reading many reviews I ordered up a half size. My street shoe size is 7.5B and I bought these in an 8M. I pulled the strings as tight as I could and wore them with socks. My teacher at first said she would normally order down, not up but decided the 8 is fine for my feet and I wore them to class this week, no problem.

title: Too big
text: I ordered my normal size and they were too big so I returned them. If you can figure out the right size, they're a good deal, but I think I'd need to repurchase them in-store to try them on.

title: Cute Beginner's Shoe
text: These shoes are great for beginner dancers, the full sole, the more economic leather - it smells GREAT though, the thing I love most about this pair. I do realize that Capezio's other ballet slipper, Teknik, is of similar leather but has a softer and thicker bottom sole and better internal lining. I suppose the Teknik is a one up for a more serious dancer. I wear a size 7 street size and have tried 8 but it is too wide and long. The elastic is way too loose. So I am returning those and going down to a 7.5 (7 was too small). I thought we were supposed to go up way more than 0.5 size but...I guess that's just the way it works for me! They fit and feel much like my various New Balance shoes (Dunham is a New Balance brand). One thing about Dunham and New Balance is that the sizing is almost always consistent across the brands and different models, so once you're set on a certain size/width, you're set. I returned some Timberland boots because they were too narrow and just not that comfortable - a little tight. These are the opposite - massively roomy toe box and roomy, spacious interior from toes to heel. I really like that about them. My sense is that, overall quality wise, these are a cut or two above other similar boots at this approximate price point, making them a good (though not inexpensive) deal. No boots are ever as comfortable as shoes, but these come reasonably close.

I wear a size 14-wide US and they seem to fit just a tad large when compared to my other 14 wide shoes/boots etc. I believe a 13 and a half would have been the perfect fit for me; the size 14 will work just fine with some thicker hiking socks. Great traction, great support (for a flat footed person), they're lite on the foot and I'm very happy so far. I look forward to challenging hiking in these. I have not done so yet, and these seem like they might favor on-rail and moderate terrain, since they don't have a significant shank for stability and for fending off big pointy rocks underfoot. Still, I expect these will become my primary SUV footwear for most uses. They are so comfortable and the traction is so good, I'll probably look past any technical shortcomings and use them for more demanding hikes just the same. The rubber toe rand is a nice touch. title: Worst boat shoes I've ever worn
text: I started wearing this type of boat shoes back in the mid-1970s, and have worn them ever since. This is the 3rd pair of Dockers boat shoes, and it will be the last pair of Dockers shoes I will ever buy. I was very pleased that these shoes fit as expected, and that perhaps I'd found a nice shoe at a good price. Boy, was I wrong! When I first put them on, I noticed that the laces were much thinner than I had on my most recent pair of Docker boat shoes. In fact, the laces on one of the shoes broke on the first day. No problem, I thought, I picked up a new leather lace at the cobbler that afternoon. Unfortunately, I found that after wearing them for a couple of hours, my feet hurt. I didn't expect much arch support from boat shoes, but these shoes had NONE. Several hours later, the shoe liners came loose, with one continually folding back on my foot and the other coming out of the shoe completely. I tried gluing the liners back in, but they kept coming loose. Finally, after 3-4 days, I decided the shoes were not worth the effort or discomfort, so I returned them to Amazon, vowing that I'd never buy Docker shoes again.

The soles are soft and wear quickly, you get about a year out of them. The design of the toe box also creates rigid folds when walking. The corner of one of these folds always pressed against the base of my big toe. Eventually, I formed a calcium deposit on my right foot and could no longer wear them.

title: I keep buying these...
text: This is my fifth pair of these shoes. Dockers has been making them for several years and they are a good all purpose waterproof work casual shoe. The uppers are durable and a change made (in pair 3, I think) to the inside of the shoes has made them both more comfortable and long lasting. The only reasons these don't get a 5 star rating are the shoe laces, which neither stay tied nor last, and the soles, which have very shallow lugs that wear away relatively quickly compared to the uppers. The upper leather grain varies from pair to pair from almost smooth to "football" pebbling--that all look pretty good. For the money, these are a good value and do the job.

At the end of that time the leather is still in perfect condition and well connected to the sole. However, the foam the sole is made out of does not last particularly well. It wears down quite quickly and pretty soon is thin. You start feeling the bumps on the ground beneath you. Finally it breaks through. Recommendation: If these are going to be used for Dress shoes only, they are fine. If you want shoes to actually walk in, these will let you down after a few months.

Alegria advertises "one shoe 2 widths." You can get them free when you buy a pair of Alegria shoes on their website. Otherwise, they charge $24.95 for wide width insoles. Shoe Buy charges $20. I love all my Alegria, and they are all I wear. I have problem feet (high arches, slightly wide feet), and Alegria shoes are perfect for me. I just hope they never stop making the Paloma style; it's my favorite, and I have several pairs. I must say thanks to a reviewer on Amazon that told about the wide width insole option, albeit her message was a bit foggy, If you buy your shoes directly from Alegria (and they are having a fantastic sale right now), you get the option of a wide width insole FREE. The insoles are thinner and afford more room in the toe box. Remember, "Alegria makes one shoe with two widths!"

title: comfortable, fun shoes!
text: I have plantar fasciitis. Too many years working on my feet 12-hours a night! I've worn dansko/ sanita shoes for years, but I've been having problems even with those lately and decided to try something different. These are great. The Alegrias fit more closely than the dansko; I've yet to run to a code and accidentally run out of my shoes! They aren't quite as high as the danskos, and they have a wider base. Again, a little more stable. Like the dansko/ sanitas they have what I believe is called a "Rocker bottom"; the design of the sole is meant to sort of propel you forward. The sole is more cushioned than my danskos, and it has a removable innersole. You can use your own orthotic, which is a much-appreciated feature for those of use who need them. As this was my first pair I ordered my size in a sale pattern. They're red patent leather with little owls. Really fun! I get a ton of comments on the pattern from patients and coworkers. The shoes are just so cheerful! I've found the alegria paloma to be very supportive. I can wear them all shift without my feet hurting; what more can you say?

The "wide" shoes are actually just a slightly thinner insole - the shoe is exactly the same. Even their website suggests trying the "wide" insole, if you are between sizes. I like to wear mine without socks, and find them very comfortable. I can easily stand for hours in them. And bonus, I think they are super cute with all of the different patterns/designs/colors they offer. Yes, they are a little boxy looking, but that's actually pretty much the shape of my foot, so I'm OK with my toes having plenty of room to just be themselves. Would buy again (and have!)

text: This style of shoe is excellent if you have plantar fascitis! The arch and heel support is heavenly. The price was a huge savings as well.

title: Mephisto Sandal Size
text: They are a little larger than the size 38 that I wanted, but they actually fit better. I love the sandal.

title: These sandals are fabulous but small-boned gals need to go down a size perhaps
text: Please note that I wear a size 7 medium shoe normally, but with Mephisto sandals, I always go down to a size 6 to have them fit well, get the arch in the right spot, and not be clunky and long. This particular sandal was made for me! I have worn it for at least 12 years and am delighted that it is available in fashionable patent leather. So, I indicated that they run somewhat large and wide, but in one size smaller, I love them. I have a small bone frame and slender, weak ankles. If you have a thicker foot and ankle, do not follow my sizing guidelines. Thanks.

text: Mephisto is by far the best brand of sandals I've ever had. I love the Helen, have purchased this style in the past, and love it. But...I would love for Mephisto to make available the Violette in black waxy in my size. Please, Mephisto!!!

text: These sandals are SO comfortable. I wear size 8 and they fit perfectly! I would highly recommend them! I would buy another pair!

title: Best comfort sandal anywhere
text: I have wide feet and wear orthotics in all other shoes. These mold to my feet and are the only sandals I wear. Can't weather Birkies because of the toe hold, these don't have that feature. Just a soft, smooth fit.

title: Made cheaper than they used to be.
text: Made cheaper than they used to be. Not the old Mephistos. The leather is much thinner, and not dark all the way through like my old ones in the same color and texture. I am very disappointed and I sent them back. They didn’t fit the same either through the straps. They were to lose.

title: worth the $$..hopefully!
text: My friend turned me onto these sandals, so I took a chance and ordered them. Sports and bad luck have left me with bad knees and ankles (I am barely in my 30s!)and I have gotten to the point where my beloved Rainbows kill me. I used to have a pair of Birkenstocks, but these seem much more comfortable. I hate spending this much $ on sandals, but then again if I wear them all of the time and they save my joints, then it's worth it. I am wearing them right now and can tell that, out of the box, I could wear them all day without suffering from a "break in" period. I am a 7.5 with a pretty normal width (maybe on the wider side of average). I typically order a size 7 when shoes don't come in half sizes and the size 8 is what I stuck with. I ordered both sizes, because there are mixed reviews as to whether they run average or small. The width is practically the same, but the leather strap is a little shorter on the 7. In the end, I went with the 8 because I felt like the 7 was a 1/2 size small (the 7 felt like a 7, and I am a 7.5). The quality is great - I hope they last!

title: Super Comfy and CUTE!

title: SKECHERS....WHAT'S NOT TO LIKE
text: I've been a big fan of Skechers for about 6 years now. I had surgery back then and asked my nurse what shoes she was wearing. She replied all the nurses wore Skechers, they were the only shoe they found that were comfortable all day. I decided then to try them since I've always found most shoes uncomfortable and I've been hooked since. These particular shoes are nice looking and just as comfortable as every pair of Skechers I've purchased. Do they last as long as a "name" brand sneaker? Nope, but I don't care since they are 1/2 the price of what I would spend for the others. All I care about is having a shoe that I can wear all day long without my feet aching and Skechers never fail.

title: Super comfortable!
text: Very comfortable! I still have to use my SuperFeet inserts, but I'm quite satisfied with my shoes.

text: Bought sketchers in other models ("Afterburn"), they fit fine but this one ("Stamina Nuovo") was way too small.

They're really loose and bulky looking over the toe area. I'm not comfortable with the look or feel. I tried to get used to them and broke them in pretty good with a couple long walks or I would have returned them.

Ordered on amazon December2 2021 I have not been able to super glue rubber back on soles I would be lucky if I get 4 more weeks out of them. Not sure if I am allowed to send them back and get a more durable pair. Please let me know if you recommend any good trainers which may help

title: A shoe with a comfortable sole.
text: I knew before I ordered the size I would need. I ordinarily wear a 9 medium shoe, but in these shoes I order a 10.5, so I think you would want to order at least one size or one and a half size larger for these shoes. I have four pairs now that I rotate to keep them from getting smelly. Two pairs I bought in our local shoe store. They are both white. And the soles are so comfortable on my feet. Not all Skechers have this sole. It has a softness to it making walking comfortable for me. The stamina nuovos are the only ones I have found thus far that have this soft sole. I have polio legs and feet, and now this type of shoe is the only ones that I find pleasant to wear. I purchased two pairs of the charcoal/black on line as the store had only white. All four pairs are identical in the way they feel on my feet. I can't tell I'm wearing a different pair each day. I just cant wear a regular shoe anymore. If you have tender feet, I think you will like the Skechers Stamina Nuovo sneaker.

title: Perfect fit for a guy with wide feet and high arch

Ordering online is also challenging, but this time, the fit was perfect. Cannot believe it, but he loves these shoes! Will buy Skechers again and again.

title: Amazon Sending Out WIde as Extra Wide
text: These shoes would have been perfect for me. I have a very flat foot so I need an extra-wide shoe. Unfortunately none of the shoes I really like make extra-wide but Sketchers does. I ordered and sent back 2 pairs of these shoes because Amazon sent out Wide instead of extra-wide. Even the sticker on the box said they were wide. I have no idea whom to contact but maybe someone from Amazon will see this and correct the problem. Returns were a breeze as normal and customer service was great.

title: Sketchers best

title: Strange Smell and Quacks
text: I would not recommend this product. It’s like maybe they put waaaay too much “new shoe” smell in them, and thee weeks later they smell strange. Enough to where you and other people will notice periodically throughout the day. There are a couple of other issues, too. When walking on wet floors they quack really loudly. I thought that might improve over time as the bottom gets broken in, but no improvement so far. Also, some of the threading on the front is already coming undone (on the rubber part at the very front of the shoe). For now it just looks bad, but it may break down soon. Basically, I have to get rid of these and buy new shoes after 3 weeks.

title: Made well

title: Best shoes for my giant
text: Only go to shoe that my husband loves to wear. He is hard on shoes & truthfully if they can hold up to my giant than they are good quality. Glad he no longer has to struggle with finding comfort in a shoe & he can pretty well order online & know they will be true to size.

title: Great

title: Walking on clouds
text: I love my Skechers. It feels as if I'm walking on clouds. Amazon had the price I was looking for. They arrived on time. They met my expectations. Thank you.

title: Super comfortable!
text: My husband LOVES these sneakers! He says they are the most comfortable shoes he has ever worn. I bought him two pairs, one for street wear and one for the gym.

title: Comfy - even for high instep
text: I have a high instep and I typically cannot wear Keens (I've tried many styles with no joy) because they're way too tight at the top of my foot, but for some reason, this particular style works for me and my high instep. I'm glad I tried them. They are super comfortable and my go-to shoe. Good sized toe-box so my toes can move. My only issue is the fabric attracts things like leaves and debris, so if you're working in the yard or chopping wood, you may have some debris stuck to your shoes that you'll have to pick off.

title: Keen Howser
text: This is a great shoe by Keen. Not as comfortable as my other Keen shoes, but they are nice. Great for around the house, and even those early morning grocery runs, and grabing the newspaper. They are very warm and soft on the inside. This shoes seems like it will last for years. The fit seems true to size. They do take a minute to get on, not a slip on shoe. However, they stay on your feet and dont come off. I would recommend these to anyone looking for a great shoe around the house and even out of the house on occasion. The only reason not to wear these out of the house much is that if wet, they seem to stay that way for a bit. Overall, a great shoe that will last for years.

title: Can't get them on
text: If you work all day, the last thing you want is to struggle with putting on your slippers when you get home. These have such a small opening that you have to sit down and use both hands to get them on your feet. Once on they are super soft, warm and comfy, but slippers should be easier than this.

title: I have wanted these for a long time
text: I wanted these shoes for a long time but couldn't see spending $70 on them. @ $34 I went for it. They are so comfy....my boyfriend makes fun because I want to wear them everywhere. True to my keen size in other keen products I own. Love them!

title: very comfortable!
text: I like these b/c you can wear them around the house and they are also good outside. I took these to Tahoe and they kept my feet warm as well as protected when I had to take my dog out to potty! they seem durable.

text: These outdoor slippers are comfy and warm, like wearing waterproof house-shoes. My only complaint is that it gets a little tight across the top of my foot as I wear them throughout the day. I have high arches and I suspect my feet swell and makes the shoe feel a little tighter. I didn't notice it when I wore slightly thinner socks, so that could be the issue. I love these winter shoes!

title: Great slipper/shoe
text: As some commented, they are snug to get on around the ankle area. But once they are broke in, they are the typical awesome KEEN that you know. They have a nice arch support and are warm. Love them.

title: Stylish & Comfortable
text: This are such wonderful slippers, Keen is my favorite shoe brand and what's not to like about a slipper you can wear outside, keeps your feet warm and looks stylish while being comfortable!

title: I love these slippers - I've spent hundreds of dollars on ...
text: So comphy, I love these slippers - I've spent hundreds of dollars on cheap slippers and finally decided to get smart and buy a pair of Keen's as I love, love, love all my other Keen shoes and I'm so glad I did! They are so comfortable and cozy; plus if you need to go outside - no problem! Make the investment - you'll be glad you did - at least I am!

title: I am Not Happy with These
text: I am not happy with these but they are not a bad shoe. Yes, they are a shoe more than a slipper. House shoe maybe, but you could certainly wear them outside, only the upper is not very durable or weather resistant for outdoor use. I normally wear a 7 or 7 1/2. Since I intended to wear these with thick wool socks, and everyone says to order up, I ordered an 8. They are hard to get on but then when they are on, my foot is loose and as I walk around, they slip around my heel. If I went walking in them I'm sure I'd get a blister. So even if they loosen up so they go on more easily, once on they'll still be too big. The wool upper picks up lint and dog hair. I really like both the outsole and the insole, which is very cushy and removable. The insole is not fleece but the rest of the inside of the shoe is.

title: love these slippers
text: all keens are comfortable and these slippers are no exception. i'm an 8.5 and that's what i purchased. they fit perfectly. they are very warm and i like to wear them bare foot, which can lead to stinky slippers. I have washed them a couple of times and they turned out great. i don't really know if you are supposed to wash them, but i did. i removed the insoles and washed those in a garment bag. other reviews mention that they can be a little tough to get on because the opening is a little snug. this has been the case for me too, but that doesn't bother me. they aren't a slipper that slips on and off easily. but i sort of like that. i put them on after work and wear them all evening. because of the hard sole you can step outside to take the dogs out or get the mail. on the weekends i even run errands in them and no one knows i have slippers on because they just look like cute keens.

title: Great price!
text: I usually don't shop for slippers on line but I really like the way these feel, comfortable and well made. I was looking for something to walk around the house and also to step outside once in a while and these are perfect for it.

title: Awesome Keen Slippers.
text: I probably own 15 or more pairs of Keens of all kinds. These are great and love the rough grip on the bottom so I won't slip.

title: Check color!
text: I had to return them. Color was misrepresented. Did you know monochrome is actually coal black? Good slippers just not the right color for me.

title: VERY comfortable!
text: VERY comfortable, and true to size -- no "break-in" period. I can wear thin- to medium-weight socks with them, or no socks at all, and they're comfortable. I will live in these all fall/winter, so worth the money. My feet will have support AND comfort!

title: I like them
text: I read a lot of negative reviews on these slippers, but I decided to get them anyway because I wanted something I could wear outside when it is cold.. I know that people have said that they are hard to get on and that the whole is to small, but it does get easier every time you put them on. The first time I put them on it was a little hard, but I just stood up and twisted my foot in them. It wasn't bad. The second time it was easier. I am sure it will get easier every time I put them on. I think that they are really cute and warm. I'm not sure I would want them for in the house because the sole is more for outside, (not as soft) but they are perfect for being outdoors. The madder brown looks more like mulberry to me, but they are cute. I wouldn't get this color if you want brown. The size runs pretty good. I can wear between a 5 1/2 to a 6 in women's shoes and I got a 5 1/2 and it fits me good. It just depends on the different brands for me.

title: I really like these slippers
text: I really like these slippers. They have a good sturdy sole so I have actually used them outside taking a walk! The Keen brand fits me perfectly . I have their hiking boots and the arch is very supportive with a good fit. I was happy to see these slippers are the same.

title: Heaven for my feet

title: WARM

title: Very comfortable and Keen quality

These are my indoor shoes for my hardwood floors, which are much easier on my feet vs. socks or other less durable slippers. Keeps feet warm (I always wear footies with mine). I would recommend ordering a half size up from your normal size, as I would never have done that had I not read the other reviews, and that tip was spot on for me.

title: Comfort plus

I didn't expect that with the fabric and plush inside but I'll just wear them every now and then for now till they get broken in so I don't get blisters. Aside from that they are the bomb!!!

title: Extremely comfortable

title: PERFECT for all hiking and beach wear

title: Love these, but, they can be hot on your feet.
text: Only downside to these sandals is that my feet tend to get hot when the weather is warm. Otherwise they are VERY comfortable and provide excellent arch support and I can wear them for long periods of time.

title: Very comfortable! Tried them out for an afternoon to get ...
text: Very comfortable! Tried them out for an afternoon to get use to them. They were so comfortable I walked around all day with them. Also bought the Whisper Sandal and like them equally well. Looking forward to using them on an upcoming trip where I will be hiking in woods as well as on city streets. Highly recommend these especially if you have wide feet and normally have issues finding sandals that fit. The adjusting cords make it even easier to customize the fit. Awesome sandals!

title: Order up a half size
text: I love these Keen Newports and the color, beet red (a burgundy shade) is so beautiful. I bought these in a diff color 2 years ago in my normal size - 9 and the heel strap cut in a bit, but the 9.5 is perfect. I recommend ordering up a half size. So well constructed and comfy!

title: Who knew?
text: My husband and a friend each have a pair. I sort of made fun of them a little with their "cool" shoes. We had a trip planned that would involve some hiking, and some waterfalls. I was able to use points from my credit card (linked with Amazon) and got an additional bonus for using the points, so was able to get a pair for almost half price. I shouldn't have waited so long. They're super comfortable and sturdy. I wouldn't wear them for a very long hike, but the few shorter ones (up to 1.5 miles) even on steep rocky terrain were perfect! They're also great for running errands. They don't have to be just for hiking or kayaking. I have shorter, slightly bent little toes, and they hit one of the open spots a little weird. I thought I might have issues with them rubbing, but nope. Really great shoes that will be worn for years to come!

title: Keen's Forever
text: What can I say? I love my Keens. This is my third pair. I wore the first two out. They are comfortable, rugged, good in water, washable and CUTE. Can't live without them. The toe cap is great for protection and the thick soles can go anywhere. Mine have. Zip lining in the poring rain in Costa Rica, climbing up seep rocks in the western states, gardening, shopping. These are my every where every day shoes.

title: Good fit… Not great color for me.
text: This rainbow color is very comfortable. The only reason I tried it is because my foot is hard to fit in many shoes… I could not get used to the color! Many people choose this shoe for the color but I only tried it for the fit… Which I liked.

title: YAY!

title: Love KEEN!

Thankfully I have broken them in a bit but there is still no room to spare... they fit like a glove. Buyer beware. Other than this.. I love the retro tie dye & expect to enjoy them for years.

title: Love love love

They look cute with shorts or a casual summer dress. I especially liked how comfortable they were, and it was a nice bonus that they’re so cute!!

title: adorable, comfy shoe
text: I normally wear a size 8 - 8.5. I ordered a size 9 after trying these on in a store. Size 9 fit perfectly. Other than that, adorable, comfy shoe. I love sandals or flip flops, but need arch support for Plantar Fascitis. These are great for that. Love them.

title: Great sandals, I just have feet that are too wide.

The color combination is okay (I suspect Keen adds pink or coral to some of its styles to give the impression that it is a "lady's" shoe). I returned this style, but ordered another more lightweight Keen sandal because, as I said, I love Keen.

If I had to complain about anything at the moment I would have to say that the heel strap and arch support did take some getting used to. text: Inferior to my past favorite, the Gel-Nimbus 15; before that it was the Gel-Nimbus 12. After a month, the footbed no longer felt well cushioned in base of the heel and the ball of foot. Perhaps it wore down, although I only run 3-4 miles per session, 4-5 times per week. There is a lot of cushioning in the side of the shoe cupping the heel and in the shoe tongue (doesn't help me!). I find the footbed to be very ridged without much flex. I am prone to supination (=under-pronation) when I run, and running in these shoes really irritated my IT band. I hate them. I should have returned them to Amazon in the 30 day return period. I use them now for just going out on errands and they still bother me, especially in my heels. Hoping the Nimbus 18's will be better or I may try the Asics Gel Kayano 22 next time as some have suggested. Update July 2016 - I bought the Gel Nimbus 18 and it was no better in the footbed cushion than the Gel-Nimbus 17. The main difference is that the toebox is wider in the 18's. I then purchased the Asics Gel Kayano 22 and they are feeling great and I am keeping them great arch support , more flex in the footbed and great heel cushioning.

She feels surefooted in the New Balance shoes and loves to walk around to stretch her legs. The 6 wide (C/D) size leaves enough room for her bunions while still supporting the rest of her tiny feet. This is the second pair of these shoes I have bought her, and I’m grateful this style still available on Amazon to help protect Mom.
