title: Sooo cute! But my poor pinky toe can't handle them!
text: These are my first ever Crocs and I purchased them a week ago. They are adorable and remind me of growing up in the 80s, except in a much more comfortable version of the jellies. Pros- - Style is great - Comfortable at first Cons- -Comfort is short lived. -The cut out pattern can work against you My big complaint is that the circle cut out patter hits my pinky toes just right, so that they are squished through them. I have round, painful indents on them. Today I really wanted to wear them so I put band-aids on my pinky toes. Verdict- As long as you're willing to use band-aids for comfort each time you wear them, they are great!

title: Jellies?
text: Look at my new gardening shoes! Fun, right? Usually I am appalled by Crocs but these are sweet and remind me of jellies. They are so comfortable too!

title: Fan-ta-stic
text: I LOVE these shoes. They are comfy, cute, and terrific to bang around during the summer.

title: Try them in at a store before you buy. Wide feet? May pinch.
text: Not as comfy as I had hoped. A coworker lives hers. I have wider feet. Not comfy as I need them to be. 😞

title: Great shoe!
text: Love it. Bought it to wear on the beach but have been wearing it with tights because it is so comfortable!

title: Wore these comfortably all day at Disneyland
text: I wear an 8.5 with crocs I wear an 8. Wore these comfortably all day at Disneyland. If your feet sweat put hand sanitizer on her feet and let dry, that should do the trick.

title: more like a year
text: I wish they'd keep making these, so I wouldn't have to stock-pile them off ebay. Back when I'd walk a solid 7000-12000 steps a day for work, they'd last at least six months, more like a year. I nearly wore the sole through on the balls of my feet on one pair. I can run for the train, run for the bus, workout in them if I forget my regular shoes. The do get a bit slippery inside the shoe in the rain, so not great for running in the rain. With wool socks and only an inch of fresh snow on the sidewalks, I've walked a mile, including uphill, in Calgary in December with no slipping and warm toes the whole way - really! Love these things. No one believes they're crocs. I do own another pair of croc flats, more conventional closed-toe black flats that are much harder plastic, pinch my toes a little, make my feet sweat despite the three small holes at the arch for ventilation. Not even in the same ballpark as these. Downsides: I did once step on a concealed piece of sharp rebar (thank you, County of Baltimore, for not tending to your bus stops) that did puncture the sole of the shoe and into my foot - so these are not meant for hazardous areas. But regular rocks and pebbles and roots and s

title: Nice Shoes
text: I really liked these shoes the rubber is super soft so you do not have to worry about blisters or breaking them in. The sole is comfortable although not as cushy as the original crocs. I really like wearing these and this shoe runs true to size. I would say if you need a half size get the next size up not down.

title: Dressy Casual and Super Comfortable
text: This pair of shoes I have now purchased in espresso, pink and am waiting on the black. They are a very flattering look to the foot. You could walk around in them all day. The only break-in point would be the toe opening (not much at that). I personally love these shoes, the look and feel. The pink and celery are just fun spring and summer colors.

title: Croc's Pink Adrina Jelly Shoes
text: I like the shoes...a fun jelly style for summer. Could use a bit more cushiness in the footbed, but it's not bad. It did seem that they stretched after wearing a couple of weeks so I don't suggest buying larger than you usually wear. I still enjoy them, but they would be so much better with more cushioning. I give them a solid 3.

title: Run large
text: Ended up giving them away because they flopped off of my feet! Real pretty color though.

title: Crocs Adrina Flat is my favorite. I own 3 pairs of this shoes
text: Crocs Adrina Flat is my favorite. I own 3 pairs of this shoes. They are light, soft, comfy and with good support.

title: Cushiony comfort.
text: If you need a shoe to take you from the beach to out to dinner--this is it. You can literally LIVE in these shoes. Plenty of cushion, allowing you to walk for hours.....no worries with getting them wet, having them fall apart, or losing their shape. I've bought these in various colors (slate grey, brown, and pink), and have yet to wear out any of them...some of which I've had for years. Just a great pair of shoes. Well worth the money! Love these.

title: Very light and comfortable.
text: I usually wear 8 1/2 to 9, but needed the 8 for this to stay on. GREAT travel shoe--I bought this in black (really more of a dark gray) in the 9 but it fell off my foot so I gave that pair away and bought it in 8 and wore it all over France.

title: Great for summer
text: I purchased two pair of these in different colors as casual summer shoes. They have enough give to get through hot days as one's feet swell. I use them to run around with my grandchildren outdoors , but they can be worn anywhere. Probably would not work as well for someone with very skinny feet.

title: so comfortable
text: i love these crocs. i'm technically size 5.5 but the 6 fits fine. I tried on a 5 at the croc store and it fit nicely as well. the 5 is more of a secure fit.

title: They fit big! If your size 6.5, get a size 6.
text: I purchased these in a size 7 and they were too big. One thing about Crocs....ive never seen them to have half sizes. I am a 61/2, so I thought a size 6 would be too small. I never found out because I returned these after trying them on. They did feel very comfortable and wouldve been a nice shoe for work if they had fit.

title: Wonderfully comfortable for hot summer days and nights!
text: I have one in every color! They are my go to shoe for day and night. Good arch support, cushy heel and airy cool! I wore them as water walkers in salt water and wahed them on gentle cycle in washer to get the "salty stink" out and they came out like brand new!! Did not put them in the dryer -just let them air dry in the sun.

title: Light and comfortable
text: Sized generously so there is no break-in needed. Extremely light, airy and comfortable. Very happy with this purchase.

title: Cute and comfortable
text: These are cute and VERY comfortable, but the material has stretched a bit and now my heel flops out of the back occasionally. I'm just barely a size 10, and Crocs doesn't make half sizes, so be aware, if you are slightly too small for a size, you may have the same problem I do.

title: Love these!
text: These are my favorite Crocs! They fit really well, and provide so much more support than regular flats. I plan on buying more!

title: Five Stars
text: Fabulous feeling and comfy, don't know much about arch support, but u can definately wear them all day. Feels great for your legs

title: very uncomfortable shoe
text: I bought these shoes in good faith. However, I wore them for the first time around my home, and when I took them off, my heels hurt! Probably because these shoes, although pretty, have poor support for the feet. The rubber is much too soft and flimsy to provide any kind of support. So they're pretty, but impractical shoes. By the way, as far as I know, Crocs does not make a narrow or a wide width shoe, they're all the same width, and the "W" stands for 'women', not "wide"!

title: Adrina Crocs
text: I was lucky enough to find the oyster ones in my size...I had a pr, but the upper part discolored when I put them in the washer.

title: Love!
text: I ordered these in Scarlet/Oyster, hoping they would not be a bright red. They are not, and I love the color. They are actually more of a soft melon or coral color, very pretty and versatile. I am normally a size 8M or 8.5 M, and I ordered the 8. They fit very well and are not at all tight in the toe area for me. First day out, I wore them for hours. I was on my feet all day long and they were comfy from morning to evening. BUT, if you have wider feet, you might find them a bit snug and uncomfortable, so be sure to order the Wide. A couple of strangers stopped me on the street to ask me where I got them. My feet do not perspire in these shoes, probably because they are open lattice design, and the cushioning is very soft and bouncy. Another great thing: if they get dirty, you just wash them in warm sudsy water and let them air-dry. I also ordered the Sexi Platform sandal in Oyster/Oyster and the Adrina II in Gold, but they haven't arrived yet. I will be rocking the Crocs all summer long.

title: They do exist!
text: Comfy work shoes. I work in a business environment and these shoes are awesome. Comfortable but stylish. I wear them everyday. I have wide feet and these fit great. They do pinch a little bit around the edge where by big toe and pinky toe hit the edge, but not enough to be horribly uncomfortable. They are great to walk in or stand it.

title: Need Comfortable Shoes? These Are It!
text: I love these shoes. In fact, I was so afraid I would never find them again that I quickly ordered a pair for when my other ones wear out. It has been over 2 years and I am still wearing the first pair. These shoes are SO comfortable you hardly know you are wearing them.

title: Saucony Walking Shoes
text: I was worried about buying shoes via the internet, but I have to say I couldn't be happier with my new walking shoes. Many years ago, I had Saucony walkers, and now that I'm walking again I thought I'd go with a brand I like. I need a wide shoe which can be hard to find and Saucony had my size. These shoes couldn't fit better if they were custom made. No break-in period necessary....I've been wearing them every day for weeks now.

title: Two Stars. Great shoes. My last pair took a beating. I hope they haven’t change.
text: They are comfortable. BUT they only last for2 months at the maximum. After wearing two months they are horrible.!!!!

title: I think I have to break these in, but ...
text: I think I have to break these in, but it is not the shoes fault, it is my old feet.

title: Good replacement
text: Bought these to replace another worn out pair and they are just as nice as the ones they replace. Nice and wide in the toe box. Glad I found them on line

title: Narrow, small toe box and hot
text: I wanted to like these, but sadly, I did not. Their narrow with a very small toe box. The support seamed good, for a very narrow foot. They also do not breathe well... I found them hot to wear. I returned them for a minimalist sneaker.

title: The perfect shoes
text: I have plantar fasciitis and really struggle to find a shoe that's right for me. Soon as I put these babies on I didn't even need a break in period. They fit just right, have arch support and look durable. I see these lasting years and matching with outfits. Love them

title: Top quality, excellent value, Keillor buy again!
text: This is the 5th or 6th pair I’ve purchased for my wife. She’s had foot surgery on both feet and these are positively the only shoes she’s been able to wear. Absolutely recommend!!! 5 out 5 stars!!

title: Quality
text: Daughter-in-law pleased. Didn't realize she could have such a quality pair of walking shoes at a more than reasonable price.

title: Tried them today
text: I finally wore these today. I ordered them last month. I wore the same walking shoe for years but another manufacturer quit making leather shoes. I live in a rainy area, so cloth shoes just won't do. I also have a narrow instep and a high arch but the rest of my foot is a medium. I did research and found out that these have a relatively high arch. They are adequate for me. I wore these all morning and they felt very good. My last leather walking shoe lasted 5 years so hopefully this one will be the same.

title: Came out to be a perfect fit!
text: I ordered half size up and a wide size since I will be wearing these with thicker socks. Came out to be a perfect fit!

title: Happy it fits so
text: Needed a 4W shoe because of foot surgery and this was the only one I could find for my size 6 foot. Happy it fits so well

title: My favorite sneakers
text: Well made, comfortable sneakers. At first, I ordered them in black, but they were too tight for some reason. Then ordered them in white after reading that another reviewer said the same thing about the black ones. The white ones fit perfectly with excellent arch support.

title: Very good shoe for walking
text: I walk several miles each week, and need shoes with good arch support, padding, and comfort. I had been wearing Nikes, but am boycotting them over their Michael Vick endorsement deal. It was difficult finding a substitute, and then I came across the Saucony online. Having read a number of good reviews, I decided to give it a try. When the shoes arrived, the right shoe fit perfectly, but there was a problem with the left shoe. I notified Amazon, and they had me print out a return label, and immediately shipped me a replacement pair. The next morning, I boxed up the shoes and dropped them off at UPS (so easy). The next day, the replacement pair arrived! Excellent service! The replacement pair fit perfectly. I wear a size 7B, and these fit just right. They were comfortable right out of the box. I love how soft the leather is, unlike some walking shoes (Rockport)that are stiff and uncomfortable. The next morning, I wore them on my 2-1/2 mile walk, and they were fine. I have no problems with these shoes. I highly recommend.

title: Perfect for a basic, casual shoe
text: I have never had a pair of Saucony shoes before and I really like these. I wanted a better built shoe than typical Reebok or Nike - I have Asics brand runners and love them. I find that I am a 50/50 split between a 6.5 or 7 shoe size fitting comfortably. I ordered both sizes with the intention of returning one. I kept the size 7 as it afforded me a bit of extra room for thick socks and it was just more comfy as a casual shoe. The 6.5 size also fit comfortably but would have needed some breaking in and I would certainly not be able to wear thick socks in winter. Overall a great, basic, casual shoe. I'm sure I will replace these with the same item when they finally give out.

title: amazing comfort
text: These shoes are wonderful! Right out of the box I wore them today for hours as I marketed, etc. I have knee problems that rebel when I' m on my feet for hours and then have to apply topical pain relieving ointment. This did not happen today! The shoes are a perfect fit. Roomy in the toes, but not so much that my foot moved around. Arch supports were comfortable and hit at the right place. (I have tried other so-called orthopedic brands in which the arch was too high and very uncomfortable). The heel cup is perfect and my heel did not slide up and down even without using the extra shoe string hole. I highly recommend these shoes. I intend to purchase another pair.

title: Very Comfortable
text: The Saucony's were extremely comfortable the first time I tried them on. A very smart looking walking shoe to. I usually wear New Balance Walking shoes, but after hearing that these were so good, decided to try them. Now I'm a convert and will continue to buy the Saucony's. The size 61/2, usual fit for shoes with socks fit just right. Very happy with them.

title: Most comfortable walking shoe I've ever owned.
text: I was hoping that the info on sizing was correct and it was. I needed walking shoes that were wide because of bunions and pinched toes and these shoes are so comfortable! I had no problem with "breaking them in". I walked a couple miles the first time and my feet (especially my toes) were so happy to have room to move. I have moderate arches and these shoes work for me. I bought them 1/2" longer than my foot length which was recommended and in wide.

title: Purchased Shoes for $75 and Price Constant for Months but Dropped to $55 Two Weeks After Purchase
text: The only consolation is the 7.5 EE fits and when writing reviews, I learned that after many months of costing $75 they are $55 two weeks after received shoes. This particular shoe gives the most bounce for feet with no fat pads.

title: Plantar fascitis
text: Started using these, along with ortho inserts for plantar fasciitis. I wear them everyday, even inside of my home. This has reduced pain tremendously.

title: Best shoes for bunions and problem feet
text: I hope they never stop making these shoes because I don't know what I will do of they do! I have had bunions on both feet (right foot worse) since I was a kid and shoes have always been an issue for me....which has been even more problematic when I've had jobs where I'm on my feet all day. When I first bought these shoes, I was working as a dog walker in NYC for 6-8 hours straight a day--I needed a seriously supportive shoe! These were the godsend I was looking for. Very supportive and a erfect wide toe area. I'm no longer walking dogs, but I continue to buy these shoes and will do so for as long as they make them.

title: Very comfortable shoes. I had plantar fasciitis that was often ...
text: Very comfortable shoes. I had plantar fasciitis that was often bothering me before I started wearing these shoes three years ago (this is my second pair). No problems at all with my plantar fasciitis anymore.

title: Nice shoe
text: Light weight and seems to fit well. Have a narrow foot but these seem to fit fine with socks. Will use when shopping and doing a lot of walking.

title: Too hard to keep clean
text: Would never purchase the nubuck again, they look filthy already and do not clean up well at all.

title: Majorly slippery soles
text: While these seem super comfortable, I’ll be returning them due to the soles being super slippery. I was trying them out inside my housewhike washing windows. A tiny bit of overspray got on the floor - I slipped and almost fell. Seriously super slip sole. So while the great cushioning might help feet, knees and back, it wouldn’t be good to have a fall.

title: Saucony Excellence
text: Throughout the years I have tried different walking shoes. Saucony wins hands down. The best walking shoe I have ever had. In fact these feel so good I am going to order another pair for backup. I know I will get many years wear out of these shoes. When it comes time to replace them I want to make sure I don't have to figure out which one to buy. As it is now, I am overweight and out of shape and these shoes are the beginning of taking care of this problem.

title: Great shoes!
text: Fit perfectly right out of the box! Could have a little more arch support but that can be accomplished with inserts. Toe box is not pointy like so many shoes are now, makes for good comfort and no squeezing together of your toes. The walk great with no rubbing on my heel. Love them, thinking of getting a second pair already!

title: Alright….
text: I basically bought this shoe because I like the brand, Saucony, it came in a wide width to accommodate an orthopedic insert, and I was sick of all these multi colored mesh athletic shoes. I wanted something simpler. I love the look of most Nike's, but Nike shoes don't fit well on me in terms of athletic use and are hard to find in wide widths. They felt a little smaller than I expected but seemed to stretch out quickly with some walks around the house. After a few weeks of wear, I thought the look was almost too plain, I felt like I was wearing an "old lady' shoe. I will continue to buy Saucony, they make a great shoe, but probably won't buy this style again.

title: Happy with my purchase!
text: Very comfortable and the toe box is large enough to accommodate my impending hammertoe without pain. I also love Amazon wardrobe! This is the second time we have used it. Hassle free shopping at home!

title: Good walking shoe - cushioning stiffer than other Sauconys
text: Nice and wide in the toe box which really helps with wide feet and my bunion and hammer toes. Only reason I did not give these 5 stars is because the cushioning not as good as my other Saucony running shoes. Might be because these are my first pair of walking shoes and I just need to get use to them but they definitely felt stiffer.

title: Five Stars
text: These shoes fit perfectly and are very comfortable. No break-in required. Feels like I have been wearing for years.

title: NARROW
text: Crush pinky toes. Toe box too narrow with laces at widest. Stiff around ankles and a bit high - uncomfortable as a result. Wide heel, so loosening the top of the shoe to relieve some pressure from stiff upper a round ankle leads to heel slippage. Seem to roll my foot out a little too much. Not the quality I was expecting from Vasque. Soles are good. Three plus mike walk with small elevation change and I feel my knees and toes talking to me. Light weight, which is s plus. I’ll try different lacing and terrain and review again.

title: From 3 Stars to 4
text: At first I felt the toe box was too small and painful. Now after wearing these shoes on and off again they have"broken in" some, and the fit in the toe box is slightly better. What I do love about these shoes is the support around the heal. Feels great there when on rocky and rooty trails.

title: The look grip and stability
text: Very happy with these they have a great look and off trail and fishing they have the grip and stability that you can feel

title: Fantastic shoe - small toe box
text: I like this shoe, it is outstanding, unfortunately for me, the toe box is just a little too small (tight), and it causes discomfort when hiking. I recently took a 15-mile hike and wet conditions, and it performed well. My shoes did not get wet until I was forced to walk a section of trail that 2"+ under water. They have good traction and are durable.

title: ... is my second pair and I could not be happier with them
text: This is my second pair and I could not be happier with them. I used to wear Merrells, but they never fit me as well as these. As long as Vasque makes this shoe I will be a loyal customer. Great fit, comfort and performance. Six stars.

title: Great shoes. Runs a bit smal and narrow in sizing.
text: This is a great shoe but runs very narrow in width. Looks good and is comfortable. Make sure to order the wide or 2E version. Also, consider going up at least half a size to a full size (if you prefer a more loose fit). I had to return a pair that was too narrow. Would be a five star rating if the sizing was not so difficult/vague.

title: Fantastic shoes!
text: This is my second pair. When they wear out, I'll order another. These shoes fit like a glove and are great for hiking, as well as everyday shoes. Pretty warm and decent water repellency. I've done several 10-12 mile hikes in them with a light pack. I haven't carried more than a 20lb pack and probably wouldn't, they don't offer a ton of support.

title: Very impressed
text: Extremely comfortable. Does a good job for protecting my feet from cactus spines (not 100% but much better than athletic style shoes).

title: Great all around shoes
text: I like hiking/walking shoes for everyday use. I bought a 10W and they fit perfect. They are a little heavier & stiffer than my Altra’s, but those are meant to be. I like the looks of these and they have great traction. They do need a little break-in. I paid $82 for mine & think that was a great price for shoes this quality.

title: The greatest shoes I have ever bought or owned in my long sporting life
text: Well built/looks great/versatile but most importantly they provide the kind of support and cushioning I have yet to find in any shoe. If I someone was holding a gun to my head and I had to make a claim for a perfect product, in any category, and form an argument as to why, it would most likely be this... If I wanna go on a long walk/hike (now 59) and I had to pick a shoe to compensate for any physical shortcoming (posture, weight, tightness in my back/whatever) which is a big ask for any shoe, I'm grabbing this every time. I've had it for 3 yrs and no damage or signs of wear anywhere and I weigh 240 pounds. Do yourself a favor and buy it!

title: Stiff toe box
text: The toe box is really stiff and hurt my toes Really bad while hiking downhill. So much so that it really slowed me down because I had to hike down side stepping.

title: This shoe is no surprise in the quality and comfort ...
text: This shoe is no surprise in the quality and comfort, all at a very affordable price (at least for myself). Have used previous Vasque shoes on hiking / climbing trips to Mt. Everest, and Mt. Kilimanjaro, and various everyday activities. You might find a cheaper version, but, not the quality. Next, will see how they holdup in Antarctic until boots will replace them.

title: wow vary nice
text: Love these sneakers light and vary well maid for the money vary fast delivery Ty. The fit is perfect did not need the wide ones.

title: Vasque Men's Juxt Multisport Shoe
text: My first pair of Vasque shoes, fit is good and quite comfortable right out of the box. Look good with jeans or business casual for work.

title: The overall length is perfect. The shoes are just a bit narrow in ...
text: The overall length is perfect. The shoes are just a bit narrow in the toes. I normally don't have this issue with other brands. A few days in and they are getting better so I'm not returning them.

title: Didn't feel quite right on my foot.
text: I like the shoe overall, but it didn't feel quite right. It felt a little narrow in the middle of the foot. I like the lacing of the shoe - it really did snug up very nicely. I had another pair of Vasque's to try on at the same time - the Mantra 2.0 GTX - that felt much more natural on my foot. Now, I had an 11.5 in the Mantra and an 11 in the Juxt based on reviews of what fit. But, I still don't think I would have liked the feel of the Juxt's. The Mantra feels very much like my Vasque hiking boots - it fits like a glove and feels very comfortable to walk in. I returned the Juxt - a nice, well made shoe, just not the ones for me.

title: Praying they never get discontinued.
text: Been wearing these for years. Good fit, decent service life and very comfortable. Mine tend to wear at the inside of the heel, but that's my foot shape and I get good use from these Juxts before it becomes a problem. I like them enough to have 2 pair in the current rotation and 2 more new pair in the closet (purchased on sale), if that tells you how much I like them

title: Recommended by Gideon
text: Feels a bit strange at first with the full length lacing, but you get used to it. Vasques design makes the shoe feel more connected to your entire foot and lighter than it actually is. I bought these based on a recommendation from Gideon's tactical on YT.

title: Recommended
text: 2 months in > Sturdy but light weight shoe. Great grip! Runs slightly smaller than sized.

title: Fit like a dream, no blisters
text: I've been a Merrell guy my whole life but decided to take a chance on these Vasques. I'm glad I did! They fit extremely comfortably even with zero break-in and I didn't get a single blister or hot spot after a tough nearly 10 mile hike on my second day wearing them. It rained halfway through and they indeed get slippery when wet, which I saw in some other reviews, so be extra careful on wet surfaces - that's why I deducted a star. On dry surfaces, though, their grip is excellent and they are very supportive.

title: Favorite shoes ever!
text: I was worried that they would run large/ long, but they fit perfectly. I always wear size 12EE, and ordered this size, it was perfect.

title: Very comfortable to walk in
text: Very comfortable to walk in, but they seem to run just a bit large (I wear 15 so no half size), and are a little warm. Just got them and have only worn twice, but they may turn into cooler weather shoes with thicker socks for me.

title: “The Dude abides.” Like buy these Vasque’s man
text: Just opened my new VASQUE JUXT and love the way they fit. I’m 71 and have had numbness in both feet for over 10 years because of peripheral neuropathy. I haven’t found a pair of shoes that feel really good on my feet in all that time and I’ve tried many. I put these on and instantly felt like they have support in all the right places plus the lacing system allows for them to fit like a glove, something that’s important when you have numb feet. I’ll wear them for a month, then I’ll do an update. I also like the way they look, especially the orange thread, partial orange lacing system and orange area under ankle. Nice touch!!!!!!

title: Great shoes at a great price!
text: Just bought my second pair of the Juxt cross trainers. Great shoe, great price and you can't go wrong with Vasque!

title: Great shoe!
text: I purchased this shoe for doing yard work around the house. I like these shoes/boots as they get great traction and dry quickly!

title: Everything I was looking for
text: I really enjoy wearing these juxt multisports. I had been looking for a new pair of light hiking/outdoor shoes to replace some Timberland boots I bought nearly 15 years ago. Overall I find them very comfortable and they have performed great so far. Let me just caution everyone to keep an open mind, the consistency in workmanship is so-so. Every time there was a noticeable difference between the left and right shoe quality-wise. I had to order a few to get a defect free pair but I am also picky. In this case 3rd time was the charm. At this price point I am very pleased. I would even happily pay more if they were made to higher standards. I just hope they last!

title: Warm and strong
text: Toe is excellent shape is anything but flattering to the foot. But functions well. Had to dash a quarte mile on slick city streets and they were just fine. Daily wear will tell how they hold up and as they break in I’ll add to this review

title: Felt comfortable right out of the box
text: Felt comfortable right out of the box. I have a narrow foot so it was nice to see my size come in a narrow option. Have worn around the house and yard and feel good for that purpose. Have only been on one trail. They feel solid with just the right amount of padding and urface feel. I found myself slipping a bit on loose soil and small rocks but don't think it was the fault of the shoes. Will wait and see if I have that issue again otherwise would have given 5 stars. Very happy with the color and looks.

title: Outstanding, trail runner & light hiker
text: Great trail running & light hiking shoe... It does not replace my classic Danner hiker for a loaded pack over extreme terrain nor should it. Great for a lighter hike and with no load. Out of the box completed a10 miler without breaking down is very impressive. The heel cushioned & cupped the heel very well and supported the light touch of plantar fasciitis . Any critical observation is the scooped heel which most runners have these days - not conducive to an easy run on wet silty clay trails as they accumulate too much soil but easy enough to resolve. I will always have this model as my transition foot gear.. It would also make a great single go to travel shoe...

title: Really great hiking/outdoor shoe
text: Really great hiking/outdoor shoe. Fits well and has not hurt my feet, even after 8+ mile hikes thru challenging terrain. I've hiked both coasts, blistering deserts and cold frozen forests and they have held up perfectly. Have received compliments on the shoes. Will buy again when this pair is someday worn.

title: Great for Nursing!
text: Bought for Girlfriend who is a Nurse. She needed some shoes with excellent support. These did the trick, and half the price of Nike! She loves the colors and that they breathe well.

title: LOVE THEM!
text: Have never owned a pair f K-Swiss but have to say I do love how they fit. Very comfortable. Love them!

title: Survive with Wide Feet
text: My kid has wide feet and is sensitive to shoes. She only wears my 15 year old Saucony. New Saucony is no good to her. She was happy the first time she slip her feet in. This shoes is like using strip wrapping around your feet. You will be amazed how much you can adjust the width. No need to break in.

title: Best Shoes EVER!
text: I have purchased quite a few pairs of K-Swiss Tubes. They are the best running/walking shoe I have ever bought. I have purchased other shoes, but always end up returning them and go right back to my tubes! They are very comfortable and feel as light as air. I need to stick with what works and never buy another brand. I just hope they keep making these for a very long time.

title: Very comfy and stylish!
text: For quite some time now I have been wearing regular sneakers to go on my hour long walks around the neighborhood. I have finally decided to buy some actual running shoes instead for my walks. Upon reading the positive reviews, I decided on these and I am happy I did. I just took my first walk today in them and they are mighty comfy! They are very flexible too, give me a bounce in my step, and are quite stylish. I got the green/black faded ones. Even my mother is considering getting herself a pair after she saw them. Overall, I highly recommend them. I am thinking of buying a second pair for work because at my job I am on my feet all day long. Even though these are technically running shoes, they could definitely give my feet some comfort when I stand on them for 6+ hour shifts. UPDATE (October 2012): I just wanted to say that it has been 5 months and these shoes are still amazing! I still wear them for my walks. I also wear them at work since, like I said, I am on my feet for long periods of time. These are the ONLY shoes I have owned that allow my feet 100% comfort throughout my entire work shift. They are amazing!

title: ... for a pair i bought two years ago and loved so much

title: K-Swiss Running Shoes
text: Comfortable. Nice arch. Great for working out and putting miles on the treadmill or on the road. Love love love them.

title: Not worth the money
text: At first glance they seemed very nice. Until you get them on your feet.I knew this was a gamble trying a brand I haven't worn in years. The outside of the shoes aren't bad.I really think the tube tread would have been fantastic. It's the sole and construction on the inside. They don't even match. The inside arch is not even close to being the same. I think this is a manufacturing defect that slipped through some how. Would I buy them again. Not a chance. I don't believe this was the sellers fault. Again I think it's cheap manufacturing. This isn't to say all KSwiss are faulty. But this pair is definitely garbage. I should have just stuck with my normal brand

title: Super cute and comfy!
text: I bought these on a whim because I usually buy somewhat more expensive running shoes, but these were just too good a deal to pass up. They are very cute and comfy and seem to be wearing well. I can't speak to their impact on running mechanics or overall quality, but for general use are fine for me.

title: Only Lasted 2 months...
text: These shoes tore rather quickly the soles of them came apart and holes started forming in the mesh of the shoe.. They are really comfortable though.. Just wish that they lasted longer than 2 months:(

title: So Far so good

When i do run in them that will be the true test. i feel they run a tad bit big, but i dont know if that would make me order a 1/2 size smaller - i would have to try them on. They are great if you have wide feet. If you are just looking for a pair of good sneakers because you are on your feet all day i would 100% go for these. If you will be running, walking, workign out in these for the price it is worth giving them a try. I really do feel once they are broken in i am going to love them. I bought the light pink and they are really cute :) have gotten a few compliments.

title: I wish they still had the grey and green

title: My second pair
text: I wear these to the gym every day and if i can throughout the day. I have planters facilities and these kswiss shoes allow me to run pain free.

title: Great shoes

title: K-Swiss Running Shoes just as comfortable as K-Swiss tennis shoes
text: I've been wearing K-Swiss Tennis Shoes for almost 10 years, so I was delighted to find K-Swiss running shoes. I have high arches and must use "Good Feet" shoe inserts in all my shoes. I have worn these K-Swiss Tube Running shoes for almost 2 weeks (in x-training) and find them very comfortable.

title: Very cushy but not rigid enough for me
text: The shoes fit a bit wide (my feet are average width). They are very cushy, feels like walking on air. Unfortunately, I felt like my plantar fasciitis was back when wearing them...the shoe needs to be more rigid for me. Will be returning.

title: Great Option for Anyone Needing Traditional Cross-Trainers, Just Not For Us
text: As a traditional athletic and training shoe, these are great. However, for someone slowly weaning their way toward more "neutral" shoes with less heel-to-toe drop and better ground feel, my wife found these to be way over-supportive and far too cushioned for her liking. The overall design is wonderful and the black/coral color option really "pops" in person. My wife thought they were absolutely adorable and was sad to return them based on style alone! However, they were the exact opposite of what my wife is beginning to prefer since taking a more "minimalist" approach to her shoe choices. If you are looking for a lightweight, comfortable, soft-riding pair of athletic sneakers with very good built-in support for daily use and athletic training, these are definitely a good choice.

title: Just Not What I Expected from a Runing Shoe :(
text: For the price I expected a comfortable shoe, i've purchased many running/walking shoes and they were very comfortable, "Not These" at all, very hard construction of the sole, very little padding in foot bed where you need it the most, support in arch area none..omg just poor construction in a running shoe...but that's just my opinion. I would not advise anyone to buy these for any purpose or use...just poor quality again in my opinion, Sincerely, Marla B.

title: Super comfortable shoes!
text: These shoes were so comfortable! I really loved wearing them, but unfortunately they wore out very quickly. The stitching frayed very quickly, and then the sole of the shoes on the "tubes" started tearing. I think I would still buy another pair in the future, even with the lack of durability because they were very comfortable.

title: perfect

title: Lovely metallic gold in sexiest Birkenstock style
text: I have been wearing a pearlized white Gizeh style Birkenstock with a little adornment on the shoe for many years and they always receive compliments. With care and resealing of the cork, they still look great after all these years, but I purchased a pair of pink suede Gizeh thong sandals and was hit with the itch for more. Because of the low cost of the current Graceful Morocco Gold Birko-Flor sandals in my usual size, I ordered a pair a couple days ago and have been wearing them now for an hour. Tonight, I'm stepping out with the new shoes and know I'll have no problems walking. This style is the most sleek, in my opinion, of the Birkenstocks and creates the appearance of a longer foot. When wearing the Arizona style, I find that my feet appear chunkier and wider, but I love that style as well. My Boston clogs also create a wider appearance, but I'm excited that Fall is approaching and I'll be wearing mine even more often. I have a little advice for any Birkenstocks. Take good care of them and they will last for a long time. Clean them and reseal the cork when it appears to be a little dry. Wipe them down after being exposed to salt or chemicals. Don't let the soles wear down to f

title: Plantar faciitis suffers should give these a try
text: Wore these all through college and then got professional and stylish in high heels and such. After years of battering my feet they got so bad I could hardly stand and just the thought of putting them on the floor in the morning would bring tears. Then I remembered my old favorites- Birkenstock. These shoes have a cork bed that molds to your foot as you wear them. They come with soft foot bed or regular; narrow, regular and wide widths and high arch for extra support. After just a couple days of wearing these shoes, my foot pain was gone and the leg cramps that plagued me at night have all but disappeared. Plantar faciitis sufferers should give these a try. They are the only shoe in my closet, I even keep a pair by the bed as slippers and a pair to garden in.

title: LOVE my Birkenstocks
text: After years of foot pain and leg cramps caused by trying to wear 'fashionable' shoes, I have returned to the shoe of college days. I swear by Birkenstocks. No more Planter Facitis, no more leg cramps, no more foot cramps and swelling. Soft footbed option is heaven!

title: like others, I have noticed a decline in quality ...
text: I have been wearing some version of the New Balance 600 series shoes for over 10 years now. I have really come to appreciate the ability to order a pair of shoes online and not be at the mercy of what local shoe stores have in stock or on sale. I wear these shoes all day for both work (office) and play (volleyball). In general they perform very well but, like others, I have noticed a decline in quality over the last few years. The pair I just replaced had the upper pull away from the sole at the heel within a fairly short amount of time. I used to be able to count on a pair lasting at least 6 months of everyday - all day use. For the price and convenience though I am sticking with the brand for at least this one more pair. We'll see how it goes. My four-star rating is obviously not based on the pair I just received but aggregated over the last several pairs I have ordered (not all from Amazon and not all MX603V3).

title: The wide sizing is great, but...
text: This is my husband's third pair of New Balance shoes. The toe box on this pair (we got the white ones with the black toe cap) is very nice and deep. I didn't want to leave a review until they had been worn for a while. My husband is on his feet all day long at work, and walks a great distance. Comfortable shoes are a must, and he doesn't need safety toe shoes. The report is that these are very comfortable and provide plenty of support for his feet and ankles during the day. That is the good news. The bad news, is that despite looking like they would be very sure-footed, the bottoms provide almost no help on non-carpeted floors. title: I don't understand...
text: New Balance once had a very good reputation for making quality athletic shoes that provided solid support and were well-constructed. I have owned many pairs of their gym shoes through the years. The old version of the 608 in particular was a very good shoe. The shoe shape was well-proportioned (wider in the forefoot where most feet tend to widen), the materials were good, the support was almost unmatched in this price point, and the durability was exceptional. Well, sadly this is no more. I tried on a pair of these and was horribly disappointed. The shoe is shaped like an oval now, not conforming at all to the shape of my feet. The materials seem to be of poor quality, the uppers being stiff and not very breathable (the old 608s were made from soft, comfortable leather). The sole is completely flat and seems thin, not very cushioned. The toe box is short yet very high (how many feet are shaped like that??). I couldn't even walk around the store comfortably when I tried them on! What has happened, New Balance? Is the focus now on the whole minimal footwear concept rather than on the old standby? Whatever the case, NB has lost a customer here. Disappointing.

The fastener thingys (which replace shoe laces) won't stay put in their clamp thingys. In the first pair, I could get them clamped in OK, but they would pop out easily, so I was continuously fiddling with my shoes during workouts to re-clamp the fastener thingys. Annoying, very annoying. But I put up with it, and even ordered a second pair in a different color, because the shoes are so appealing to look at and so comfortable to run, hike, do TRX, whatever else, in. But now with the second pair, I can't get the fasteners to clamp in place at all, and they are essentially useless. The "laces" flop to and fro as I run, the plastic ends hitting my legs and the loops catching on things. How disappointing. And it seems like a pretty simple thing to come up with a design that ensures the fastener thingys stay in place as you vigorously move around. I'm going to contact the company and ask them to fix the problem or give me a refund.

title: My last pair of Teva lasted for 17 YEARS! ...
text: My last pair of Teva lasted for 17 YEARS! If these last half as long, it will be well worth my investment.

title: Unbelievably comfortable for walking around camp all day
text: Unbelievably comfortable for walking around camp all day, in and out of water, and around the town. They fit as expected, are easy to clean and did not cause blisters when worn for the first time. I bought these as a cheaper "hiking" sandal to the Keen sandals (which are also amazing by the way!) and am not disappointed. Very well made and quality material so they should last for a while!

title: Sizing up was way too big
text: Wish Teva made this in half sizes. Like the shoe itself, but it was way too big for an 8.5 sized foot. There was too much space in front of the toes to the point that the front strap was actually on toenails. However, the return was smooth to an Amazon storefront and got a gift card back by the day's end.

title: Big guys and Tevas
text: Ordered these for my husband (wears a 13 or 14, depending) in a size 13 (for references he's 6'4" and about 250). He reports that these fit great, are very comfortable and molded to the foot quickly with a week or so of break-in wear prior to our trek to a waterpark. Rigid enough to feel sturdy on gravel and uneven surfaces, solid footbed but not overly hard on your feet. He also likes the blue coloring which is impressive since he rarely wears anything that's not solid black. Typically he wears the cheaper sandals but I insisted on some higher quality ones for the summer. Also, he had the benefit of trying these on in a brick & mortar and then ordered through Amazon for a much cheaper pricetag. Good investment - go for it!

title: Great shoe for the job
text: I just needed something for walking around outside and the price was right. They are more comfortable than the $3.00 pair of rubber sandals you buy in WalMart. Although they were a little stiff at first, they loosened up right away and now I wear them all the time.

title: Good, tough sandals.
text: I'm rough on shoes. I'm tall and heavy with big feet. I'm clumsy. I do a fair bit of work outdoors. I've worn these sandals daily for over six months. The Velcro fastenings still work fine. None of the stitching is coming loose. The soles are a little worn and damaged, but that's to be expected. I'm pretty pleased with them overall. They're comfortable, and the arrangement of the straps is sensible and strong.

title: My hubby is super picky about his shoes but his old flip flops ...
text: My hubby is super picky about his shoes but his old flip flops are shot. He loves these. Thanks Teva, Great shoes!!!

title: Awesome sandals at a fantastic price
text: This is a fantastic product. It is very comfortable, even after wearing them walking all day. They have held up beautifully for me. I've worn these on numerous 6+ mile hikes, in lakes for swimming or getting in/out of my kayak, and when pouring outside when my shoes would get wet anyways. They don't take forever to dry like the pair of sandals I was replacing either so that is a definite plus. There hasn't been a time when I thought they wouldn't be what I wanted to wear on my feet for the day. If these wear out I wouldn't hesitate to get another pair.

title: Nice quality.
text: If you are between sizes,definitely order the size DOWN rather than up. VERY roomy fit. Nice quality.

title: Good purchase!
text: Very comfortable sandal. They provide the support I was looking for in a "lake shoe". I did get blisters on my big toes after wearing them for a whole day the first time. After regular use, my feet got used to them. I'm happy with my purchase.

title: Thumbs up!
text: I bought these for my husband who has never worn athletic sandals before and he loves them. He usually wears a 10.5 shoe and the size 10 fit perfectly. He has high arches and heel spurs from running and these shoes provide good support for a sandal. Thumbs up!

title: Teva's--My Go-To Shoe in the Summer
text: I've been wearing Teva's for years and it was time for my annual purchase. They arrived quickly and fit perfectly, as they always do. Very comfortable for walking. I also wear them when kayaking. They are rugged enough for what I use them for. I also like that I can wash them.

title: Wonderful sandals!!
text: I "guessed" wrong and got the sandals too large. When I received the 15s they were perfect! Great for hiking and for going to a beach with pebbles and not sand! I don't worry about losing these as I would flip-flops since your foot is solidly encased in the sandal!

title: Top strap rubs skin
text: Fit well and seem sturdy. My only gripe is the top strap hurts the top of my foot. It rubs in such a way that the strap takes my skin off. They should have lined the top strap with a material thats not so abrasive but other than that not bad.

title: Comfortable Sandal
text: I wear a size 10 shoe and this size 10 sandal fit just right. It is comfortable and it looks well made and durable. We will see, I will be wearing them quite a bit. I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars because of the price but I guess you get what you pay for. So long as the Sandals last then they will be worth the price.

title: Great sandals that last for a long time
text: My son loves these sandals. They last for a really long time. He hasn't worn a pair out, his feet just keep getting bigger and I have to buy him a new pair. He loves them so much that when he outgrows them we don't even look for other brands we just order the next size up in these sandals. I love the Teva brand and have found them to be comfortable and long lasting.

title: Very much as expected - good fit and comfort
text: Very good basic sandal. Fits well, comfortable at beach and resort areas. I'm sure there are fancier ones around, even from Teva. But these work quite nicely.

title: Great sandals
text: Came a day earlier than stated, which is always nice. Product as expected. Started wearing them right away. They are correct size, etc. I normally wear a 10 1/2, but noted from another reviewer who wears the same size, to order a 10 and they would fit perfectly. So I did, and they did.

title: comfortable, pretty adjustable
text: I wear size 12 Narrow, and found the size 12s comfortable and adjustable enough to feel like the fit is good. Haven't had a change to run in them much (playing Frisbee this weekend) but seem like they are a good purchase. Also has a little arch support which, for me, is a definite plus. Recommended

title: Big hit
text: Christmas present for grandson, he immediately put them on and said they were perfect. (His Dad agreed since the son had taken Dad's as his own - so now Dad gets HIS pair back!) Can't go wrong w/Tevas.

title: Very good unisex shoe
text: This is a unisex style. I have a wide foot, so like most women with this problem, I try to find men's shoes that are unisex in style as they are wider than the average women's shoe. Women's shoes for wider feet seem to be sized for people with a weight problem and I found they do not fit properly. These fit perfectly. You have to measure your feet and follow the size chart as men's shoes are like women's in that different brands and models fit differently, so you may wear one size in one brand/model and a different size in another.

title: Perfect!!
text: Got these for my youngest son and he LOVES them!! He is headed to Florida this week and can't wait to get them in the sand! He also has a Kayak and will be using them a lot!

title: Love my Tevas
text: I had my last pair of Teva sandals for over 15 years. These replacements don't seem to be quite as deluxe as the old pair (the feel of the sole is more rubbery, less cushiony) but if they last half as long as the last pair, I've gotten my money's worth. The purple straps are very attractive, sturdy as ever.

title: Too long.
text: I normally wear a 9 and I kept tripping over the front of the shoe. I gave them to a friend who wears a 10 and they fit her just fine. I have worn Teva's for years, but these didn't fit as well as the other ones.

title: True to size.
text: My daughter is a 9, and the size 9 sandal fit her perfectly. Money well spent. :)

title: love tevas
text: I love tevas and purchase regularly. These are great. I love black. it looks more presentable than the colors. Since I have a bunion I wear these all the time

title: Washington Fan
text: I usually love Teva. but these sandals are so stiff they hurt my feet. I have even washed them in the machine and still stiff,

title: LOVE THESE SANDALS!
text: Fit perfect! I took the advice of other reviews and bought a 7 because I wear a 7.5. COMFY and just right for me! My feet are wide and these sandals are wide so my feet fit well in them.

title: Sandals for "Big Foot"
text: I ordered the black Teva Women's Hurricane XLT Sandal in size 8M which is my normal size for any shoe from dress shoe to flip-flops and they always fit perfectly. The package arrived very quickly and nicely packaged, but when I took the sandals out of the box I freaked. I thought that a men's sandal had been packed in error because they were huge. My first reaction was to return them, but after verifying that they really were women's size 8M (as ordered) and that there are no half sizes made for this specific sandal, I decided to put them on. I looked like "Big Foot." This sandal has a thick rim around the sole which adds to the overall size and particularly the width of the sandal, but the rim is part of the structure that holds the straps securely fastened in the sole. I would not object to the rim itself if it were not for another half inch of undesirable additional sole surrounding my foot inside that rim. I am a hiker and use sandals of this type to cross streams. I had been wearing a pair of Nike water sandals for several years, but they eventually fell apart when I kept wearing them when mowing my big wet lawn throughout a very wet season we are having this year. title: Great buy !!!
text: The most comfortable sandles I have ever worn. Walk a lot so these are perfect . So happy with my purchase :)

title: Teva
text: I love Teva sandals. This one runs a bit wide. and I can't adjust them narrower at the toes because it is at it's end of the Velcro.

title: Size 8 - fit perfectly
text: I wear a size 8 almost always unless if I wear a footwear with socks which requires me to get an 8.5. This teva sandals fit perfectly. The straps are adjustable too.

title: Velcro came apart on the strap 1st use
text: nice fitting durable sandals but the Velcro came apart on the strap across my toe the first time I wore the shoe. I had to use Gorilla Glue to repair :( Guess what you pay for??!!

title: Teva Sandle
text: I purchased these BUT they were for my wife. She has a difficult foot to find footwear that feels comfortable. Sandles work well for her and these were a replacement pair for her first pair of Tevas. These "shoes" are comfortable with a good rugged sole that feels good and wears well. She selected a pair where the pricing was good which was another factor in the purchase. A good shoe at a good price. Sounds like a win win to me.

title: Great sandals!
text: I took these out of the box and headed to Disneyland for two long days of constantly being on my feet. These sandals held up even better than I expected and were comfortable for Disneyland and beyond. I couldn't be happier!

title: Wonderful sandals
text: I enjoy these sandals. I wear them every where in the summer. Good quality. Fits as expected. Great buy. I will purchase again

title: Love Tevas - these are awesome!
text: The grip, the rugged, comfortable platform, the quick-drying straps with anti-fray strap pull on the ends, the cool patterned design and colors, the protection around the foot bed by the extra dimension around the foot, the comfort wearing all day (like going barefoot!)...Love these....they are plenty durable and good on all terrains! As I stated, the sole has extra length of about a 1/2" around the entire foot for protection -- some folks may not like that.

title: not a great fit
text: Nice arch support but fit just wasn't for me. No matter how many different ways I adjusted the straps, they kept rubbing against my feet. The search for sport sandals continues.

title: Excellente!
text: Live in sandals all spring and summer. These are very comfortable and easily adjusted. I usually wear a women's 9, but probably could have gone a 1/2 size smaller. Still great shoes.

title: Dressy Tevas
text: I have suffered a stroke and have to deal with feet and ankle swelling. These Tevas are plain black and I can adjust them to fit on any day. Love this product for me.

title: Love these sandals
text: I needed walking sandals for my lifestyle. These fit like they were made for my feet. I hope to wear these whenever the situation calls for sandals. I usually wear a 7.5 or 8 depending on the shoe. Going by reviews, I got these in a 7 and they fit just right. I have a wider foot but only at the front. People said they were slightly wider at the front so it's just what I needed. The velcro straps mean you can customize your fit. The footbed is very smooth, but if you have high arches, you might want to reconsider. I have low arches and these are great for me.

title: exactly what you expect from. Teva
text: I have been needing to replace my tea's for a few years now. I re lucy antsy bought these, afraid they wouldn't be as comfortable. They are awesome. There is a piece of soft rubber on the end of the velcro so you don't have to pull the actual velcro strip to undo them. The velcro fits securely and the color is lovely. Exactly the quality I would expect from Teva.

title: Wear these all day!
text: I've worn Teva sandals for years and these are my favorite style. I can hike, shop, walk on the beach, get them wet in the rain or in a boat, and they are always comfortable. I like the three adjustable points on the straps (toes, ankle and heel) as well as the good arch support. The turquoise color on the straps is muted and not too bright. I wear a 7 1/2 to 8 medium and bought these in 8 medium. They fit perfectly.

title: Excellent summer sandals
text: These sandals are amazing for hiking, water activities like river rafting, and casual summer wear. They are so comfortable, and the fit is customizable. The tread has good grips. I bought the aqua color, and it's gorgeous. I bought a pair of these for one daughter (age 18) last summer, and they were such a hit that I got this pair for my other daughter (age 20). They both love them, and maybe I borrow them sometimes myself. ;-)

title: Great shoe
text: I love these shoes! They fit perfect and are very comfortable! The color is great a well! Will be ordering more!!

title: All models are not created equal
text: Returning these. I've worn Tevas for about 10 years. I am used to the ones that have neoprene padding under all of the plastic bits on the sandal. There ir is no cushion between skin and plastic on this model.

title: They are extremely comfortable and can be worn all day without issue since ...
text: Slightly disappointing that these came to be way to large in the size I ordered them in. However the straps are fully adjustable so they can be made to work. They are extremely comfortable and can be worn all day without issue since the day I got them. Just wish the size was a bit better.

title: The one and only
text: great sandals, very comfortable, reliable and stable on uneven ground. Worth every penny.

title: Beach Sandals
text: Got these for a trip to Mexico. Comfy and waterproof. Not at all dressy...good for basic walking.

title: Perfect for hiking. Very durable.
text: Perfect for hiking or whatever. Very durable. Planning to purchase a lighter style in future since these are kinda thick soled.

title: Just what I needed.
text: I needed these shoes because of a sore foot. The post-surgery boot the doctor was giving me just didn't work, mostly because it was only one shoe, and it caused me to walk unevenly due to a height difference. I needed a pair of shoes, the same height, that would accommodate the support wraps I had around my foot and ankle. These aren't stylish, but the are superbly built and accomplish the task that they are made for. They are easy to get on and off with their Velcro flaps. I have worn them inside and out...even in snow. They are non-slip...a huge plus in my book. The only cons I have noted are that they seem a little too big, but I don't blame the shoe. I am a woman and bought men's shoes, because women's shoes tend to not be wide enough for me. Anyway, a great shoe if you need protection for your feet, and especially if you need a shoe that you can wear with support wraps or boots.

title: Great Quality!
text: Very good slippers, well made they will last a long time the only thing that will wear out is the Velcro. They are very comfortable and the color goes with just about anything.

title: Works For Dad
text: I bought these for my father and he says that they are very comfortable and easy to put on.

title: Quality Made- But, Like walking on Concrete
text: This is a quality slipper with no arch support. Feel like you are walking on concrete. After spending another apx $10 for Dr. Scholl's inserts, I now have a very comfortable pair of slippers. Just add $10 to the purchase price of your slippers if you don't like walking on concrete.

title: Too hard to use
text: Others may not have trouble adjusting these, but I did.. because I have painful feet and also can't bend to fix them it made it too hard for me to adjust them. so I can't really judge..

title: Excellent buy. My Dad prefers these over any other ...
text: Excellent buy. My Dad prefers these over any other shoes for their comfort and ease to put on. GREAT PRODUCT especially for older, diabetic persons who have issues with circulation, etc. in their feet. VERY PLEASED!!!

title: Foam print Shoes
text: These are a nice wide shoe especially if you have a swollen foot that won’t fit most shoes. I would recommend these if you have large swollen feet.

title: QUICK AND NOT TO EASY
text: LINER TOO CHEAP AND SHOE TOO WIDE SHOULD HAVE SENT THEM BACK. GOOD DESIGN BUT I DID NOT NEED THE BACK STRAP AND I ORDERED TOO WIDE.

title: Slippers are just right
text: The adjustible velcro straps are convenient and easy to use. The slippers work for inside or outside activities... Delivery and the packaging were just fine, too. Thank you.

title: Physician Slippers
text: I purchased these for my Dad--due to a disability, his ambulation is at times compromised. He needs a sturdy slipper that also has a no-slip sole, particularly when he has to walk out to his mailbox when the driveway has ice or is snow-covered. The two velcro closures for a customized fit have really made this a winner for him!

title: My elderly father hated them
text: I'm sure they'll do the trick for some people esp if they only need them around the house. If you're needing something they can feel good wearing in public and are easy to put on, you might look at Florsheim Men's Dorado Sporty Slip-Ons.

title: These slippers are wonderful! They can be adjusted to his feet and ...
text: I bought these slippers for my father (almost 90 with diabetes). He sometimes has trouble with his feet swelling and getting sores from his shoes. These slippers are wonderful! They can be adjusted to his feet and are comfortable, he can wear them all day instead of shoes. I was a little leary about the expense, but would buy them again in a heart beat.

title: LOVE
text: My dad has severe heart issues and his feet are swollen much of the time. He says these are extremely comfortable and soothing to wear. Fantastic slippers.

title: Good for Diabetic with swollen feet
text: My husband has diabetes and his feet and legs can swell up quite a bit. Because of the wider velcro tongue and longer tabs on each side it is easier to "resize" the shoe when his feet are really swollen.. It is also easier to slip his feet in the shoe as the tongue goes back almost to the toe. There are 2 things I would like to see that would make this shoe perfect.: 1) a tab in the back heel to help you pull up the slipper; and 2) making this slipper in a short boot height so the material would come up and around the ankle because when the foot and ankle swell up it is sometimes hard to keep the foot in the heel.. Also - most diabetics have cold feet all the time so the added material up the ankle would help with the insulation.

title: Life saver shoes
text: I bought these for my husband after cancer treatments. His feet were extremely swollen. I bought multiple kinds of slides etc. With Velcro in an attempt to find something for him to wear on his feet. I was at a loss until I found these on amazon. His normal shoe size is 8 1/2. I bought a 9 wide, though with the multiple options for Velcro "resizing" I didn't necessarily have to go to the higher size, but they fit great. These are a life saver. He loves them, they are very comfortable and soft/cushioned for his feet. As his feet have changed sizes both up and down in swelling, they adjust beautifully. And with the substantial sole they can be used outside or inside the house. They are the only "shoe" he can wear. When you look at them, they don't look like "medical shoes". We have found that the additional Velcro on the heel is so helpful. I would recommend for anyone who is having edema or other "sizing" issues with their feet.

title: Wide not available in all sizres
text: These shoes are not as wide as advertised..I ordered 13 2x but would have a 14/2x if avalible.

title: Easy to get on, well made product, true to size
text: This is a well made product. I believe they are true to size. My husband is an 11 and we ordered a 11 1/2nbecause his feet are swollen due to health reasons. The 11 1/2 was too large but we kept them, as he is in a wheel chair and it is not a problem. They are easy to put on and look like they would be comfortable to walk in.

title: Finally a shoe that's easy to put on!!
text: At last shoes that are easy to put on! My father in law has large wide feet and is wheel chair bound. The staff love how easy these go on and they look decent enough for church. A great find.

title: These are fantastic! My husband has had great difficulty finding shoes ...
text: These are fantastic! My husband has had great difficulty finding shoes he can wear, due to edema. These don't look bad, and adjust totally to fit the wearer. For getting around, these are perfect. For formal wear, not so much, but we don't have that need.

title: Great!

title: Upper is NOT all wool, lining and inner sole are synthetic, ick.

title: Love the Velcro Adjustability!

title: Adjustable fit makes these perfect!

title: Not pretty, but quite functional

He gets around a little with a walker when he is not in a wheelchair. They were easy-on and easy-off, as the entire forefoot opens/closes.

title: Easy on and off

title: Good shoes.

title: The best boot!
text: I love, love, love these boots! I only wish it would rain more or get colder where I live, otherwise there really is no reason to wear such boots. They're very warm and keep your feet dry. If this helps, I'm 5'2 and three quarters, I ordered a size 7, and they come up to just below my kneecaps. They fit true to size. I have sort of thick calves (mostly jiggly fat) and they do not squeeze my calves at all. There is plenty of room for skinny jeans. Also, they do not let air in so you might want to wear moisture-wicking socks (nike makes some) to prevent a sweaty feet smell if your feet sweat a lot.

title: Best value and look rubber boots!

title: Beautiful, functional rain boots!
text: These are amazing rain boots!! I love that they aren't clunky, rubbery looking, crazy pattern boots. I have gotten so many compliments and they look like actual riding boots! They are tighter than other rain boots so you can really only wear them over leggings or skinny jeans, but that is pretty much all I wear anyways. Because they're tight and rubbery they can be a little difficult to remove after an entire days wear, and they definitely leave your feet sweaty, but at least they keep the rain out! The dark brown boots look expensive. I'll definitely be getting another pair if/when these fall apart, I'll also purchase in other colors for the fall.
