text: Very cute but I couldn't even get my foot into them they were so stiff. The matte rubber also attracted tons of fur from my dogs.

title: Too Stiff and small in leg
text: Leg is small-cannot get pant legs inside. Heel rubs--as a diabetic not good. Tried heavy socks and could not get them on. Akward to walk in. No give. Driving is very awkward due to stiffness. Not a good feel on gas and brake pedals. Skippery on wet steps.

title: comfy and eye catching
text: We bought these a little big based on other reviews. They fit comfortably and have received several compliments. They seem to be made of better quality material than the last pair she had which were purchased at target.

title: Long lasting
text: I was and am still very surprised at how well these boots have held up. After being worn every day for about 5-6 months a year for the past 2.5 years (during the mud and bathing season), they show no sign of cracking or weakness. I will be replacing them soon and retiring them to home use as I do not want to destroy them at the barn I love them that much <3

title: Five Stars
text: These boots are lovely! I am very please with the look, the fit, and the quality.

title: Not wide enough
text: I have a 14 inch calf and was excited to see the opening was large enough to accommodate. However, it needs a zipper in order to be able to put your jeans or pants tucked in. Instead your pants just wad up around the knees. Too bad. Returned.

title: perfect for narrow feet!
text: I'm a 7.5 and I ordered an 8 and it fits great. I have narrow feet, ankles and calves, so these run narrow and it's perfect for me.

title: Meh..
text: This is the first time I haven’t loved a Dansko shoe. They are ok, but I would not get another pair.

title: Third pair!!!
text: LOVE these sandals they are AWESOME!!! They are so comfortable and go with everything for the spring and summer months! I am sure I will order yet another pair before the end of the month!!!

title: Pretty and comfortable
text: I love this shoe. I have one other pair in another color. The size I wear in other brands is 38, but I need a 39 in Dansko's. The footbed is so comfortable and supportive. It is hard to find a sandal that is both nice to look at and be supportive at the same time.

title: These are very comfortable!, I wear a size 8amd my foot ...
text: These are very comfortable!,I wear a size 8amd my foot comes to the very end!! The 9 would have been too big!! However I do like them!,and so comfortable!!! They don’t come in half size !!only problem!!,

title: Dansko Sandals
text: I have five pair of Dansko sandals. Love them. They are comfortable and well made.

title: Comfort AND style????? I'll take three!
text: I'll start by saying that I am NOT of the comfort shoe camp. I live in stilettos, willing to sacrifice comfort for style, but in small doses. A dear friend recommended Dansko pro clogs years ago for serious walking and I got hooked; but only for emergency comfort needs. I was skeptical about these at first, but ordered them for a trip we've planned down South in the sweltering August humidity. I was blown away by the stream lined fit. These are not clunky or geriatric at all. The sand dollar is a good neutral. I ordered the red and metallic blue as well. These give better back support than sneakers and, might I add, a lot more style! I'm sold.

title: I love these sandals!
text: I bought a pair of these sandals at the beginning of summer and loved them so much, I bought a second pair. I have wide feet and have had several surgeries, so shoes never fit right. These sandals have adjustable straps, so they can be perfectly adjusted to fit my Frankenstein feet. I walk 5-7 miles a day and these are great. For the first time in my life, I've not had to wear band-aids or foot tubes with these shoes. They look really cute and fashionable - not at all like the clunky ortho shoes of yesteryear!

title: Love This Sandal!!!
text: Love this sandal. Great for working on your feet or walking while traveling. I own them in 4 colors!

title: Favorites
text: Dansko works for me. I have several pairs of Dansko shoes in different styles. Fit and support are just right.

title: Loved these so much, I ordered several more pair
text: I bought my first pair from the Walking Company while shopping. I was already wearing a pair of Dansko clogs but they were still breaking in and my heals were getting blisters. I slipped these on and it was instant relief. Amazing comfort..plus when I walked into Coach down the hall, I immediately got a "Oh! Cute shoes!" from one of the young sales girls. Which made my middle-aged ego glow. lol. Unfortunately, I bought a couple pairs of Dankso and had to forgo the Coach purse I was coveting. Ah well, I will get more use out of the shoes.

title: Super comfort, cute enough.
text: Love these. Extremely comfortable and excellent arch support! I have them in bone and black but didn't like the brown color so I returned them.

title: Perfect shoe for stepping out at work or evening!
text: My job requires walking and standing all day. It is perfect for many widths. My foot is an A and adjusting is a breeze. I have worn this particular style for several years and purchase an extra pair in case it is discontinued. If you are older and still want to dress in a heel you will love the wider base which I find gives me the confidence and stability needed. Dansko is the only shoe I can wear all day, every day in total comfort. Beautiful shoe.

title: love the shoe
text: I bought the shoes to wear on vacation at Disneyland. I wanted a comfortable shoe to walk in. I owned a pair of walking shoes from Dansko manyu years ago and loved them. I walked all over Europe in them. I was disappointed when I couldn't find another pair exactly like the first pair and settled on these. My old pair stretched out and became loose. So I decided to buy a smaller size. My foot is really between sizes. I chose this pair because the buckle allows for adjustment if they loosen. The only downside was that the raised arch didn't hit me quite right. I wore them around the house for a couple of days before deciding to not send them back. I intended to go shopping before my vacation to see if I could find another pair of shoes that were more comfortable but ran out of time. I ended up taking the Dansko shoes and they were fine - very comfortable. By the way we were at Disneyland for three days, so I wore them three days straight with no problems. I have since worn them quite a bit. They are very comfortable and really cute. I love them and would buy another pair. Dansko shoes are expensive but worth it if you want a good walking shoe that will last for years.

title: This one is a WOW!
text: Blue is my favorite color, and this sandal is as blue as it gets, shiny, holographic and totally fun! Plus, the fit was just right out of the box. I couldn't be happier, as I remember another wonderful Dansko sandal called Mette, which I loved and wore two sets out completely, and wished I had bought several more. Then I found this style and took a chance, and bingo, the perfect sandal for my wide feet. They are cushioned just right for my arches, and this also helps for plantar fasciitis, which my poor left foot has suffered in the past until I gave up flat shoes. Recommend the style and the color wholeheartedly. One small quibble is that the "patent" material may not hold up the way a leather would, but for the grins I'll get when wearing these, I will pamper them and buy another pair in a more practical color, such as beige or tan. So glad to find this comfy and versatile sandal. The reduced price was also another great 5 starred feature.

title: she loves them and are very comfortable! and the price is fair
text: I purchased these sandals as a gift for my mom, she loves them and are very comfortable! and the price is fair.

title: Cute & comfortable sandal
text: I've worn them a couple of times now, love the short heel. They fit as expected, I wear a size 39 (8.5) and are super comfy! I will look for more of the same style in different colors. Will be my summer go-to sandal for sure!

title: Favorite Shoe!
text: Over the past 3 years, I have purchased 6 pairs in 6 different colors/fabrics. I LOVE THESE SHOES! I hope Dansko never changes the Sophie, but just keeps bringing out new colors and fabrics each season. I wear them with everything: shorts, dresses, trousers, even around the house.

title: Cute and comfortable.
text: I had plantar fasciitis and am now very particular about shoes. These are perfect, never hurt my feet even walking miles in Vegas. They are so worth the money. Bought the black ones as well. After a year of heavy wear they still look great!

title: Love the sandals
text: Love the sandals. I have a 37 with the clogs but the sandals run a bit smaller. If you have a 37 EU or 7 US I would recommend you choose the next fit especially for your big toe. Comfortable and dressy.

title: Cute, Supportive, Run Small
text: I really like Dansko shoes. They are incredibly supportive and constructed very well. And, they are extremely durable shoes. My problem with Sophie is that this particular style seems to run a bit small. I have a couple pairs and they are all the alike. I have tried other Dansko styles that seem to run true to size. I suppose I will steer clear of this style in the future. Don't let my review stop you from buying Sophie as no two feet are alike. They are a very nice shoe.

title: Runs small
text: These are much prettier than pic. Love them. I usually wear an 8 and ordered the 8.5-9 because of reviews. Very glad I did. They definitely fit like an 8.

title: I am a Dansko convert....
text: My shoe collection has exploded over the past few years and it now includes many pairs of Danskos. I have two pairs of the Sophie, one in Black Moray and the other in Blue Shagreen. They are a fun sandal and are very comfortable. I like the soft footbed and the heel gives you a bit of height but is also stable which is important to me. I have sprained my ankle a few times and really have to be careful on it. I don't have any worries with my Danskos. Some may say they are a little orthopedic looking, I don't find them to be. I wear my Danskos with dresses and skirts mostly but they can be worn with anything really, jeans, pants and shorts too. They are easily dressed up or down. I especially like my Blue Shagreen ones, I have no other shoe like it, I call them my "Disco shoes". My black ones go with everything, I have some jeans that are long and drag on the floor, my Sophies will fix that problem. It's nice that the Sophie comes in so many colors as well, something available for everyone! 5 stars!

title: go one size up!
text: For some reason, this particular style of Danskos require me to go one size up. So far, I've been a 38 in all the other styles I've tried (flats and those that slope down at the toe), but I require a 39 in the Sophie style. I have three pairs now.... love, love, love them. I have trouble with my feet in almost all shoes, but I can wear these all day without my feet aching. Straps are adjustable. Arch support is adequate for me. They are a clog, and the base does not bend. If that bothers you, it would not be the shoe for you. But my main goal is comfortable shoes that are cute, and these fit the bill!

title: Super comfortable
text: Fashionable and with great support! I have plantar fasciitis and can wear these Sandals for hours! Love the neutral co,or with a faux print for added style. Goes with everything! Dresses, jeans, capris. Perfect for summer.

title: Can't say these were great
text: I have sesitive skin everywhere. LOVE the Dansko brand and have many pairs. This pair rubbed my skin to blisters in no time flat. Gave them away

title: Great arch support & comfort
text: I love these shoes! They fit like my other Danskos, and are just as comfortable. They have a great arch support, and feel secure on my feet. I don't know why it took me so long to look for a Dansko sandal, but I'm glad I finally did.

title: She loves them!
text: You have to break these shoes in, but after that they will fit like a glove. Being in an office setting, and having to deal with plantar fasciitis, this is saying a lot. She now has two pair. :)

title: Smaller than you might think and uncomfortable straps
text: I wanted to love these sandals so much. I think they're really cute in the photos. I ordered based on the estimated US size (e.g. 9.5-10), which should have been perfect. They were WAY too small, literally too short. So I returned them for free (THANKS AMAZON) and got the next size up (10.5-11) which seems so weird because I'm never in a shoe larger than a 10. While this next size is probably the right size, they still felt small, as I found I had to change the buckle to the widest hole to slip my foot in naturally. Then my foot wanted to slide down the shoe, with my toes practically sticking out the ends. So I compromised and adjusted the toe strap smaller to keep my foot from sliding, but it just didn't feel right. I know everyone's foot is different, so this clearly isn't the problem for many, but for me, the straps are not in the right place on my foot. The toe strap covers the pinkie and second-smallest toe completely, which feels weird when I walk. The other strap feels like it's too high on my foot. I can tell it would not be comfortable to walk in these for very long or very far. They'd be fine if I just stood in place because the footbed is amazing. SO comfortable. It's ju

title: Looks modern, not clunky.
text: Really nice sandal. True, all the reviews that said they run wide. Also run short. I measure a 7-1/2 and generally get a size 38. The 38 had to go back. Was able to keep this shoe because both straps are adjustable. I have a narrow foot and similar sandals from Dansko had to go back because the toe or ankle strap had little or no adjustment. Like the size of the heel and platform. Looking forward to wearing this shoe in total comfort.

title: Comfy, not age appropriate.
text: Just a smidgen small, but for the 10 minutes I walked around my kitchen, seem very comfortable. They will be going back, as the pink/gold holographic pattern are more befitting a tweenager than anyone over the age of 20. ...Or 30.

title: Decent "upgrade" from the original Vasque Mantra shoes
text: Purchased these for my husband. He had a very worn pair of the original Vasque Mantra shoes and put me on the hunt to find a replacement pair. I quickly discovered that Vasque no longer makes the Mantra and that they had replaced it with this 2.0 version. I showed the pictures to my husband and after about a week of thinking about it, he had me order them. They were delivered quickly via our Prime 2 day shipping. They were boxed and packaged very well. Hubby put them on and was immediately impressed with them. He rarely purchases footwear off the internet but chose to do so with these as he had a very similar pair in the past and knew what to expect. The differences between his old Mantra and these new Mantra 2.0 are very few. Mostly he noted that the 2.0 has a slight variation in the materials used. And the color offerings are slightly off from his old pair of the original Mantra. But, he is pleased and has been wearing these for a few months now.

title: This is my second pair of these shoes
text: I bought my first pair at the Alpine Shop in Kirkwood, Missouri and was amazed how quickly they broke in after wearing them only a day or two. I bought the second pair from Amazon (different color). Same experience with the second pair breaking them in and wearing them almost all day is no problem.

title: Sturdy Hiker.
text: 2 weeks in, I have done about 15 miles of rough, rocky trail hiking and 10 miles of smooth trail walking. Sturdy and comfortable so far. I'll know more about this hiker in couple of months and how it wears in a year. Star rating is for less than a months use.

title: Light and comfortable
text: I gave it as a birthday present. it was very light and comfortable. He likes it. He use it for trekking and short hiking.

title: Didn't work for me
text: Returned these shoes after receiving them and realizing how high they ride on my ankles. They instantly started digging into my ankle bones right where the skin is thinnest and most prone to cuts or blisters. I need shoes that ride a little below my ankle for this reason. Otherwise these shoes look nice and I'm sure they hold up well. But they didn't work for me.

title: Great shoes
text: I have worn these shoes for a while now. I bought them for a trip overseas. They need some break in time, the shoes where a little on the stiff side. I wore them on a trip to New Orleans. We had a down pour! I had to walk 5 blocks in the rain. Some times with no choice but to walk through about 2 inches of water. The outside of the shoes was soaked inside my feet stayed dry!

title: Vasque Mantra 2.0
text: A friend recommended the Mantra 2.0. These are fine quality. Easy to see the value over the less expensive shoes of this type I've worn in the pass. MY foundation is much more stable and secure in these shoes and at 78 that's a big deal.

title: Light, comfortable and gives you confidence in a hiking shoe....
text: These hiking shoes are the bomb (in a good way). They are very comfortable without a lot of weight associated to them. On the trail, these give you confidence due to the stickiness and have been more than pleased with performance. I actually like these so much, I will be purchasing at least another pair of them for future use. Yes, they may be a bit more money, but in my experience and opinion, well worth the confidence they deliver on the trail.

title: Beautiful, but long and skinny
text: These shoes are beautiful and I would definitely buy again and recommend, but I'd get the wide version next time. These are narrow--too narrow for my non-wide feet. They aggravated the long lasting corn on my toe. The length of the shoe is actually a bit long, especially for the narrow width. I returned mine to REI (after quite a while!) and exchanged them for something else.

title: Fit so well, I immediately bought a back up pair
text: I did not rate the arch support since I use arch support inserts; which fit perfectly into the shoe once your remove their foot bed.

title: I wear these every day
text: My only complaint is the factory insole is not good, at least for me. I wish Vasque had more of their product line available in a wide foot. I have issues with tendonitis in my feet and I've figured out that most any Vasque shoe or boot, with a vibram sole, in a wide size plus a fancy "orange" insole keeps the flareups from occurring. Unfortunately, trying to find an 11.5 wide size is difficult.

title: I wear these every day
text: My only complaint is the factory insole is not good, at least for me. I wish Vasque had more of their product line available in a wide foot. I have issues with tendonitis in my feet and I've figured out that most any Vasque shoe or boot, with a vibram sole, in a wide size plus a fancy "orange" insole keeps the flareups from occurring. Unfortunately, trying to find an 11.5 wide size is difficult.

title: Pure quality, ruggedness and looks
text: Despite the size being a bit off for me, the shoes are pure quality and looks. Comfortable out of the box, attractive everyday shoe. They are .75 to 1 inches narrower than the Keen Targhee II or Voyager, and for me this difference was significant from the perspective of stability--a wider shoe increases stability with mild to moderate climbing and hiking (unless your doing more serious climbing). The toe-box on the Vasque's was a bit small for my needs, but nonetheless would be very functional for someone with with a D width foot or less. Overall, you can't go wrong with this shoe. Pure quality, ruggedness, looks.

title: Impressed
text: Shoes look very nice, and fit maybe a little bit large though not enough to make any bad critic on them. The shoe design overall is well built, and are very comfortable. I usually buy merrell's but it seems that they don't last very long. I think these shoes should last longer then the merrell's I usually get, and right now am impressed in Vasque's quality.

title: A Match Made in Heaven
text: I would wear them to bed, if I could. You remember that feeling when you were a kid and you didn't want to wear your shoes outside because they might get dirty? Well, say hello to your childhood. I love this shoe. Sometime from '99 to 2001, I bought a pair of Vasque Sundowner hiking boots. now those boots were hardcore and, quite possible, the best shoe purchase I have ever made. They lasted for years, unitl I lost them in a move. (Yeah, I cry everytime I think about it.) These shoes may not be as hard core, but they are every bit as comfortable without the long break-in time that the sundowner had. You may think that Merrills are the path to happiness and I say, "NAY!" Stay your wallet. I find myself going through Merrills at a rate of about a pair a year. These shoes show no sign of that. I love them...I love you, Vasque.

title: husband hikes at work
text: My husband and I own a factory and he is all over the factory several times a day. After other nice brands wearing out I decided to look for "hiking shoes" These have been the best footwear for him on an everyday basis. It's hot in Florida but he has not complained of them being unconfortably hot. He loves these...If they can stand up to what my husband does every day they can stand up to any trail.

title: These shoes are perfect with a Dr Scholl insert!
text: These Vasque shoes are my go to shoes! Have walked ten miles a day in both Europe and the Continental US in summer and winter.

title: Love, love and love these shoes
text: Love, love and love these shoes. I don't hike but wear them every day on my job as a General Contractor. They are the most comfortable shoe to wear when you stand all day, or go up and down ladders as well. I have a wide foot and the double E's work for me. Some shoes advertised as double E's are wide enough for me, but the Vasque's are perfect. I give them a big thumbs up!

title: Wouldn't buy again.
text: Not very comfortable shoes. Hurt my feet. Part of the seam on the left shoe rubs a toe. The right shoe is tight and uncomfortable. Soles are fairly hard and could use more padding. The color is a lot darker brown than the image on the listing.

title: Great shoe but wide is not-so-wide
text: This shoe is VERY comfortable to wear...with one exception. I ordered the wide size and, for a wide it's, well, not. They will break-in a little wider, but out of the box, it feels only marginally wider than a medium. Since it's basically impossible to find this in the stores, I tried other brands before buying this. The Moab Ventilator from Merrell, for example, has enough room to fit a small army in. I own a pair of Timberland White Ledge in non-wide and these are only marginally wider than the White Ledges. It's not enough to make me want to return them, but I wish the wide was definitely a little wider. Outside of that exception, it's one of the most comfortable pairs of shoes I've ever worn. It is super comfortable on the bottom of my feet. The shoe is high-quality and very stylish as well. I definitely recommend these, but if you have really wide feet, you may want to consider the Moab Ventilators - though they are lower quality and frankly really ugly. There is also a version of these same shoes with Gore-Tex if you want the waterproofing - though there are complaints on Amazon's listing of those being really narrow, perhaps more so than these are. The Gore-Tex version is mo

title: I love these shoes but the price has gone up way too much!
text: I wear these shoes daily and do a lot of outdoor work. They're good for about a year. They went up in price by $40.00! I can't afford that kind of increase. In less than a year they went from $90 to $130. I'm bummed out. I'm going to check out another line made by Columbia - I understand they're a good value.

title: This is the regular ventilated version. NOT the waterproof version with Gor-Tex.
text: The top review is unintentionally misleading buyers stating that it's 2 star rated because their feet got wet. It's got mesh ventilation features clearly in the photos. Expecting waterproofing when buying a mesh ventilated shoe is not the fault of the shoe. There is a separate listing for the Gor-Tex waterproof version here: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B005EP1FBO

title: not a good Vasque shoe
text: These did not hold up. I have been wearing Vasque boots for years- currently have six pair. The Breeze is my go to boot, fantastic for hiking. The Mantra was not used for hiking- it was used for summer wear around town. In two summers the stitching at the toe joint tore- both sides of both shoes. I bought another pair at the same time and have just started wearing those. Don't know how they will hold up. However wearing them around the office they make a loud flopping noise- kind of like flip flops- but the fit is right. I have no idea what is causing that, hopefully it will stop when they are fully broken in. But I would not buy these shoes again.

title: Great right out of the box
text: No break in time needed. Just an outstanding boot. Very comfortable and supportive. I have had wide flat feet all of my life. Put them on, took the dog for a 2 mile walk with absolutely no issues.

title: Great fit for my foot.
text: After trying many on, I loved this as the best fit for my particular foot. I do use aftermarket insoles on most all active shoes.

title: Vasque Men's Mantra 2.0 Hiking Shoe
text: If you have a high instep, consider passing, since the tongue will just meet the eyelet sides-for the hype and price I do better with the high tech brads from china half this cost. Build quality is ther, but so what. If I buy bigger then it's too long and tripping. The girth size matters too!

title: Consistent and high quality, exact fit
text: My husband now has three pair of Vasque shoes. All fit as expected. The quality is first rate. His first pair are now six-years-old and going strong, sound footbed and sole. Hold up to hard use since he uses his first pair for work! The latest pair meet our expectations which are high.

title: Great Out Of The Box But Moderate Arch Support At Best
text: Fits very comfortably right out of the box but haven't worn them for an extended period yet. I may return them. Color is darker than I expected. They are basically black. Arch support seems moderate at best. I'm a little concerned they might not be ridged enough once they are worn in. Probably need to invest in some good replacement insoles. Lack of support is why I got rid of my Merrell Moab's. I'm not sure these are any better. That being said, Moab's are popular too so it might just be me.

title: Comfortable right out of the box!
text: Purchased these shoes for my daily walks (45 minutes). shoes very comfortable out of the box. I like the vibram soles, but they are difficult to clean out if you walk in mud. I also where these with jeans when I go on casual outings. High quality shoe, you will be pleased with this purchase!

title: Nice shoes
text: I normally wear a12and these seem true to size. My foot is narrow and fit seems good.

title: Shoe Lovers need These!!!
text: Best shoe(s) on the market. Comfortable right out of the box! Machine washable, casual tennis shoes, or with this pair, sleek enough to wear with dressier clothing.

title: Not what I expected and No Free Return Shipping!!!
text: The fit was fine but it wasn't the type of fabric that I was expecting. I was going to return them but when I found out it was going to cost me $13 just to ship them back I decided to keep them. The shoes only cost me $30 (that was for shipping and everything) so I wasn't going to ship them back to only get a refund of $17.00. They don't feel as good as the other go walk shoes I got from my local Shoes Sensation store but for the price they will do!

title: Go walk shoe
text: This shoe is very comfortable. I have them in three colors and wear them all year with shorts or slacks.

title: Too small and much too hot
text: I ordered an 8 1/2 and received an 8-9 so these should have fit. My toes came to the end, the toe box is not as roomy as expected and the shoe is so hot I can't stand to wear them. When I first put them on they felt cushioned, but have no support when doing any major (airport) walking. My sister loves them but they are not for me.

title: Buying my 4th pair
text: This is my 3rd pair of Sketchers go walk shoes. They are comfortable from the start. The only thing I wish is that they were just a little bit wider.

title: Flat and flimsy.
text: No bouncy, cushioned inner sole; both outer toe areas pinch and I ordered 1/2 size up so this should not be happening. These shoes are flat and flimsy, and I am 1* disappointed. All my other Skechers are my favorite shoes... these I can wear only for watering my back yard garden.

title: Go walk
text: LOVE, LOVE these shoes. They are like walking on pillows. Extremely comfortable. I now have 3 pair of them. Will definitely buy another pair this winter. Highly recommend to anyone on their feet all day or just around the house.

title: Defective inside
text: Received my shoes in the mail today and the inside of the right shoe was defective. Thread showing on inside seam. Will be sending these back for full refund.

title: Every shoe should be a Sketcher Go=Walk!
text: Seriously, these are the best shoes ever! That's why I have to get them on amazon bc they aren't the latest Sketcher style and you can't find them in stores. It's cute and comfy and reasonably priced and wears very, very well!

title: I really love the light weight
text: I really love the light weight. I wonder why the soles are not as much cushion as my last pair. They are supposed to be the same. Anyway I wear them to work for versatility

title: Comfy!
text: These skechers are lightweight, cushioned and stretch, so there are no hard points. I have 2 others for the Summer, but these have black soles and are great for Winter. Can't wait for Spring and the new colors.

title: Love them! They are Sketchers after all
text: Love them! They are Sketchers after all. Will keep on wearing them until they stretch.

title: great shoe
text: Wow. So light, so comfortable. Will purchase another pair in one of your bright Colors. This is like no other shoe I have ever worn.

title: Bad buy!
text: I ordered the black in this shoe. I had already gotten the navy and taupe. I loved the ones I had gotten earlier. The arch support was great and the shoes fit great. I don’t think the black ones are real Sketchers. They have no arch support and after a few wears, they feel like I am wearing the boxes. Big waste of money!

title: Narrow, small and uncomfortable
text: I have an older pair of GoWalks that I love, but not these. These are very small, narrow and uncomfortable. A larger size might be better, but I decided on another pair of sneakers and returned these.

title: Great comfort shoe
text: I add my own arch support, so did not give it 5 stars. I do love these Skechers slip ons - they are very comfy!

title: Best shoes ever!!!
text: I was looking for the perfect slip on to wear for the long walk in the city I have from my car to my building. These are perfect!! Very light weight and SO comfortable. I just order another pair in a different color. They are true to size. Shipping was slow but worth it. I would highly recommend these shoes!

title: My favorite shoes!
text: I love these shoes! This is my 3rd pair. I have gray, white and now navy. I can wear these all day and my feet don't hurt or feel sore. I recommend these shoes to everyone I know. They are also very lightweight and it's hard to believe they have support but they do! I used to buy $150 walking shoes that were comfortable but I don't wear those anymore since I got the Sketchers Go Walk shoes.

title: easy to wear, but not for too long
text: I feel some fatigue in the sides of my feet when wearing these shoes. Probably due to the stretchy material that fits snugly so as to keep your foot from sliding around. However, they are a dream to walk in. I can't wear these for an extended length of time, because of the snug fit around the sides. title: Really comfortable clog
text: I call this a clog, because that is the general design of the Merrill slide, but it is far more comfortable that the typical clog because of the sole. Merrill slides have a soft and flexible sole, unlike the stiff wood or hard plastic sole of most clogs. This means the shoe flexes as you walk, and provides excellent cushioning. One other difference that adds to comfort, and is not obvious in the photos, is the heel indentation. In a typical clog, your heel goes right to the back edge of the shoe. With a Merrill slide, there is a shallow indentation for your heel, and a small ridge that fits behind your heel. This means your heel is held in place, again a major comfort item. I now have three pairs of Merrill slides, all different styles but basically the same shoe. One is a matte fabric, another is a textured fabric, and this is soft leather over the foot. This one, in particular, looks really nice with jeans or my scrubs at work. The leather is soft but cleans easily with just water. I wear my Merrill slides all the time now and can't recommend them highly enough!

title: Plastic New Balance Logo On Left and Right Shoe Tongues--Two Different Colors???
text: This was purchased for a gift for a relative. Recipient immediately pointed out that the New Balance logo on the right tongue has black and gray lettering on a gray background, as in the listing photo. The left tongue has black lettering on a shiny silver background. It's not enough of an issue to return the sneakers, but for the price paid, I'm subtracting one star! The sneakers look oddly mismatched. Recipient said they are comfortable. Adding to this review--Other reviewers have said these sneakers smell like cat urine. I thought it was a joke. It's not. These shoes do not smell, they REEK. It is impossible to describe how BAD the odor is. STINK, STINK, STINK, STINK. PEW! If I could re-rate this shoe, I would give it zero stars. Your friends will not want to be in the same room with you, that's how bad the odor is. SICKENING. NO JOKE.

If PUMA would fix this, they would be perfect, but now the only solution is to cut out the tag. Update: I ordered another pair and there doesn't seem to be any improvement with the tag. They came with 2 pairs of laces, in different colors, but one pair is very wide, unfortunately. I'm not a fan of super-wide laces, but they at least had the good sense to make the more narrow pair, the more difficult color to obtain. The super-wide pair is white, which can easily be replaced anywhere you can find laces. I see many comments on the sizing being small, but I don't know that I agree. They may be just slightly narrow, but I wear the same size as I do with Nike athletic shoes. In contrast, I have to size up with New Balance shoes. text: Nice traction on soles and great color....Fits pretty true to size(did need to wear a little to stretch out)

title: Men's MW759 Country Walking Shoe by New Balance
text: I ordered this pair of walking shoes to replace an old pair of NB Athletic Shoes, white, that finally were too far gone to keep, even for mowing the lawn, which they had been deligated to for several years. This new pair will be used for walking until they finally also go on the yard work. The tongue is unnecessairly thick, but the shoe overall is comfortable, right out of the box. Not a bad looking shoe, but it does look a little to fuddy duddy. This term, pretty much sizes my in general purchase of shoes. I don't expect my purchases to look styleish or trendy, but when I do buy, they always seem to be this way, as is this pair of shoes. I now live in the South where shoes are hot on the feet, about half the time and sandles, thongs or water shoes is the norm. I wonder how the common man can stand to wear work boots or work shoes in this environment of heat and sweat. This shoe is a functional walking shoe, which is comfortable and reasonably priced. Good enough for the likes of me.

title: As Expected
text: I use this type shoe, it's my favorite. These shoes were as I expected in all aspects. Shoes are comfortable, fit as expected, picture is precise to the shoe itself. No fault or complaint with this product in any manner....

title: Comfortable and good looking
text: Bought these for my husband because his athletic shoes were so old and he hates to shop. He loves these and they fit him well - more comfortable than his previous athletic shoes.

title: comfortable shoes
text: bought this shoe for my husband who has problems with his feet. he had been looking for another pair of shoes and is happy that this one arrived in perfect condition.

title: These are the best athletic shoes I have ever owned.
text: I am very pleased with these shoes. They are so comfortable that I have worn them with a suit while attending church.

title: These shoes were recommended to help with supination
text: I can wear these all day and don't need an insert. These shoes were recommended to help with supination. They do seem to feel a little more supportive in that realm, and I have yet to roll my ankle while wearing them

title: Maybe order a half size up
text: I wear a size 9.5 but returned the 9.5s I bought and got 10s. They fit okay, but they aren't immediately comfortable, as I was hoping, and as previous walking shoes have been. Still, I'm hopeful, and they look good.

title: good knock-around shoe
text: It is a good knock-around shoe, fits as I expected it too and I would buy again perhaps a different style. I have always liked NB

title: The length is close
text: These are very comfortable . The width is right on but the length is just adequate, no room for heavy socks. I am not going to send them back but if I were ordering again I would order a half size larger. They look good also!

title: Keep Your Puppies Happy
text: I've worn several times and they are a very comfortable show. Good quality and value. I recommend highly.

title: Very comfortable walking shoe
text: This is my third pair of these and my 10th pair of earlier model New Balance walking shoes. Very comfortable for walking/standing.

title: Great Walking Show
text: Really like these shoes. Pounding out about on average 6 miles a day walking in these and my feet feel great. At tad narrow at the front, but they seem to be stretching out a bit and really fit nice. I generally wear a 10.5, but these are 11 and dont feel too big. Would absolutely order another pair if these hold up to wear and tear..

title: Hubby likes it
text: My hubby is hard on his shoes, so I like to find him good ones at a reduced price, such as these. he likes the fit and feel of New Balance, so these will be his next pair when his current ones are too tattered to wear anymore. Good grippy sole for our rocky western trails, and decent laces that shouldn't break with his hard use.

title: REALLY DISAPPOINTING 4E WAY TOO NARROW
text: This is probably the 15th pair of NB shoes I have bought over the years. 8EEEE fits perfectly in their traditional shoes. I ordered 8.5EEEE and that's what they say but they are far narrower than the others and with significantly less toe room. Really disappointing that NB has done this. Same applies to their slip on topsider shoes. The conventional ones fit fine but the slip-on's are way too narrow. Somebody at NB made the decision to mis label these shoes ( probably due to low demand for 4E thinking purchasers would never notice. I ordered them because I needed a professional looking hiking shoe for a business meeting on an rugged site.

title: Do NOT Have The Fit New Balance Became Known For
text: I have always hated Nike footware and preferred New Balance because New Balance fit me better and the heal did not slip. These New Balance slip on the heal like the Nike did. They are a little too snug width wise though. Length wise they are correct. If you order 1/2 size bigger lenth wise such as a 10 instead of a 9 1/2 they will slip. If you are guestimating, I recommend keeping the same size yet choose the next wider width. The the NOT same New Balance fit of days of old. I recommend trying your New Balance shoes on in a store and not gambling on the internet.

title: Very comfortable shoe
text: I find these shoes very comfortable during my walks. I usually walk 50 minutes or so at least three times a week. As far as quality I was disappointed with these shoes. The soles began to come apart after 10 months. I used this shoes for everyday tasks such as going to the store and working. I have another pair that I use for walking in the park and these are several months older and doing okay. I don't know but the quality is definitely different between the two shoes.

title: This is an outstanding shoe
text: After ordering I began to have second thoughts considering some of the reviews suggesting that the sizing on this shoe was not specifically too good. After wearing it for my daily walk approx. 10-12 miles I was totally satisfied with the decision to order it. Very comfortable, and with my inserts easy on the foot. I would highly recommend this shoe without reservations.

title: NB walking shoe
text: One of the shoes had a lump in it and even if the size was compatible I could have not worn them. Also they were made in Indoneisia, not the U.S.A as I had expected. Definitely not worth the money and the time it took to repackage them and send them back. Very disappointed!!

title: Pleased
text: Prompt, as Stated, Pleased Good quality, good price, the only way to get them. I reordered several times. It was a real convenience to be able to purchase this item on line. Thank you.

title: Not all I hoped for
text: Seems too bulky when I lace it. Doesn't snug up good around my foot. I tend to roll in one foot when I walk and these shoes seem to increase that roll.

title: Nice shoes
text: I always have good luck with new balance they are extra wide and fit very nice and very comfortable

title: Comfortable, big, sturdy shoes.
text: Comfortable shoes with a huge toe box. I love that. Toes move freely. Sturdy sides and bottoms. I hope they last long.

title: Runs a full size short and narrow.
text: Compared to the Asics 15 4e and the New Balance 840 this shoe runs a full size short and narrow.

title: Smaller Than Typical NewBalance Size 12 4E shoes
text: They are a nice shoe - too bad they don't fit as well as other similar sized shoes from New Balance. I could possible get them bigger in hopes of a better fit, but not wider as I order the widest available shoe.

title: They are really nice shoes.
text: My husband loves them and his width is too hard to find in stores. They are really nice shoes.

title: True to size, good width, comfortable shoes
text: Nice shoes. Have wide feet and these are perfect. They offer decent support and are very comfortable. I usually have trouble finding good shoes to fit that don't give me blisters. Good value, nice style, perfect width.

title: Shoe is a little tight. I ordered 4E but ...
text: Shoe is a little tight. I ordered 4E but they don't seem to be that wide. There doesn't seem to be much arch support either.

title: Great looking shoe, but size is wierd!
text: There are plenty of comments about these shoes being too small. I ordered a size 10 - I'm really a 9½, but often a 10 fits fine. I got these shoes quickly and tried them on... they're a tiny bit loose in the heel, a bit tight across the widest part of my foot. Fabric stretches over time, so I'm not worried. The loose heel feeling went away after a couple of days, but they are kind of a strange fit! Damn! These are great looking walking shoes.

title: Smaller than shoes bought at store.
text: I bought these shoes at a Clark's store in a different color and loved the comfort and quality. Since I could not get the navy in my size at the store, I ordered from Amazon. These shoes feel totally different, they are tighter and the leather isn't as soft. I will check and see if this shoe at the store is better quality, if so I will send these back.

title: 2nd pair!!!!
text: I liked the first pair that I had purchased that I ordered a 2nd pair. Because I am on a fixed income - I am careful of how often I make purchases, so after getting the 1st pair at such a good price, I continued to check the shoe prices on a daily basis until I was able to get this pair at almost 50% off the original prices. I love these shoes. They are a very stylish (but waterproof) and very comfortable. there is a little time needed to break the shoes in. Because they are a waterproofed suede leather, the leather does not stretch as easily as other shoes, so be sure to take time to get used to them, before wearing for a long term. I hope to be able to purchase several more pair of the shoes.

title: Cute but stiff shoe!
text: This is a pretty stiff shoe and my orthotics make it so my heels come out of the shoes when I walk. They are good for hard hiking though. Nothing "cushy" about them.

title: Heel too wide
text: The shoes are very nice and well made. But, I had trouble with the heels slipping on my foot. They were too wide in the heel for me. I had to return them. Otherwise I would have kept them for sure.

title: Too Small
text: I have lots of Clark’s shoes, sandals & boots and I take size 6. These were way too small. Hit right on my bunion, which is usually not a problem with Clark’s

title: Lightweight Comfortable Shoe Running true to size.
text: This is my first pair of Clark Shoes and so far I am enjoying the shoes. I was not expecting the shoe to be so lightweight and comfortable. I wear a 10 and I purchased a 10 so they are running true to size. I didn't not experience any break in issues. I put them on straight out of the box and started wearing them and they are super comfortable. Nice traction/grip on the bottom and they are stylish. The backstay/heel of the shoe is somewhat low and I will have to watch that or I will otherwise "mush" that down trying to get the shoes on. I would purchase again!

title: Very comfortable and fits wide feet
text: This is my first purchase of a Clarks shoe, previously, most of my shoes are made by New Balance. In New Balance I wear a 9.5 4E in Mens or a 11WW in Women's (Aravon, mostly). I'm always worried about width in shoes and was uncertain if Clarks would be able to accommodate my feet since generally, a D is not wide enough. I really wanted a waterproof casual shoe, however, and these Wave.Treks had very good reviews and an interesting look. I am happy to report that these shoes were able to fit my feet without any squishing. The ties are helpful to adjust the top of the shoes and the soles are suitable for my feet. There's very little shoe lace left but I did not need to swap them out. As the other reviews say, these are supremely comfortable shoes. I wore them around the house first and then on a weekend trip. Even after having them on all day they remained comfortable. I haven't tested how waterproof they are since the weather was nice. The red is a very retro-red with a tomato tint. I think I'll get another in a different color for the days I don't feel so colorful.

title: Great shoe
text: This is my 4th pair. I can work all day (Im on my feet 8 hours) and still want to walk the dog. We're a no show household and sometimes they are so comfy I forget I have them on!! Great shoe

title: I hate to give 3 Stars, But
text: I think these are pretty good shoes with a great look, but really bad sizing. I border closer to a narrow width shoe, I got these in a medium width, because of sock and prefer a roomy toe box. There were so tight behind the toe area at the widest part of the foot. The length was good, but OMG, the width was really narrow for a medium width. Others have stated the same thing, believe them.

title: nice all-around shoe.
text: Looked around for a waterproof athletic shoe and tried several different brands & styles. Liked these the best for a couple reasons, including fit and style. They are rugged enough for hiking, light and flexible enough for athletic activity (I was able to kick a soccer ball around comfortably) and look a little more polished than a running shoe. They fit true to size; I'm on the border of a US women's size 6.5 and 7; I typically size up, though the 6.5 in this style fit fine. They are very comfortable, though I may change out the insole for a little more arch support (the support in these OK, but my personal preference is superfeet). The 'grey leather' is a nice neutral color- between a grey and a brown. Comes with two sets of laces (black and aqua and a grey color) to change the look a bit. They seem well made. Plan to wear them on walking commutes and light outdoor activity during our rainy PNW winter.

title: Good shoe
text: I often have a problem with shoes fitting properly because I wear arch supports. This was solved for me by removing the insole in this shoe. It is pretty and comfortable and now my daily shoe.

title: Love the way the shoes look
text: Love the way the shoes look, however found the following issues: 1. Too narrow. I ordered a wider width than I usually take. 2. Too shallow. Shoe does not come up high enough on my foot. Foot was slipping out of the shoe and the shoe was very snug. 3. No arch support. Shoes are being returned. Very disappointed.

title: very comfortable
text: These are very comfortable and an amazing fit.for my 7D feet. I wear them with wool socks and at the end of the day, my custom insoles are soaking wet since these are water-proof and don't breathe. Also, the lighter gray on the sole is wearing extremely fast. It borders a darker gray material that seems to be much more durable.

title: Amazingly comfortable and stylish...
text: Amazingly comfortable pair of walking shoes. I ended up buying more colors. They are cute, casual and stylish when you have to travel for work. Love them!

title: Nice Walking Shoe
text: The attractive stitching emphasizing the shape of the shoe rubs the top of my foot. Toe box feels narrow compared to other Clarks. Prob could had walked for miles in comfort.

title: Too tight on my feet
text: I was surprised by the tightness of these shoes. They compress the front of my foot, just below the toes, because there isn't enough room at the front of the shoe. So the tops of my feet are "flattened" and really hurt after wearing them. I'm going to shop for Clarks online only after testing them in stores in the future.

title: Not up to Clarke quality
text: Usually love Clarks but these are stiff with very little padding. I kept them but wouldn't buy again.

title: Very comfortable
text: I'm glad I read the reviews about these running skinny. I bought a wide and they fit my normal width feet perfectly. I wore these all over Ireland and they kept my feet comfortable and dry.

title: Didn't stay waterproof
text: I purchased these shoes from another vendor. However, I felt I need to write a review here... I need comfortable waterproof shoes to walk my dog 2 miles each morning and evening. At first, these were great...but after a month or so, my feet became wet. I did order 1/2 size up as I always do with athletic style shoes, so the fit was fine. My feet did not hurt after walking either. Just wish the waterproofing was reliable.

title: I love these shoes they are so comfortable I would highly ...
text: I love these shoes they are so comfortable I would highly recommend them. I have tendonitis in my ankles and every pair of tennis shoes I have purchased have caused me pain these dont. The heel is to low and they are narrow.

title: Best Shoes Ever
text: These are the most comfortable shoes I have ever worn. Well, they are tied with the other pair of wave walkers I own. It's really hard for me to find comfortable shoes, and I was getting tired of wearing giant granny-style walking shoes. These are sharp looking and they come in nice colors. I will probably get a third pair.

title: Wonderful Walking Shoes!
text: This is my second pair of these wonderful shoes. When I put them on I was afraid they were a size too smal, but I tied them up and went on my 2 mile walk. They're fabulous, as my other pair is. They're stiff, but somehow it doesn't bother me at all. When you first put them on it feels as if the foot should fit lower in the shoe, but I haven't found that it's a problem. I really do like these shoes and recomment them highly. As usual, the price is right at Amazon!!!

title: Different than the shoes I'm used to, but I like them
text: As someone who usually wears Keen and New Balance, these shoes take a little getting used to. They look nice on and they didn't require a break-in period but they feel different than the shoes I'm used to. The footbed is padded well and the shoes wear well but they seem to be stiffer in general than regular sneakers or trail shoes (probably by design). Also, they are shorter in the ankle area and tend to suck off my footie-type socks as I walk (so I wear socks that are a little longer when I put on these shoes). I will update this review after wearing them more, but from my experience so far they are worth a try if you aren't sure whether Clarks are for you.

title: Great treking shoe
text: I was nervous about purchasing the Clarks Wave Trek walking shoes on line without trying them on. so I searched local stores and finally found them at of all places, a Clarks outlet for $70. The fit is great - I wear a 8.5 medium, but I opted to go to a wide because I wear heavier socks with these shoes. But wthout the thicker socks, I have to tighten up the laces more significantly. I am about to head to Africa, so I have been wearing them non-stop to break them in, and really there is no need - they are very comfortable and provide light arch support. If you need more arch support, I recommend that you purchase inserts in addition. I purchased the dark brown shoes, and they have teal colored stitching and accents. What I like most about them is that I get a comfortable, athletic shoe feel without the casualness of tennis shoes. I even wear them to work. Updated 12/2013: Returned from Africa and they were an excellent choice! Nice traction for walking on dirt paths, hills and uneven pavment and rocks; I got a lot of compliments from other travelers at how nice looking they are. I plan to take them with me on my next trip to Central Europe, where I will be doing more light hiking a

title: True Support!!!!
text: I recently had knee surgery, the support is absolutely amazing. The design keeps everything in alignment, which helps not only the surgery area but the arthritis also. I hope they make more using the exact same technology but possibly a slip on.

title: These shoes are great
text: I really like these shoes. Bought one pair and liked them so well I bought a 2nd pair in a different color. I have learned over the year that when I get shoes that fit and feel right, get more than one pair because by the time you wear out the one pair you have, you won't be able to get them again. Clarks always fit for me but I have never had this type of shoe from Clarks before. I was really pleased with them.

title: Always happy with Clark Waves
text: You can't beat Clark's for great fit, comfort, and quality. The Waves style, in particular, add the extra incentive to buy these shoes for someone whose feet, knees, and back hurt from too much walking. Just wish that they weren't so expensive.

title: Rusty
text: These fit well, however, the color on the screen does not match the color in the box! The color is not red, it is rust!

title: Nice Looking
text: As other reviewer's posted the toe box is much narrower than most Clarks. However, that is my foot shape so I thought it would be o.k. I first tried with medium weight socks and they pinched, then went to very lightweight and it is now o.k. Lightweight socks are good for the light travel packing I wanted these shoes for. Have worn them two days straight and they are comfortable and very lightweight for sneakers. Because of the weatherproofing they are a warm shoe. I found them o.k. at 70 degrees but would opt for something else if it were warmer.

title: Comfortable, a little firm
text: True fit. Good support, but I would like more cushion on the inside. These replace my Clark’s Outdoor wave walk that I have worn daily for 5 years. I have high hopes, just need to break them in. For now I am wearing thick socks, that helps.

title: GREAT GREAT value for money
text: GREAT GREAT value for money. We went skiing in Colorado and wore them all the time. They were super comfy, dry and warm. I bought 2 pairs 1 for me and 1 for my son. We both loved them !!!

title: Toe box could be wider, a little tight
text: The toe box could be wider, a little tight, esp if one adds tick winter socks, debating whether to return!

title: Comfortable and warm
text: I bought these for my husband to use during our (very) cold, snowy winters. He says they're very comfortable (fuzzy and cozy on the inside) and keeps his feet warm, even in sub-zero temps. The grip on the bottom is perfect for maintaining traction while shoveling and the height on the boot is great even in deeper snow. We would definitely recommend!

title: Way better than Sorrels
text: I read a review eating wi tee boots. These were the highest rated and also the cheapest in the review, so I decided to give them a shot and I’m glad I did! They are really well made and super warm. I have big feet, size 14 and they also fit much more like a boot than a big flat piece of cardboard like a lot of other winter boots feel like. Very happy with my purchase.

title: Would easily find boots at this caliber for $500.
text: High quality. Would easily find boots at this caliber for $500. or more in the dept stores. I feel fortunate to have found these particularly warm and durable boots. I bought them for my college age 20 year old son and he loved them. a thousand thank you Mom I love you's . so that alone was worth it.

title: but they look great and feel great
text: First i have to mention that i return the shoes - not because of the shoes themselves but because i got two left ones. The shoes run true to size , i wear 7 to 7.5, ordered 8 and the shoes fit well, with thick socks they are slightly small for me, maybe after some days of wearing they will be OK. I have not tested them in real conditions, but they look great and feel great.

title: Disappointing
text: I would expect snow boots to keep your feet dry. These did not. I even used Sno Seal on them. In light powdery snow they are fine. However, in anything wet, heavy, or slushy, they don't work. I believe they were leaking at the seams. I bought them to wear while I was plowing snow, so I didn't walk a great deal in them, but if you plan on walking a lot, they are not great.....very thin sole and little arch support. They were however very warm. If you're looking for a quick in and out of places boot to wear, they may suit you fine. For extended use in the snow, I would recommend another choice.

title: Well Made
text: This is a well made sturdy and durable boot. It was a gift, but I am told that it fits well and is comfortable, thank you.

title: Warm with Nice Soles
text: These are "non-fashion" boots for my wife. I've had the same NationPlus boots for a year and we both like them for working in snow around the yard. The boots are warm, the soles are reasonably slip resistant, and the price is good. Overall a very nice snow boot.

title: Not Very Warm
text: With a heavy pair of wool socks, husband said his feet still got very cold on a 20 degree day. Good traction, fit good and true to size, just not very warm. Wouldn't buy again.

title: Excellent Snow Boot!
text: I ordered these boots right after Christmas and my first occasion to wear them arrived a month later with the blizzard of '16. I live in Baltimore and we got hit with almost 30" of snow. Needless to say, I had a lot of shoveling to do! These boots were comfortable to wear throughout and kept my feet warm as I trudged through the drifts. They also did an excellent job of keeping my feet dry as I worked in the snow. I highly recommend these boots if you're looking for something to keep your toes toasty and dry while you're spending significant time outdoors in snowy or wet weather. Our temps never dipped below about 20 degrees, so I can't say how well they hold up in minus weather, but I imagine they would work well based on my experience thus far. Terrific boots for the price!

title: No more extra socks
text: The only problem I have with these boots is that they don't come in half-sizes. Didn't think this would have been an issue, since I normally wear a couple of pairs of socks when out in the cold, but these boots are so warm, I don't have to wear extra socks. This was a mild winter here in Michigan, so I haven't put them through any severe weather tests. But they seem to be VERY warm, and quite comfortable. Being a bit too large for my 8 1/2 sized feet, I wished it was easier to tighten them down for long hikes. As it is, my feet have room to move within the boots, which wouldn't be good for lots of walking.

title: Nice snow boot
text: These boots fit perfectly; however, the turned up toe made them uncomfortable on my husband's foot. Unfortunately, we had to return them.

title: They are so worth it
text: I wish I would have found these 2 months ago but now I have them for next winter. They are so comfortable and light. They fit just right with a nice pair of wool socks. They are worth it if you are out in the snow constantly.

title: Comfortable and warm
text: I normally wear a 9 in women's so I ordered these boots in an 8......fit perfectly! These boots are incredibly comfortable and warm. They're definitely not waterproof above the rubber/leather junction. I stepped in a puddle just barely above or right at the seam and felt the cold water in my boot. My only complaint is the laces are too long but not long enough to wrap around the shaft and then the unless you just knot it...at least for my arthritic hands. I should add that I have plantar fasciitis in both feet and have yet to add insoles. I am so glad I bought these boots.

title: but appears great from the box
text: brand new, not yet worn out in the cold, but appears great from the box . as to sizing, my experience is these are way small compared to my two main foot wear providers. I wear New Balance shoes, 11 EE/EEE, and Justin boots 12 D/E, many pairs on a regular basis. I started with size 12 on this boot, way small, then size 13 still tight, then on to 14 my current pair which 'fit' with regular street socks not heavy winter socks, and this is the largest size available at time of order. I expect these to work well as the insulation boot is modern technology and my past experience has been onlty with wool/felt interiors. all the best IF these do the job, I shall update star rating to the 4/5 range.

title: Good Boots
text: Got these for my son and he loves them. Fit was great, they are light weight, but they are warm.

title: Fantastic snow boot
text: Lite weight, warm and sturdy. Great for snow shoveling or work around the yard in the snow.

title: Good boot at a great price
text: Does the job at half the price of the nearest competition. Great winter boots for anyone on a budget, but especially for a teenager who's just going to grow out of them before next season anyway.

title: comfortable, warm, and thicker than I expected.
text: love these boots, lighter than my old Kamik's .My only issue is the sole is not as thick and you can feel every stone, stick, or other objects that you step on.

title: Ill start by saying these boots were very comfortable. However
text: Ill start by saying these boots were very comfortable. However, i did end up returning them due to what i consider sub par construction. I could still see some glued seams on the outside of the boot and upon taking out the thermal insert inside - saw that they were just thrown together (China quality). Im sure they would last for a little while and for the price that may work for some people... but I did end up returning them for a higher quality boot.

title: Warm, but felt every pebble underfoot
text: Is it even cold out? These boots kept my feet toasty without feeling hot in 25° weather for 3 hours, and could have gone much colder. And they were comfortable on smooth surfaces. But as for other surfaces? I felt every pebble, every small chuck of ice, every rut in the parking lot, etc., as if I were barefoot. But hey, I didn’t come home with frostbite. They were extremely comfortable on the sides and top of my feet, and the shaft of the boot was comfortable on my ankles. I’d probably recommend these for basic snow play with the kids in the yard, but not for anywhere that has uneven ground or pebble sized pieces of ice.

title: They are warm and comfortable and I hope I don't need them too often
text: They fit well even with heavy heavy socks on. I wear a size 12 and I bought size 12. They are warm and comfortable and I hope I don't need them too often :)

title: Perfect cold weather boots
text: These are not work boots, if you want a pair of work boots they make plenty. If you want something to walk 500 miles in get something like that. If you want your toes warm and toasty standing in snow at 10 below 0 then get these. Excellent boots. Stood in the snow all day at -10 and my toes stayed dry and warm.

title: Subpar
text: Boots did not live up to expectations. The soles are extremely thin. Could feel every contour of the ground as well as the cold coming thru after only 10 minutes outside shoveling. Feels like walking in rubber rain boots.

title: Perfect boots for working in the cold!
text: These boots are warm and comfortable, fit just right. Great for outdoor work in subzero temps!

title: boot review: My experience
text: For the most part they fit. I've worn them a few times. My toes did get cold in them once.

title: and the felts are not as good as Sorel's
text: These ran narrow, and the felts are not as good as Sorel's. The boots are just ok.

title: Way too small
text: My husband did like these. The quality seemed fair for the price but the sizing just ran too small. He wears a size 13 so we ordered the 14 so there would be extra room but they were way too small and these don't come any bigger.

title: mens snow boots
text: just arrived and wearing them! I usually wear a 12 but ordered 13 as per reviews to go up 1 size. These feel really good! I did a thorough inspection of the build quality. I have not found anything standing out other than a good quality boot at this price point. If you look close to the sole there are little holes for studs if you are in really icy areas. This boot does have a removeable 3m liner. I have not worn these in the snow as of yet. the storm just passed. I feel that this is a great boot for the price!!!! Only time will tell about durability. I will be re reviewing. I recommend

title: Light and Comfortable for Summer
text: I love these sneakers and have bought them a few times. The wear very well, considering the miles I put on them. They are perfect in warm weather and my feet don’t get hot like they do in other athletic shoes. The only drawback is that if they get a little bit wet, your feet will be wet. They are very comfortable. I use my own orthotics in them for support. The insole is removable.

title: Love these
text: I got these in wide because I've been having some foot issues. Have been wearing them for a few weeks, and I really like them. title: Buyer Beware!
text: These shoes are great for wearing around the house or for local errands. They are lightweight but not supportive as described and not well cushioned. The adjustable elastic laces are very convenient and allow for loosening or tightening to accommodate socks, or not. However, my bigger issue with this purchase was with the seller. Their return policy, which is to deduct a whopping 20% restocking fee is not apparent until you make a return. I checked before placing my order and the only information provided was that they follow Amazon policies. I don't know about you but paying $10 for the privilege of ordering a pair of $50 shoes is outrageous. My advice is not to order from this Marketplace seller unless you know in advance that the shoes you order will fit. Otherwise there are many other sellers who offer free shipping and free returns.

title: Love these sandals!
text: I bought these in the coral color and absolutely love these sandals! The wide size is perfect for my sasquatchian feet - I ordered a C/D width and they fit great. Loved them so much, I bought another pair in 9.5 reg width for my mom for mother's day, and she loves them too. She is older with arch issues and usually has to wear customized orthotics, but these shoes work for her. They have a nice arch support in them. Super cute, super comfy, can't go wrong.

title: All in all, a very nice pair of shoes!
text: I was in search of a wedge slide on to wear as a house shoe post surgery. These fit the bill nicely. The sizing is spot on, the beading has not come loose, and the soles are very supportive. The color is true to the photos and the leather is supple. In my cas, it’s a bit too supple. I have very narrow feet and normally have a problem finding shoes that aren’t “floppy” on me. These are okay but not great. If I move the wrong way when taking a step, I fall off the shoe. I’ve twisted my ankle a few times already. I’m clumsy but the leather does seem to stretch as I wear them. Maybe warming up from my body heat? The top edge rubbed my toes at first but it’s smoothed out over the last few weeks.

title: The best sandals ever
text: I love these Clarks sandals. I slid them on my feet the moment the box arrived and enjoyed instant comfort from that second on. I have a wide foot and ordered the wide size 7 in black hoping that it would fit and it did PERFECTLY. The design on the front with the petals and beads are so pretty and the sole just cradles your feet in comfort. The heel height is just right and can be worn all day. I plan to buy another pair in a different color.

title: Yeah Clarks
text: What can I say except Clarks are my favorite shoe for comfort and fit for my narrow feet. That's it.

title: Perfect fit and so comfortable!
text: These shoes are amazing. I ordered a 9W in coral. Such a pretty color. They fit great with room to spare. I have to order a wide width because I had an injury to one foot that makes it thicker than the other. These worked great! They seemed just a bit snug on the bad food at first, right where the sandal ends, just above the toes. I wore them for the first time yesterday, for 12 hours. The longer I wore them, the more comfortable they felt. The heel is just right, and didn't make my feet feel tired. After about 10 minutes the leather had adjusted to the shape of my feet and I no longer noticed any tightness on the one shoe. No blisters, no sore spots, my feet were happy feet last night when I got home :-) Going to order another pair in pewter, now. Highly recommend these to anyone that wants a comfortable shoe that will adjust to your foot shape and stay comfortable all day.

title: Like it but...
text: It fits very well and makes your foot feel secure, unlike with many sandals where your foot slips around and off the shoe bed causing the ankles to turn and possibly sprain. ...this style has a serious issue: Should you accidentally step into a deep puddle of water (as I did), the soft suede-like lining of the inner sole will become loose and severely wrinkled. It should have been securely stitched down so this could not happen when becoming wet. All my other Clarks have always held up in all weather conditions and I was really surprised by this. I read somewhere that Clarks now uses a different manufacturer and sincerely hope that this is not the end of the fine Clarks quality I have been accustomed to. This issue need looking into and a serious fix. I have had this pair only a few weeks and now have to buy another pair of good sandals because I can no longer wear these. The lining wraps around my toes so badly when walking that it drives me crazy and there really is no way to have it repaired.

title: Comfy and pretty

Ended up returning that one and going for this in coral. It's similar in design but much softer on the foot, and the extra height makes it a little dressier. I barely notice that I'm up off the ground. It fits as comfortably as my regular sandals. The heel cup is deep and cushioned. Footbed is a little slick--not the velvety, more grippy type that many of my sandals have, but I don't seem to have any trouble walking in them. The coral color is much more muted than its picture here on Amazon, which is a good thing. The picture makes it look almost orange. My foot is a 9.5, and the 9.5 fits perfectly. I was able to walk all day at a Renaissance fair with almost no pain...that's saying a lot. I like these sandals so much I bought three pairs in different colors and I am pretty sure I am going to buy two more pairs in other colors. They are more than half the cost I paid for my Naots. Don't get me wrong, I love the Naots but the Clark's are just as good and over half the price. Score!

I don't think going up a half size would be the answer as the width was was generous and the length was good, so sadly, I must return the shoes. Five stars for cuteness and most likely comfort, Three stars for a design that limits the wearers ability to adjust accordingly. Gosh, I wanted these shoes!

title: Construction Quality Slipping But Comfort Still Reigns
text: Wear 7.5M in shoes & usually 7 in sandals (Sketcher's & Clarks for example) but needed a 7.5 in these. I love the fit, the feel, the color fabric, the toe scuff guard, the comfortable foot bed. Was able to wear them out of the box without a break in period & for hours at a time. The reason for the lack of 5 stars was the non-matching color of the ankle strap (it's way darker - I'm looking for a ribbon to sew over it to fix this problem) but, more importantly, the quality & precision of the construction. The crisscross open spaces were markedly different from left to right foot & there was a buckle in one of the straps in same area. Even ordered another pair to try to see if I could get 1 matching pair but could not as the 2nd had the same problems on the same feet as the 1st. Seems who ever sewed the left feet weren't checked against how the sewer of the right feet was doing them - which boils down to management & quality control, which I attribute to overseas manufacture. The same shoe in Blue Bell was not as bad but the price was higher and the color light enough I felt it would get dirty too quickly. title: Try on in store first if possible. Front can oe floppy.

Too late to send back. The problem is the non-elastic synthetic fabric and the fact it's sewn too loose across the top of the foot so as to work for thicker feet, is inappropriate for what Keen shoes do. It's useless as support. Another experiment I guess, but maybe they should think through and test more on feet before adopting various synthetics, that seem to be replacing leather. Why not use a stretch fabric if it must be synthetic? Or is this an older version I bought without knowing that?

I wore these my entire Hawaii trip, from airport day to the beach, and I never ever once had sore feet! I wore them right into the water when I went kayaking, and I was the only one on the boat who could keep my shoes on while parasailing! I guess most shoes fly off, but mine had no problem staying on. That ankle strap does the job! They did great in airports, beach day, water activities, walking around town, and sitting on a plane all day. I could wear them all day and my feet would not hurt. I'm happily shocked and in love! A few things other reviewers mentioned, and I'll give my experience: Arch support: I have high arches, and these felt amazing! When I tried to replace them, I could not find black on Amazon at that time in my size for a reasonable price. So I went with this color instead, still neutral enough to wear with most anything casual in the summer. So long as my parent's scoundrel dog doesn't eat these, they should last a good long time, a very well-made, sturdy and comfortable flip flop.

title: Best shoes I've ever bought!
text: These are the best shoes I've ever owned. I bought them outside of Amazon, but will likely buy more online as the fit was absolutely perfect. I have wide feet and have a history of arthritis, bunions and surgery to fix those things, so I pretty much have Frankenstein feet. No shoes have ever fit well and I've never been able to get through a summer without band-aids and blister treatments. I tried these sandals on in a store and was skeptical because the upper structure is fabric beneath the leather, so I expected them to rub. As soon as I put them on, I was in love! I couldn't believe it - they were so comfortable and fit perfectly. The straps across the toes, heel and top of foot are completely adjustable, so they can accommodate just about any foot shape. I felt so good in these, I wore them out of the store and was sad to go to bed that night because it meant removing the shoes! The soles are thick, sturdy rubber with lots of grip. I walk 4-5 miles a day, mostly in an urban setting, and these shoes don't slip on uneven pavement or cobblestones. I can run in them - not long distance jogging, but short distances - and my feet feel like little rockets. I find myself making excuses

These sandals are perfect for walking! They have GREAT ankle support, and he is extremely pleased. Once he adjusted the straps to fit snugly, he said he hardly feels them, and he gets no pain or discomfort. We are super happy, as we have 14 day trip to Europe coming up, and for once, we are looking forward to walking everywhere painlessly.

title: New Balance sold their soul (sole?) for bigger Profits
text: New Balance is a good example of a company getting so greedy they ruined their product in the process. Every pair I bought fit perfectly with no visible manufacturing flaws. Now with them outsourcing manufacturing to a number of different third-world Asian countries, every pair I buy is an adventure in sizing and there is almost always an obvious flaw to be found - usually it's a case of sloppy manufacturing. This pair of shoes was way too small and the insole on one shoe was either cut short or too small in the first place because there was a full millimeter gap at the back of the shoe where the insole fell short. And speaking of insoles, they used to be permanently affixed to the shoe. These days half or more of New Balance shoes come with a cheap, removable insoles. Take them out and there is no padding at all. I'll have to keep buying New Balance however, because they are the only athletic shoe I know about that's comfortable for flat feet (no arch). Of the last 4 pairs of New Balance I bought including these (all different styles), I had to return 3 of them (thank you Amazon!). It's kind of like a lottery.
