I was a little apprehensive about not ordering the next size up; however, the flip flops fit perfectly, and they look very nice. Also, they are very comfortable. Given the price point I was very surprised just how good they are. THe only reason I didn’t give them a 5 stars is because I haven’t had them long enough to determine wear. That being said, I’m planning to buy my brother a pair. Great price, comfort, size, and esthetic.

title: Would've been better off with a $5 pair from Walmart
text: These are cheaper quality than I expected for $15. Would've been better off with a $5 pair from Walmart.

title: Look great - run a little small
text: Just got these. I wear a size 11 in shoes, so I ordered 11. They fit...but barely fit. I actually almost considered sending them back as I prefer my flip flops to bit a little bit larger. However; I decided to keep them. They look great and are pretty comfy.

title: Great
text: These are my favorite flip flops. They’ve graduated to yard work flip flops now. The only issue with these are when they get wet, you have little traction for your feet to grip to and your feet end up slipping on the flip flops.

title: Too small
text: I found these to bee too tight over the instep, can't wear them. And I order a half-size larger than shoe size.

title: They are comfortable, like walking on sand
text: Recognizing that not all feet are one size these shoes are sized to fit every foot. They are comfortable, like walking on sand, no matter what surface you happen to be on. If they wear as good as the look, as good as they feel, you have a winner.

title: Too stiff and no cushion.
text: Stiff and not much cushion. Just a shade better than the ones at the big box store at half the price.

title: Stylish, but all foam.
text: Really like the overall look. Got for my husband as a gift & he loves it. Just wish there was more fabric to it. It is entirely made of foam, even the top foot part. Only the toe wedge is fabric. However, this does make the shoe very light, and easy to keep clean.

title: Price to comfort ratio is excellent.
text: Comfy, so comfy my dog decided to chew them. Price to comfort ratio is excellent.

title: Basic Flip-Flop
text: This flip flop is as basic as they come, which is exactly what I wanted. My issue is that they tend to wear out after one busy summer and it's a bit overpriced. If you're going to be replacing your flip flops every year, you can probably get something similar at WalMart for $3-$5 cheaper.

title: Great sandal after break in
text: These were uncomfortable for the first hour of use, but then they broke in and are super comfy. I would definitely buy these again just after a day of usage.

title: After many miles, holding on strong
text: Excellent durability. These are the longest lasting sandals I've ever owned. Have survived a lot pulling that would have broken other sandals. No comfort issues either. Definitely recommend

title: super comfortable flip flops-
text: i like a 13.5 to 14, so i ordered the 14/48. they really don't seem to run too big, contrary to what others have said. they fit like a glove and they are super comfortable. thinking about ordering another pair! definitely worth the $14!!!! only drawback- i have to take them off to drive.

title: grabby
text: I am old and can't risk tripping. When I put these on and walked out on deck the flipflops just seemed to "stick" on the wood planks. Really. I walked around for a few steps using stork like lifting feet steps. Then I took a sideways step and nearly lost my balance and went down. They grabbed..like a bad brake job. I gave them to my neighbor kid who likes them just fine. He plays catch with his buddy in them. Maybe they just needed wearing down of the grabby tread?? Thats all I got.

title: These broke after 8 months of normal wear. Nothing ...
text: These broke after 8 months of normal wear. Nothing crazy. No running or hiking or gymnastics, just occasional walking. The tread on the bottom didn even have time to wear out before the strap on top just broke in half. While I was sitting at a restaurant. I guess you get what you pay for, but for $14 I expected a little more life out of them.

title: Very comfortable, fit well
text: I really was pleased with these flip flops. They were wider than expected, but that was a huge positive for me. Often I find shoes are not wide enough. Very comfortable and as you wear them, they begin to conform to your feet.

title: Held together with Velcro
text: These sandals are cheaply made, held together with Velcro which you can’t tell from the picture. I ONLY wear Merrill’s so I know their usual quality and this sandal is not it ! I wonder if these are knock offs?

title: Holy cow, these are the best!!!
text: These are the absolute best sandals I have ever bought! I bought a black pair first and loved them so I bought the brown too. Good thing because we went on a 10 day cruise and the airline lost one of my suitcases. The black pair was lost so I wore the brown pair for countless miles of walking every day and over cobblestone streets a lot! Never once hurt my feet. No break in time required! Treat yourself and grab a pair! I'm a total fan!

title: Irregularity in production
text: Love the style but one heel strap was and inch longer than the other causing the one sandal not to fit. Disappointed. Had to return

title: Loose fit
text: I have a lot of Merrell sandals but these were much looser in the footbed and there was no way to tighten the area in the strappy part of the shoe. It is a ribbon and not leather in that area. They are cute but fit loose.

title: Very cute and comfortable but too big
text: The sandles are very cute and comfortable. The taupe color is neutral and goes with everything. I have to return the sandals, unfortunately, because they are too wide and too large.

title: Perfect for what I needed!
text: I was skeptical at first. I bought them for an international trip and I knew I’d be walking a lot. I didn’t have time to break them in, as I had planned, and I feared they wouldn’t be comfortable or give enough support so threw in my old pair of sandals just in case. I was so wrong! They were the only thing I wore on the trip, and I even chose them over my far more expensive walking shoes. They are very comfortable and allowed me to walk many miles without my feet feeling tired. I love them!

title: Comfortable and Attractive
text: This shoe looks very nice on. The cloth strap makes it look dressy but I am a little concerned about how well it is going to wear compared to leather for example. I have had 2 pairs of Merrell sandals that I have worn constantly and that are so dependable for comfort. I depend on Merrell for great arch support. So far, no one noticed that I had new shoes. I recently received compliments on my older Merrell sandals.

title: I WISH I COULD WEAR THESE YEAR ROUND
text: These are my favorite shoes in the entire world. I thought I lost them a few weeks after they arrived and was devastated. Absolutely devastated. I ordered another pair w/overnight shipping, because they are the most comfortable shoe I've ever worn. Better than my running shoes, my walking shoes, my favorite slippers, my laziest flip flops. These are the best. I slip in and out of them effortlessly and still they fit amazing. At first wear they rubbed my ankles a bit but adjusting the velcro a touch totally missed that. These have inspired me to purge my entire shoe collection because I now know how shoes SHOULD feel. As someone with a wide forefoot, narrow ankles, and tiny toes I have never in my life had a shoe feel this good. Sure my pinky toe peeks out between the straps sometimes but whatever. Better than it being cramped in a toe box that's too narrow. These shoes make me contemplate moving back to california from the pacific northwest, because they'd sadly not be warm enough in the rainy icy winter.

title: Great Shoes
text: These are cute and very comfortable. They've become my "go to" sandals for summer.

title: Great Sandal no foot or leg aches
text: They are great, comfortable from first day and great to walk in very supportive. I would love to have black leather pair for dressier days. Hate to wear any other shoes but Olakai

title: didn't feel comfortable or supportive
text: felt flimsy - returned them as I wanted a supportive, comfortable athletic sandal. straps on the top were barely there

title: Great sandal!
text: Excellent shoe! Comfortable, good support, attractive. I have used for everything from hiking to a nice casual dinner.

title: Love them
text: I like the feminine look yet tough feel. The strap material is a bit abrasive but hoping it softens over time.

title: Not super exciting
text: First let me say I am huge Merrell fan. These sandals are very disappointing for the price point. They feel very cheap and have stretched to the point (in less than a month) that I cannot tighten them to feel comfortable and snug. They are almost a tripping hazard and the size (footbed) is not too big for my foot. Unfortunately I think Merrell lowered their standards in the production of these sandals.

title: Comfy but make my feet stink very badly. I ...
text: Comfy but make my feet stink very badly. I wore them for about two months but just can't do it anymore - yuck.

title: Comfortable
text: Love these sandals! I had to take off the back strap because it rubbed and gave me a blister. But when I took off the back, it became the most comfortable sandal I own. Highly recommend these Merrell sandals.

title: Not for those with wide feet
text: Not a good choice if you have wide feet. The top of my foot could barely fit in the shoe.

title: Stylish, Great Sandal
text: I'm between a size 10.5 and an 11 and the size 10 fit me perfectly for this shoe. Many other reviewers mentioned the clip being troublesome, but I really don't have a problem with that. The only thing that bothers me about this shoe is one of the straps that goes across the top of the foot is loose and can't be adjusted. To make this less annoying I've tucked it under the adjustable strap by it. I also have generally flat feet with low arches, so that might make a difference person to person as well with this issue. Despite this the shoes were really comfortable and exceeded my expectations! When they arrived I wore them out with friends for three hours with constant walking and didn't have any pain or blisters from them being so new.

title: Not made for hiking on rocks or heavy Terrian
text: The inside are suede. Not much of a tread on bottom. Returned due to these reason.

title: Always happy with Merrell
text: Nice sandals similar to ones I used to have. A bit loose over the top. Can be tightened using velcro straps but then the straps stick out. They work fine, a little snugger would be nice.

title: Liked it, but had to return
text: This is well made and I liked the shoe, but; I usually wear 7.5 and since 1/2 sizes were not available, I ordered an 8. It was too big and I was unable to adjust the straps tight enough with the velcro placement.

title: Miss the toe strap
text: I liked the version of this style shoe with the toe strap better. This shoe does fit well with a decent arch support.

title: Lightweight and comfortable
text: I am very pleased with these sandals. I especially like the straps to make for comfort adjustments and so I can slip them on rather than using the buckle. I have difficulties with buckling, but this is easily overcome with the adjustable straps.

title: Recommend
text: Nice sandals. They do need to be broken in (i wore them a couple of times on short walks before wearing them for a full day of walking) but after they are very comfy.

title: Comfy Sandal
text: Great sandal. Comfy. Use for everyday wear. My shoe size is 9. But in this sandal the correct size for me is an 8.

title: Fit great. Very comfortable
text: Fit great. Very comfortable. Use them for walking and the support they have make them as confortable as walking shoes!

title: Tight toe box.
text: I liked the shoes but the straps over toe box are tight. Velcro adjustment everywhere but there.

title: Pros and Cons
text: I LOVE my Merrell Hollyleaf flips, I never spent that much money on a shoe, I got two pairs about 6 years ago and wanted to add a sandal with a strap to my summer shoes. I have a back injury so I need support in every shoe no matter how long I wear them. I decided to go with the Merrell Terran Lattice. It's dainty and I like the colors. Cons: not as comfortable as my Hollyleaf. Maybe it's how the straps hold the shoe on my foot? Not as much arch support. My chubby arch spills a little over the side, which would be fine if the sole was as comfortable as the Hollyleaf. I know it's hard to read through reviews and decipher what works for you, my foot is a little on the flat side but a normal width typically suits me fine. This style of Merrell vs. the Hollyleaf was a disappointment. Pros: somewhat dainty, offers a little support, lightweight, cute Cons: not enough support or quite wide enough. Returned.

title: Comfortable walking shoe with good arch support
text: Very comfortable, no "breaking in" needed. I have a pretty high arch and have a hard time finding sandals that are both comfortable and cute, but these are great! The thin straps and low profile make these even more attractive than other Merrell's while still offering the structure and protection to walk or hike for miles. I wear an 8.5 and ordered the 8/39 and they are perfect. I saw other reviews complaining about the small clip being hard to manage. I find the clip is basically just for show anyway. These slip right on, and I just adjust the heel strap and go. Looking for practical, supportive sandals that are not chunky and clunky? These are for you!

title: My Favorite Sandals!
text: These sandals are not only cute, but they are so comfortable. I have somewhat wide feet, and these are perfect. The fact that you can adjust the strap on the back as well as across the top of your foot really gives you alot of options for making sure they fit just right.

title: Too big
text: If you have a small boney foot. I find this brand is difficult to fit in sandals.

title: I LOVE THIS SHOE...cute colors and style - third pair!!!!
text: Third pair of these exact sandle. Love the different colors. I have a somewhat narrow foot and they fit like a charm. So comfortable that I wear them all day. Really cute design and I love the toe placement and the over the foot strap for keeping them on my feet. They are THE BEST sandal style I own. Yeah Merrell. Hope they continue to concentrate on cute colors and styles. This one is a winner.

title: Too bad, really soft shoe
text: Soft, good length and really soft. Cute would loved to have kept them. Toe bed so narrow just a slight stretching out and my toes would be walking on the ground. I had plenty of room near the heel of the foot. Toe bed, right on the edge. Had to return

title: Comfortable, supportive & stylish!
text: This sandal has amazing support and is very comfortable. I Absolutely love it...

title: Aaaahhh! Comfort Defined.
text: These shoes are heavenly. When stepping into them I feel like I am stepping onto a cloud. I have small fiber neuropathy, as well as diabetic neuropathy (cruel, huh?) and for 5 years now have slowly been having to leave shoes behind. I can wear these shoes all day with no pain. Buy them! Leave a few pairs for me!!

title: Sizing seems to have changed!
text: I've ordered this same model in the same size (8) for several years in a row. This year, I ordered two colors and both were considerably smaller than in the past, both in width and length. Disappointed!

title: Sizes run extremely small
text: I went up a size as recommended by many reviewers. I wear a 6 1/2 to a 7. I purchased an 8 and the sandals were still too small. Sent them back. Check the seller refund policy - many won't pay the return shipping.

title: Perfect Sandal
text: I love these shoes. I bought one pair and thought the shoes were so comfortable that I bought a second pair to wear around the house. They stay on my feet well—no kicking off. I don’t have any foot issues but I did break a couple of bones in my foot a few years ago and I can’t wear soft shoes—no slippers. These are perfect.

title: Extremely COMFORTABLE -Great arch support
text: I wear these all the time. I took them on vacation and slipped into them with wet feet, and they are holding up perfectly. Now they are sold out of size 8, so I'll pick up another pair, to have on hand someplace else.

title: Women's Sandals
text: Looks great. Fits perfectly. True to size. Very comfortable. I purchased all colors.

title: Love them!!!
text: They are so comfortable and supportive. I get lots of compliments so I bought a second pair. You won’t be disappointed!!

title: Wonderful Sandals
text: Got these in bracken. Love the look and the feel. Arch support is great and they’re a pleasure to walk in. Very pleased with this purchase!

title: Very comfortable.
text: Comfortable foam sole. Accommodates my extremely wide foot after a few wearings. Quieter and safer than a flip-flop. Nice grippy sole. I live in these at home.

title: great color, comfortable out of the box
text: Attractive sandals, great color, comfortable out of the box. I ordered up a half-size and they fit perfectly. I can wear them all day and they are still comfortable.

title: Favorite summer shoe
text: I love these shoes. This is my 6th pair in 5 different colors. They look and feel amazing. I highly recommend them.

title: My favorite sandal.
text: These sandals are the only "thong" type that I can wear as I have bunions and they cover them up! They also provide great support while looking very nice and not sloppy. I wear them with everything...shorts, crop pants, long pants and also skirts. They last forever and I bought these for next year in case the style isn't avail.

title: Stylish and super comfortable
text: This is my first red pair of this particular style of Merrell sandals. I own a pair of black and blue ones already. These sandals are well-constructed and super comfortable. I practically live in them. They look great worn with a skirt, dress, pants and shorts. A little pricey, but worth it.

title: Great sandals
text: Because I have problems with my feet, I only buy Merrell shoes. As usual these did not disappoint. They are great sandals. Fit as expected and look great. They are extremely comfortable too.

title: Oh MY goodness Comfy
text: These are so comfy!!!! A bit too loose if you have narrow feet. But so comfy. I usually buy the Columbia version and these are so much more cushioned. Love love love

title: Oh MY goodness Comfy
text: These are so comfy!!!! A bit too loose if you have narrow feet. But so comfy. I usually buy the Columbia version and these are so much more cushioned. Love love love

title: Great find!
text: So grateful to be able to find this discontinued Merrell style in my size; perfect fit!

title: Best Sandal for looks and Comfort !
text: I already have a similar pair , so Knew I wanted another . My other ones were looking worn so I bought another !Love them !

title: Good quality
text: Not as good as my old Merrill sandals but after years of wear, I needed replacement. I fear the grey insole will get dirty fast. Unfortunately, I ordered these for a trip and Amazon said I would get delivery in time but I did not. It was just a few days but...

title: Perfect sandal
text: My second pair! True to size and comfy. I plan to buy in every color! (Also, I have a bunion and this sandal covers it easily!)

title: Comfortable.
text: When I first put them on, I thought, I can't get my foot thru, but after wearing for a bit, my toes slid up. I'm used to ordering the Hollyleaf Sandals, but they don't have this Cute Pink sandal, so I thought I try these. I like these too!

title: Perfect!
text: The most comfortable sandal I've ever worn! The fit is true to size and gives support in all the right places.

title: Merrell's worth the money
text: Love Merrell's and own many. The fit is perfect with every pair. The olive looks great with my cami's😃.

title: I find these really comfortable, with a good footbed
text: I find these really comfortable, with a good footbed. If you wear orthodics, I don't know if it will have enough arch support, but I find it to be good support. I also like the way the toe piece is designed. It is much more comfortable that most flip flops out there.

title: Perfect futz, good arch support and a cushioned sole
text: These are my go to sandals. Perfect futz, good arch support and a cushioned sole.

title: TOO Small.
text: I usually wear a 9 or 9.5 in Merrell shoes, but these were way too small. It was really surprising because I have always been able to order, receive and wear...not so this time.

title: Merrells are always comfortable
text: Merrell is always comfortable. The only thing I don’t like is they don’t breathe as well as the older style of this shoe and they fit a little more snug. The old style has a plastic buckle to adjust the fit but this new style doesn’t. Still happy with them & would buy them again

title: love Merrell
text: I love Merrell Shoes in general and I liked the color and style of those. I had them just for a couple of days, so we'll see how they hold up. My old ones have lasted for 3 years and I wear them all summer long. The only small complaint is the upper strap, it is a smidgen too tight. I ordered the same size as I usually do with Merrell Sandals, but they turn out a bit too small. I do have a wider foot, so I think the old ones fit better, since there wasn't a strap soo far up the foot. I will still keep them and hope it loosens up a bit over time.

title: Great Product, but is too small for the size
text: I have an older pair of these shoes and loved them (to death) :) They were so worn out I wanted to purchase another pair and these were very similar. I used the exact same size from the label on the old pair to select these. When I got them and put them on they were too tight. I thought maybe I just need to wear them in and they will stretch out. After a week, my feet were killing me. I got the old shoes out and held them up sole-to-sole with the new. The new ones are at least a centimeter smaller, and they are narrower by half that amount as well. I was very surprised, but gave my pair to my daughter and I will have to buy at least the next size up.

title: ad says hook and eye loop adjustment!
text: there is none and they are loose my 3 rd pair of this Merrill sandal,I will need socks with these

title: Love these Merrell slides
text: Aside from them being slightly wide on my narrow foot, I really like these. I bought another pair in white.

title: Great sandals!
text: I wore this style for years and had it in all colors. Love love love it. Great support, fits true to size and looks so cute. When my taupe pair finally wore out I went back to Merrell to buy it again and found it was no longer available 😱. So happy to have found it here and for a great price!

title: Comfort, Style and Good Support
text: Merrell's Terran Slide II has been one of my favorite slide sandals for several years because they're comfortable, stylish, provide ample support and wear well. This is my third pair and I'm thrilled that they still make them and with the same level of quality. Highly recommended!

title: Five Stars
text: Very comfortable sandal for around the house and errands. Merrell always mades great shoes.

title: Merrell's Sandals so comfy
text: I have several pairs of these so there were no surprises here. These are comfortable and good looking, but you have to be careful with Merrell's. I think there are some that are cheaply made compared to what they used to be. Maybe better to try on in the store first unless you know the particular shoe, like I did here.

title: Supportive and comfortable!
text: These fit like a glove - very comfortable for my troubled feet. I can walk the dog, go on errands, and wear them all day! The color is fabulous! Definitely getting a couple of more pairs in different colors.

title: Good support and cushion
text: I bought these primarily for my house slippers. We have porcelain tile throughout and it is very hard on my joints and heels. I need shoes that offer good cushion and support, will stay on my feet but that I can easily slide in to and out of. These suit my needs perfectly.

title: Five Stars
text: Given as a gift to my aunt...fits as expected...she loves the style, comfort and fit.

title: Perfect for traveling
text: Love these sandals as they are very comfortable. I recently bought them for a trip to Italy. Coming off a foot surgery made me very cautious and concerned about my shoes for a trip where we usually walk in excess of 70 miles sightseeing over a two week period. These shoes were so great, offering support and comfort, that I ended up wearing them most of the trip despite the fact I had 3 other pair with me. They have a nice suede like sole which I appreciate as my feet sweat a lot and I hate that sticky feeling that I get on some shoes. The band across the top offers some support but is flexible to fit your foot. I wore them tromping around Pompeii on the stone and sometimes uneven streets and sidewalks for 5 hours one day. No blisters or rub marks of any kind even fresh out of the box.

title: Merrells are the best
text: I've owned a number of pairs of this style slide, am thrilled Merrell continues making them. They're extremely comfortable in every way possible. In addition, they are well made, last forever, are stylish and are offered in many colors. The price, in my opinion, is reasonable for a sandal with such great features.

title: These shoes ARE PERFECT
text: I wish all my shoes were this comfortable. I guess you cant go wrong with merrell's

title: Merrils that stretch
text: Love these shoes. I have Wide feet and they will stretch! Wish they came in wide width as I have to work my foot into them over a few days so they fit properly! They are well cushioned and soft to my feet

title: It's a little tighter than I would like. I wish they offered half sizes or wide ...
text: It's a little tighter than I would like. I wish they offered half sizes or wide in this shoe. Otherwise, it's a comfortable shoe.

title: size up
text: These seem to run small. i would recommend that you buy the size up on these shoes.

title: I got / loved the first pair
text: I've purchase two sets of the Merrell Terran Slide II this summer. I got / loved the first pair. However, this pair is much narrower and even with frequent wearing and not loosened up much. Disappointing....it's too uncomfortable to wear anywhere other than around the house.

title: Most comfortable shoes ever!!
text: These are the best. I am 73, have a bad hammer toe and a bunion so shoes are hard to find!!!

title: Very Narrow
text: This shoe is Very Narrow over the foot. I can't get my foot in all the way. Buy the Merrell Hollyleaf instead. Very similar in looks, but fits well.

title: Comfortable and most comfortable sandals
text: This is my second pair of these exact Merrill sandals- best sandals I’ve ever had - comfortable - nice cushion - I hope they keep making this sandal! Nice looking and a great value! I love Merrill she es!

title: Three Stars
text: Really like them. Have owned several merrills, thought they would have more support. I am happy with purchase.

title: Changed sizing recently
text: Had a pair of these on a size 8 I bought a few years ago. Wore them out and last year replaced with size 8 Merrell District Muri slides. Those are shot and not available for purchase anymore so I tried the Terran 3 slides in an 8. Too small. Heel sits on the edge of the heel cup and toe overhangs. Exchanged for a 9 as they don’t have half sizes. Waaay too big. So wide they instantly fall off when I try to walk. Figured I knew how these fit so I ordered them in an 8. They fit like the Terrans in an 8. Heel sits on the edge of the heel cup and toe overhangs. I still have my original pair and you can see in the pic the size difference in length. So I matter size, what I can’t fit into Merrell sandals anymore. I’ve worn them for years and I’m very disappointed.

title: Merrell shoes
text: This shoe seems just slightly shorter than the Merrell sandals I currently wear. The material over the top of my foot seems just a little snug also. Still a comfortable shoe.

title: Five Stars
text: I love Merrell sandals, and these are no exception. Fit well and very comfortable!

title: AWFUL FIT, VERY UNCOMFORTABLE
text: Having bought several pair of Merrell's slide-in shoes, both black and cream, I wanted to try a pair of their shoes in white sandals for summer. I tried them on and thought they did not fit correctly, but kept them anyway since I could not find a pair of Merrell sandals which I thought I liked, just from the reviews and photos. I was wrong. The toe opening squeezes my toes together, making wearing of this shoe very uncomfortable. I have tried them again and again, but always take them off after a short while and put on a pair of my Merrells which are more comfortable. I had such high hopes. Very sad and disappointed.

title: I want a second pair spare...
text: I purchased these to use as house shoes/slippers after having developed plantar fasciitis. They are a dream! Pros: + they feel like little pillows for my feet + support hits in just the right spots + cute color Cons: None Bottom Line: I want a second pair as a spare so that when this pair is done, I don't have to start the search all over again!

title: Great for Hard to Fit Feet
text: These shoes easily accommodated my hard to fit feet - bunions, toes that overlap. I can't wear toe thongs due to those problems, but these sandals have enough give to allow them to stay on and stay comfortable!

title: So comfortable!
text: I usually wear an 8.5 and ordered a 9 in this -- fits great. So comfortable - I'm going to get another color!

title: Great Shoe
text: My Husband loves the look and comfort of this shoe. Arrived on time and was as described and expected.

title: Like these sandals :)
text: These are nice sandals. I'm always outside, camping / fishing / kayaking / hiking and they do the trick. They are a bit lighter than my Keen sandals, but for some reason I wear the keen sandals more often than I wear these. If the Keens are wet, I throw these on until the Keens dry :)

title: Fit great, look stylish.
text: These are great, water shoes plus great shoes to wear without socks. I highly recommend them.

title: highly recommended
text: These are the best water shoes I've ever used. I'm a waterfall guidebook writer (yes, that's a thing) and I use water shoes like crazy to visit and photograph falls. These hold up well, have good grip, and resist stinking afterwards.

title: Expensive But worth it.
text: I won't usually pay this kind of $$ for shoes But I'm planning a trip next week that involves walking up the Narrows in Zion and the water walkers looked to be the best of the bunch. All I've done is was Tham around the house so far butthye are soft, stretchy and comfortable. Lightweight too. they MAY be the best hiking shoe I've had. So far I think it was a great buy.

title: Goodbye Keen sandles
text: Found these discounted on Amazon and took a chance they would fit. Glad I did. Great fit. And a Vibram sole. Looking forward to trying this out on the rivers and lakes in colorado this summer canoeing and rafting.

title: BEWARE!!!
text: I tried these shoes on when received & they looked good & felt great!!! I broke in another pair of shoes & just now the Merrells. Day # 1, I'm outside in the sunlight, look down, and I'm aghast, to my utter surprise the color of the shoes is predominately OLIVE GREEN!!! They look tan & brown inside and on AMAZON'S Photos which is the color I wanted. So no matter how comfortable or high quality these shoes they will ABSOLUTELY POSITIVELY NOT BE WORN BY ME!!! Because I wore these for one day & return is unlikely, credit as well. time to throw out. Merrell & Amazon this was deceptive!!! Waste of my money!!! I'm really disappointed!!!

title: Not just for water
text: My second pair of these. First pair lasted about a year before I felt the support was diminishing. I wear them for everything - not just as a water shoe - and they're great!

title: Not the color I expected.
text: This color "brindle" is olive green. The picture doesn't look green. Very disappointed. The pull tie that you use to tightened the shoe goes across bare skin, like they are trying to be cheap. Just disappointed at the quality for the price.

title: Perfect shoes for wet landings and hiking
text: These were perfect for our trip to the Galapagos. Wet landings on zodiacs easily transitioned to land hikes on lava fields or hard-to-navigate boulders. Immediately comfortable without a break-in period. Holding up very well so far!

title: Great fit and feel.
text: Great fit and feel. I love these much better then the other brand I had. I put an insole in the shoe. But I do that for all my shoes. I know that they don't need it but, it makes them feel a little less sticky on my feet.

title: Good quality and tough
text: Good quality, great fit. Know the brand well thus anticipated no problems and that is what happened - no problems. Will buy again.

title: Low quality stitching. Coming off after 2 months
text: I wish I could return the shoes. I didn't even hike or anything. Regular everyday use going to work, shopping etc. The stitching is coming off in several places. Didn't expect this after 2 months from shoes that cost 90 dollars. Fit: A little bit wide towards the front, otherwise the fit is great.

title: Have no fear , Wide feet accepted
text: I have wide feet (EE) size 12 and was hesitant on purchasing these shoes. I like the outdoors and when it comes to shoes its slim picking for me . I bought them 12 regular width for mainly kayaking, river, beach exposure. But when they arrived I tried them on and they feel perfect, so I think they do run a little wide but great for me , even with socks

title: Five Stars
text: Perfect fit and the best shoe for wearing while rafting or strolling on the beach

title: Perfect for jungle and beach
text: Right out of the box these fit perfectly! Can't figure out all the bad "don't fit'' reviews, and I have hell trying to find shoes that fight right. I did take the time to break them in a little to scuff up the soles. They are slippery on wet surfaces when new and helps your feet get used to them so you don't get blisters on an all day trek. Used them yesterday on a jungle tour in Costa Rica, climbing wet rocks, crossing rocky sandy streams, and swimming in gravel bottom waterfall pools. Like many reviews state you will get smaller pebbles and sand in them but just shake your feet and they wash out. If you don't have sense to do that before you start trail walking again leaving your shoe full of gravel then maybe you need to try some other recreational activity and quit leaving bad reviews about that "problem". Try these you're gonna like them

title: Perfect Choice for the Expedition of a Lifetime
text: Bought these for a trip to the Galapagos. We were visiting each island via Zodiac and some landings were going to be wet. These Merrells held up perfectly, not only for the landings but the hikes that followed. They fit very well (as do all Merrell products I have purchased) and are stretchy, so I can throw them on easily any time for (boring) New England errands.

title: Only Merrell’s
text: My mom bought me a pair of Merrell’s 10 years ago. That is the only thing I have worn since, outside of some boots. I’ve not had a chance to wear these out yet but they seem to be as good as the rest of their line up.

title: Repeat Customer
text: There is nothing my husband likes more than finding something he loves and then buying it over and over (and over!) again. He finds these sandals very comfortable and wears them year-round. To him, they offer the support of a tennis shoe while allowing for great venting in the heat of Southern California. God willing, I'll keep buying them as long as Merrell offers them. The previous pair is about 2 years old with constant wear. I'd say that's a pretty well-made product. RECOMMEND.

title: Merrell Water Shoe
text: I had a pair of Columbia water shoes that were just at the end of their life. A week long rafting trip on the Middle Fork of the Salmon River demanded new shoes. I purchased these and they fit perfectly and were comfortable all day. They even did fine on several medium to long hikes of moderate intensity. Not recommended for extreme hiking. If you don't plan any extreme hikes, you can save yourself the hassle of taking along a separate pair of hiking shoes.

title: Disappointed
text: I had a slightly different pair of these that I wore for years. The biggest difference for me is not having an adjustable back strap. The back strap is loose but the rest of the shoe fits fine. I can try to use the elastic to get it tight all over, but that to try to shore up the back just makes the extra elastic band ridiculously long and event tucking it under the cross straps still leaves several inches past the toe. For the price I expected better. I loved my old ones, but will likely look to a different brand in the future.

title: Best shoes ever!!!
text: I love these shoes. With two growing boys that love to be outside, I needed shoes that could go anywhere and do anything. These are comfortable enough to hike for hours and rugged enough to handle rocks and stream beds. My feet never get hot and I can slip them on and off easily. I also have very wide feet and the normal width gives me plenty of room. I will wear these more than any other shoe I own this summer. My other Merrells will be jealous.

title: Very good fit and looks.
text: Perfect fit for me. I had it’s older version from 2016 but this one fits even better. The front width is truer and the over all support seems to be better than the previous model. It’s lightweight and very - repeat very - durable based on my experience with the previous model.

title: Great shoes but grip isn't 100%
text: They were a tad longer in length as expected for good water shoes. I'm giving them only a four star because the grip on the shoes was not as good as I had hoped. Granted, I wasn't expecting to be able to walk on algae with them but I did expect to be able to walk on the wet log that I kept slipping on.

title: Nice quality shoe
text: So far so good. These are well built shoes with good attention to detail. The lace tie works well and holds even under heavy use. Comfort level is very high and they seem like they will last awhile. We'll see.......I can see why Merrell is considered a top brand.

title: Great light weight shoe with and without socks
text: Great light weight shoe with and without socks. Easly slips on and off. My go to summer shoe. Wears well, holds shape.

title: ... with water shoes and I was surprised at how comfortable they felt
text: This is my first time with water shoes and I was surprised at how comfortable they felt.

title: These fit PERFECT and I love the look and feel of these
text: These fit PERFECT and I love the look and feel of these. I will be using them to hike the red river gorge in Kentucky next month, will update the review after wearing them for like 10hrs a day for 3 days in a row lol.

title: It's a good product so far.
text: I've only taken the shoes out on one outing so far, and that was this weekend. I went on a trip from Fayetteville Arkansas down to Ruth Mississippi to fish a couple of ponds with a mate that lives down there. They fit great, and felt secure as well. My only complaint, and it's an extremely minor one at that. Is the fact that they're a little less great out of water... In the water whatever gets in the shoe is quickly removed by the water. Out of it is a different story.... I was walking through grass and kept getting tons of seeds in them, which made them uncomfortable. So I had to keep going back to the water to clean them off..... It's only a minor complaint like I said, because I didn't buy these for working and wading in ponds.... I got them for the creeks in which I fish back in NWA...

title: Comfortable & Versatile
text: My girlfriend and I bought these shoes a few months ago to use in the Narrows at Zion NP and we were not disappointed. These had very good grip on the slippery rocks and made our 9.5 mile river walk a great experience. I paired these with a pair of neoprene socks and my feet were warm and comfortable the whole day. Since then I have used these on many hikes where water is expected and I cannot recommend them enough. Expect about a 2-day dry time in colder temps. Here in so-cal about one day to dry. I like strapping these onto the roof of my car to hasten the dry time as I drive back home/to camp, etc.

title: Good value
text: I have done a lot of hiking. I have used many brands and settled on Merrell because they have a wider toe box that doesn't hurt my foot like many more expensive shoes have. I always replace the insert with a very high quality one to prevent plantar fasciitis. The mid height shoe gives good ankle support

title: works great
text: This is a great all around shoe. I wear it every day and wear when i go hiking. They are not water proof but drain when wet and still feel great. My only issue is that they are hard to find on Amazon.

title: I will be getting another pair!
text: Excellent quality! I wouldn't expect anything else from Merrell brand! Came packaged in it's original box and in perfect condition! They provide great support for someone who needs extra ankle/leg support!

title: Great hiking boot
text: I bought these because my wife and I are doing more hiking And I needed a shoe with more support Than my sneakers. I'm very happy with my purchase. I tried on in store to get the right size and then found a better price on Amazon. For me it's a snug fit and it feels like I'm walking on clouds.

title: Super comfortable boots!
text: The boots fit right out of the box. They are light and super comfortable. I wear a size 12 shoe and ordered the size 12 boot and they fit perfectly with just the right amount of toe room. I am going to buy another color now.

title: Great boot from the start
text: Comfortable boots right out of the box. Great to walk on blacktop or hike in them. Great all around boot. Boot fit is similar to other Solomon’s boots. I normally wear a 9 1/2 but I bought a size 10 and they fit great

title: great boots
text: I love these boots. They fit perfectly and the 10.5 wide is VERY comfortable on my feet. The only problem was with delivery service. They were promised to be delivered Sunday, March 11 by 8pm. They were delivered, but not to me. They wound up on the neighbors front porch. These kind of delivery mistakes happen WAY to often on the weekends. I love the boots, but can't give 5 stars because of the delivery mistake.

title: Excellent quality and comfortable.
text: I ordered a 12 because I've had other Merrill shoes and that was the best size for me, however when I tried them on in two different stores the 11.5 and 12 were too big, at one place and at another the 12 fit perfectly, so I don't know what to say about that. I suppose it depends on what day they made them or something, regardless I eventually got the ones I needed from Amazon, and they fit perfectly.

title: Second pair - Love 'em!
text: This is my second pair and I'm as happy with them as I was with the first pair. The fit is good and, for me, were comfortable right out of the box. I wear them for day hiking three to seven days a week. The grip and support are exceptional - the terrain I hike is rocky and I'm some areas, steep - no problem for these boots. Highly recommend.

title: No break-in required!
text: This is my favorite hiking boot ever. I have bought several pairs now, for hiking and for work. They do not need breaking in, unlike my Keen's which took two years ( winter use only) to get truly comfortable on long hikes. These boots I can hike 7-10 miles right out of the box with no blisters or other problems!

title: Not happy with Amazon!
text: Same shoe bought at REI fits different then the one from Amazon. REI return policy no problem, Amazon, well just say Good luck!

title: Runs a half size large for me.
text: In most boots I wear a 9 Wide. I ordered them and it was definitely a half size large. I was going on a trip so I took them anyway and regretted it. I got sores under my feet. I would avoid black just because of how much dirt show up.

title: Glue is not gluey, gooey, gluey...more like craft glue.
text: I bought these in February of 2018, at the end of the month. It is now May. I am a teacher and spend a lot of time on my feet, but I only wear these 2-3 days a week as I have other shoes I wear. The sole and tread are separating now. If these are hiking boots then the only hiking one who buys them will be doing is dream hiking. These are not worth the price of the Merrell name! Avoid this buy!!!!!!!!

title: Fit Perfectly
text: I am very hard to fit in shoes and boots. I ordered my regular size which is 7EE. Width was a bit loose which was perfect for me because I wear orthotics. Once I installed the orthotics (over the existing insole) and heavy socks, the fit was perfect. So, my experience tells me they are a bit large without orthotics. Perfect with orthotics. Very comfortable. No ankle chafing. Great ankle and foot support.

title: These are great! Well built and comfortable.
text: I absolutely recommend these boots, they are well made, durable, comfortable, and look good. I’ll see how many miles I can get out of them, but it’s easy to tell quality is high with these, and they compete easily with boots that cost twice as much.

title: Great all around hiking shoe.
text: Fits great and are as I expected. Enough room for thick socks. I got them a 1/2 size bigger than I normally do so that I had the room. They are not too heavy either.

title: Dangerously awful traction on wet surface
text: Horrible traction on wet rocks. Downright dangerous. I can’t use these to hike in the White Mountains of NH.

title: Nice to have extra wide, fits perfect
text: Fits perfect and feels perfect. I ordered wide because my feet hurt if the boot is to skinny. This boot is more wide then normal but I like the extra room for my toes. The extra room is really nice makes you feel like a rich person I don’t know why ha ha lol.

title: Just really good boots
text: Holy cow. No wonder these boots are so popular. For the price, the quality is awesome. Took them on a 24 mile hike through the woods and they were perfect. My feet barely got sore, my ankle had just enough movement to stay loose but still have support, they were light, good looking, stop water well, and the laces never came untied! Way better than my Rockys by far. It was a perfect fit too. Definitely recommend

title: My favorite lightweight footwear
text: I like the comfort and the ventilation of these shoes. For working in the summer months nothing beats these. Regular work boots are hot and heavy. I have bought these at least 8 times. Just bought a pair on sale for 70.00

title: These are fantastic shoes. My son has wide feet so it ...
text: These are fantastic shoes. My son has wide feet so it can be a challenge to get the right size but for him to be able to start wearing them with pretty much NO break in period is outstanding. They are made well and will certainly got a work out on a week long high adventure hike!! Held up well, dried quickly when they got wet. Great boots. Would certainly buy again.

title: These are fantastic shoes. My son has wide feet so it ...
text: These are fantastic shoes. My son has wide feet so it can be a challenge to get the right size but for him to be able to start wearing them with pretty much NO break in period is outstanding. They are made well and will certainly got a work out on a week long high adventure hike!! Held up well, dried quickly when they got wet. Great boots. Would certainly buy again.

title: Consistent quality
text: I wear these literally half of the year. Since that's the part with the nice weather, I hike and work in them constantly. Always comfy, with great support, particularly at the ankle which is important to me. I improve the fit with Super Feet green insoles for an unbeatable shoe on my small, narrow feet.

title: Good fit, comfortable upper, a little warm though.
text: Great heal cushion and support. These could use more cushion at the ball of the feet though. Puffy, oversized tongue is very comfortable, but very warm on a hot day. Overall good support and grip too.

title: The Ultimate Footwear
text: The Merrell Men's Moab 2 Vent Hiking boot could be the perfect boot. This is my third pair. It wears like iron and at the same time there is no weight penalty. The looks are the standard of the industry. The tread pattern and material inspires confidence for long hikes on practically any terrain. I don’t like Goretex or other waterproofing it cooks my feet. These are great. If your feet get wet, keep hiking they will dry shortly because they breathe. I recommend this boot and don’t think that it’s just for the PCT or AT, they’re great casual footwear.

title: Best boot on the market with the best grip
text: I've been hiking for years and found these boots, with the Vibram Sole are hands down one of the best pairs of hiking boots I could have bought and the price is fair. I've taken these boots in the worst of conditions from the Appellation trail, to the Rocky Mountains, to Hikes in the Alps and they have held up to the test. I have recommended these to my friends who have also bought them.

title: I bought these for a canoe trip in Canada because ...
text: I bought these for a canoe trip in Canada because they will vent the water out of the hiking boot, yet will be secure all the way up around my ankle for when we have to portage through knee deep mud.

title: Best Hiking Boots I've ever Owned - Merrell Customer for Life.
text: I have 3 pairs of this boot's predecessor. One pair finally, after years of use, had the sole fall off. So, I bought this replacement. The Moab 2 continues to be one of the most comfortable, stable boots I've ever owned. Kudos to Merrell: I contacted their customer service division to tell them about my old pair of boots failing, and after some documentation, they sent me a replacement pair. Unbeatable customer service. True to size and width.

title: a bargain
text: very comfortable, reasonably durable, much bang for the buck. the only downside i have detected, which may not matter to many, is that the soles are hard to clean (narrow crevices).

title: Worth every penny
text: Bought these as a gift for my boyfriend. We moved to NorCal and we hike more now. I have a pair and I love them. The needed little to no breaking which was a huge plus for him. They fit well. Roomy and breathable. I think we will be buying another pair in the future.

title: Great hiking boots
text: These are the most comfortable boots I own. I am an avid hiker/ backpacker and these boots have never let me down. They provide great support, especially as I have ankle issues, and they are solid and sturdy enough to.handle any terrain. Very light, and breathable, while still being essentially waterproof (I wouldn't submerge them, but morning dew, wet grass, puddles, etc are handled with ease and keep my feet nice and dry). These feel like a comfortable pair of tennis shoes even after miles and miles. There are more expensive boots our there, but the just aren't worth the extra money. These will do for anyone e but the most extreme outdoor type.

title: Solid material and great boot
text: I hike 7 days a week, and these boots work great. I was worried about their quality, but they seem to be holding up very well, especially when wet (....and we've had a lot of rain this year). They fit me perfectly, and I'm happy with them. The only concern is the metal clip at the top of the ankle.

title: Waterproof. Very sturdy. Medium ankle support.
text: First, there is a waterproof and a breathable version of this boot. I’m reviewing the waterproof version and it has proved to be waterproof after a four-day hike on the Washington coast, sloshing through tidal pools and various wet conditions. It’s comfortable and it’s rugged. It did great on slippery rocks. This is a mid-boot so, although it covers the ankle, it only gives medium ankle support. Those wanting hood ankle support might want to go with a taller boot. Otherwise this is a great boot. As with most hiking boots, I went a half size bigger so the toes have room to go forward during downhills.

title: Customer Service is worse than the quality !!
text: 2 days after the end of the return date, and after my 6th time wearing them, the top lace came off... Getting a replacement is ridiculously aggravating ... Especially when they don't answer tour emails !!

title: I have several pairs of these shoes. I love the green on these.
text: Great product. I’ll continue to buy. I don’t know why they don’t sell the colors on the Merrell site. Glad they are available on Amazon!

title: Fit was perfect
text: Was a gift. Bought 2 different pair of Merrels. He says this Moab was so comfortable, it felt like it was "worn in" already. Loved them. It's the 3rd pair of this brand. Happy!

title: Total comfort and relief
text: Work had me walking on concrete for 8-10 hours a day. Tried memory foam shoes and was left in misery... could hardly walk. Daily switching between these and some Salomon running shoes brought back healthy painless feet.

title: A true fan of Merrell hiking boots!
text: My second pair of Merrell hiking boots. Excellent fit and high quality. Love these boots!

title: Rugged and comfortable
text: I have had an identical pair (except for color) for quite a few years and loved them. They were comfortable the first time I put them on my feet. When they wore out, I bought these.

title: Comfortable for miles, decent price
text: These boots were comfortable the first day, & put to work, walking & working. They are good looking and reasonably priced.

title: Love These Boots
text: I've had this pair since October of 2019, I believe. These boots felt great out of the box. I've been hiking in them, walked some pretty messed up gravel roads in them, and worn them to work consistently. They provide good ankle support, but not so much that my ankle got "weaker". I sprained my ankle roller skating with my kids, but I was able to cinch up these boots tight and still mow my lawn. I've seen a lot of other people wearing them that swear by them too. I recently had a lace loop detach, they still have up fine. I just can't tighten them up as much now. Once they're no longer serviceable I'll buy another pair.

title: A little wide
text: Although these are labeled a Medium width, they are a little wide. Thick socks help but then your feet sweat. Maybe it’s just my sons foot. Great looking shoes. My son says they are comfortable.

title: Great shoe for what I needed
text: Bought these for use in the snow. Several days of use for hours in a few feet of fresh snow, and I never had wet or cold feet. Very impressed with the comfort of them too. I will use these for regular hikes as well, but I haven't yet.

title: Five Stars
text: Merrell’s are great. They are very rugged, & very comfortable. They breath well too.

title: Light yet rugged. Look great!
text: Nice boot. Very light. When I picked up the box, I thought it might not be full! The boots look and feel great. If I would quibble, is that there was no "extra-wide" option. All-in-all, a great boot!

title: Comfortable, non-slip hiking
text: I've been buying this hiking boot for the past 6 years because it fits my feet perfectly, has great traction, and is durable.

title: Switched to men's sizes.
text: I have purchased women's Merrell hiking boots for many years. I have consistently worn a size 9.5 in women. I purchased several Merrell women hiking boots recently size 9.5 and had to return them for too tight a fit. My toes touched the end of the shoe and the width was just too tight. I love Merrell hiking shoes so I tried men's size 8 and they fit just right. They were as comfortable and wearable right out of the box as always.

title: Great waterproof boots
text: Have had a pair of these that lasted many years and last year replaced them with the same exact ones. This year bought these for my brother who was coming to Tahoe to join us there for a family gathering. He loved them and has sent me a few pictures of him wearing them in hiking trails etc.

title: 4stars
text: Only 4 star for elevated or heel support insole ,makes the shoes bit uncomfortable ,other wise shoes are excellent

title: Fit great every time I buy them.
text: Started buying them years ago and love them fit great last a long time are water proof great price.

title: Superb Boot
text: Merrell produces a sturdy product that handles the terrain and protects your feet

title: I like Merrell boots, but...
text: I was replacing an older worn-out pair of size 12 Merrells. This pair of Merrells is just a bit snug, should have ordered 12.5 instead. Why the heck does the same style boot from the same manufacturer differ in size?

title: They do not breathe well and hold in odor like a despised champion
text: It's an overall solid boot, but definitely has some issues. They do not breathe well and hold in odor like a despised champion. They are mostly comfortable, though can feel the frame in big toe. This is when they're new...haven't worked them too hard yet, but it's coming.

title: Prefer other brands...
text: They're a little small so I had to go up a half size, which is just what the lady told me at the Merrel outlet where I bought them. The sole of the shoe is very comfortable. But I don't understand the lack of support up towards the ankle area. Why are they so tall then? Even if you lace them up VERY tight there's still no additional support beyond basic sneakers. And the ankle area collects snow so you'll need gators. I mostly use these to hike the mountains here in Park City. More than anything I love taking these shoes OFF my feet, and I wouldn't wear them for anything but hiking. These are just ok for me. I prefer my Timberland and Keen for sure.

title: Flawed boot, but at least comfortable.
text: These boots aren't water proof at all. Stitching is weak and breaks easy. Don't hold up for such expensive boots. Only positive is that they are extremely comfortable to me

title: love them
text: check them out at dickey's sporting goods.they do run small in my case from a size 12 to a size 13 and they fit perfect , they feel like if your wearing sneakers, very comfortable.

title: Amazon recommended a size 10
text: Took three tries to get a pair that fit. Amazon recommended a size 10. Too long. I then tried a 9.5. A little long but too narrow in the arches. 9 EE fit fine. Not the first time I have had that happen but I normally wear a 9.5 D.

title: My new favorite hikers and casual wear.
text: Comfortable! Seens like good qaulity so far. Really like them. To me it feels alittle tight. Won't be able to wear my thick socks in winter with these, like my other Merrell shoes.

title: I like these shoes
text: I like these shoes though I stopped wearing them for the winter as I want to save them for hiking in the spring.

title: Not waterproof. Busted in 1 year. Ripoff.
text: They are not waterproof, but advertised as such. They busted at seams in 1 year. The inside and my socks were wet after hiking a meadow with tall dewy grass for an hour. Very poor quality, a ripoff.

title: Delivered as promised... not disappointed at all.
text: Just got back from Inyo County after my first hike in these shoes. Having just retired my Salomon X-Ultra Pros I was wary of switching to Merrell, especially since I loved my Salomons and how comfortable they are. Couple of points: 1) They are truly "Wide" and fit my feet perfectly. Just can't seem to find any Salomons that fit any more which is why I switched. 2) They didn't seem to feel "nice" when they first arrived, mostly on the sole, so they did require some breaking in... not much though.. a few hours in 3-4 separate wears was enough. 3) They are waterproof... I stepped in a stream 200 yards away from the finish of a 7.5 hour hike and my feet came out dry. Lucky for me I didn't get in deeper than the cuff. 4) They are warmish given they are waterproof, but I wore wool socks and was able to manage it well. Still, it also requires some camp shoes to wear otherwise these shoes and your feet will get a bit dank. 5) The sole is wider and thus more stable than my previous shoes. I have a supinated gait so I had a tendency to roll my ankle, but I didn't have that issue at all on this trip. 6) Has a roomy toe box. I have squarish toes so I often have trouble with shoe fit and my pin

title: Very happy
text: I bought these for a trip to the Rocky Mountain National park a few weeks ago. They worked great. I even rented a Razr UTV for a half day and muddied these things up. I just wiped down with a damp wash clothe and they reverted back to looking brand new. I like the reinforced bottoms that don't torque when you walk on rocks and weird surfaces. This is my first pair of Merrill shoes. I will buy this product line again.

title: Excellent Hiking Shoes!
text: I've been wearing the Moab series (both WP and non WP) for a long time. They are excellent shoes and their quality lasts a long time as long as you take good care of them. I typically get about 3-4 years of heavy use out of them before they need to replaced.

title: but I had 3 pairs of the old Moabs because they fit so well and are very comfortable.
text: This is my first pair of the Moab 2, but I had 3 pairs of the old Moabs because they fit so well and are very comfortable.

title: the only shoes I buy
text: these are the only shoes I buy now - waterproof to a decent extent, they last at least 2 years a pair with heavy use - I love this brand.

title: Great shoe, poor longevity
text: This is my second pair of Moab low shoes and they are great for moderate hiking when you don't need ankle support or for any kind of wet weather walking. My complaint is that, after just one year, even with very little actual hiking- mostly 3 season wet weather walking on mostly pavement, one of the shoes has developed an annoying squeak from the heel that has nothing to do with the inserts or my heel movement-it's in the outsole. My neighbors can hear me coming from half a block away! I suppose on the positive side, I don't have to make additional noise when hiking in bear country, but I think instead I will try some Keen Targhees which seem similar-and hopefully quieter.

title: Big clunky shoes
text: Not that comfortable, as all shoes have become. Shoelaces my biggest complaint, won't stay tied despite my best efforts.

title: Great shoes❗️
text: They feel real good and I wear em in snow if it’s not too deep. Good product and great price

title: So far, so good.
text: Nice, delivered fast a bit wide in the rear, heel area, but feel sturdy, good traction and my feet have stayed dry. Update.. Oct 2021. Feet still dry, shoes holding up well to constant moisture working on a golf course. Still comfy too. I am picky but I would most likely buy again. For a little over $100, if I get a year or so out of them without pulling out the shoe glue, in this world, I can't complain.

title: Love them!
text: Love these shoes. Right out of the box I walked 2 miles a day/3 days, then 5 miles a day/2 days. No blisters, hotspots, or soreness. Can't wait to take them fir a long hike!

title: Three Stars
text: bottom feels overtly hard, I don't know why. Does not seem watter proof to me though.....

title: Perfect for our lifestyle
text: Love that the price is true to anywhere else. Love the options. The MOAB series is perfect for our lifestyle.

title: Comfortable Dry Feet
text: Most of my workday is spent on concrete floors inside an municipal no kill animal shelter. I change into these shoes mid shift and my feet stay warm and dry. I should wear them all day but I'm not ready to give up my Harley boots quite yet

title: Excellent for light trail activity
text: This is my 2nd pair. These are comfortable and have good support. Using them for lighter/lesser difficulty trail hiking and have ran a few times in them. Water resistance has not let me down yet. Durable and treads provide a nice grip. I would recommend these.

title: HUBBYS FAVORITE
text: Been buying these shoes for a very long time for hubby. He is very satisfied with them and hopes they never change how they are constructed

title: Good shoes
text: These a bit on the clunky side compared to other Merrell shoes I have had. Over fit was as expected, they are comfortable right out of the box.

title: FIT
text: I gave these shoes a three star rating but honestly I never really gave them a work out as I returned them. I bought these shoes but only tried them for fit while walking around my house. I ultimately chose another pair of Merrell's that I had bought online at the same time and sent these back. The other pair fit more comfortably in hiking socks than these did.

title: Moad2 is to steep and not feel like the old Moad on your feet guts but you not have to take my word for it l.

Well I'm in wide side and the old Moad still comfortable with all the small repairs I put on and it feel like the first time I put them on. I not know what goes wrong with the Moad2. I wanna to put 1 star but the color is cool I put 2 stars if not was going to be 1Star not fit perfectly and couple of tracks and the glue is peeling off a little by little.
