text: It took a few tries to get the straps adjusted just right. Once the fit was perfected, they were quite comfortable. The unfortunate part is that after about a week of wearing maybe four times, they became SO stinky! I do not have particularly sweaty feet - I mean I live in Florida and when I'm out walking around it might get a little toasty down there, but these shoes are now gross. The flocked soles are discolored where my feet sit in them, and they make my feet stink when I wear them. Also, for the price, the sandals don't seem like they would hold up more than a season. Where the straps are connected to the sole, wrinkles - which I'm sure will turn into cracks - have already formed. Appearance wise they look good for being a comfort sandal, and they fit well for a girl with wide feet and bunions. I really expected to be a Vionic convert, but the search continues.

title: Fit
text: I was not as happy with this shoe as the other Vionic. It was a little to big. The strap do lay flat. They are to long and can’t be tightened because you run out of Velcro. Rubs a little on the top of the foot. Straps broke on both shoes in one month. Not recommending these shoes.

title: Vionic Makes the Most Comfortable Sandals Ever
text: I love the Vionic Women's Amber sandals. They are a flattering style to wear to church. They have a nice arch support and they are available in a wide width. It's a nice feature that the straps are also adjustable.

title: Good support
text: Good arch support. Like the sandals but wish they were real leather as my feet sweat so much more in man made. Also wish they were made in the USA but happy to at least be able to get sandals with support

title: Perfect fit with arch support!!!
text: These are the most comfortable shoes ever!!! All straps are adjustable for a perfect fit. Made very well.The "cork gold metallic" lines are just enough to make the sandal "dressy" yet great casual wear. I have a high arch and these shoes support my arch completely, relieving my foot pain from non-support. LOVE THEM!!!

title: Love these
text: These are so comfy. Since there are no orthotics that work with sandals these things are great. Love the fit, style and comfort!

title: Sizes run large, nice shoe
text: Wear 8.5-9, this 8 fit well and so the sizes run quite large. The sole was comfortable. The upper didn't have enough adjustment so I returned them. Certainly not a bad choice, never ordered shoes online before and it was worth trying. Return was super easy and free.

title: ... bought these for my wife and she feel in love with them right when she put them on
text: I bought these for my wife and she feel in love with them right when she put them on. She has had issues with her feet and alignment, and since wearing these her nightly complaints have ended

title: Comfortable Sandals
text: I purchased these sandals on Amazon after trying them on at Dillard. I love that all straps can be adjusted to YOUR needs (i.e. width of foot and ankle). The sole cradles my foot perfectly. The shoe is for the most part very comfortable. I have to say most part since my feet often swell up which make many shoes uncomfortable. In this case, it has nothing to do with the quality of these sandals. Great product, especially the foot bed!

title: Good for hurting feet
text: My physical therapist suggested i buy this brand. I now have 3 pairs! They fit great.are wide enough and my feet don't hurt.

title: My go to Sandals
text: This is a second pair of Vionic for me. This pair replaces a 2 strap slip on that could slip off my foot if walking fast. So I went for the 3 strap and a strap around the heel. All are Velcro which makes the fit adjustable and the heel easy to put on and off. I wore them around the house all day the first day I received them. Love the heel fit. Makes me feel like I do less rolling on the foot.

title: Walking on air
text: These sandals are very comfortable. They have good support for the arches. It feel very good on my feet. I like the multiple straples for fitting. Right now my right foot is slightly swollen. Each foot feets great for they are individually adjusted. I would buy they again when these wear out.

title: Comfortable!
text: Very comfortable to wear to work as I stand long hours. I couldn't wear it all week, but could rotate it with other shoes and my feet and arches felt good.

title: Did not work out for me
text: The straps going across the foot hurt, no matter how i adjusted them, they were digging into my foot. Also, the back strap came right under my ankle bone and that was also painful. I was so excited to get these, then so disappointed when they did not work. I returned them.

title: Happy feet
text: I have unhappy feet! Two surgeries, seven titanium screws and these shoes are SO comfortable. Not my only pair either!

title: Love Vionics....your feet will too
text: Had bunion surgery on both feet and Vionics was suggested by my orthopedic surgeon. Vionics is the closest to “normal” shoes for a person who clearly wore wrong shoes to require pins put in their feet. It’s summer in LA and I was bemoaning having to give up flip flops when I came across these. LOVE them and they go with everything.

title: Support your walk
text: I Love the sandals I have been wearing them for years the price was great and they are excellent shoes and great support they help my plantar fasciitis wonderfully!

title: Stopped my heel pain!
text: These are the only shoes I can wear that stop my plantar fasciitis heel pain. So happy to have found the Vionic brand.

title: Half Sizes- Size Down
text: I usually wear an 8.5. Since that was not an option, I sized up. I believe an 8 would have fit better than these do. The arch support and comfortable sole is everything I dreamed about in needing to replace my 7 year old Chaco's, but I am considering exchanging them for the size down.

title: Great support! My wife loves them
text: Great support! My wife loves them! The only issue that she has is that the strap between the toes is somewhat thick, and it’s irritating her some, but I’m sure that will get broke in! I had the same issue with mine, and you get acclimated in about a week or so of wearing tgem

title: Disappointed in the quality
text: Two totally different shoes. Different colors, different elevation in the front. Looks like the left shoe wasn’t trimmed when it came off the mold (plastic producer would know what I am referring to). I love my old pair but am disappointed to pay that much money for these.

title: Fantastic Fit
text: Yes it was a bit hard on initial fit but has softened up and they are wonderful. Great fit and great support, already ordered another pair and no doubt will get more.

title: Love them.
text: These are my second pair of these flip flops. I hate slippers, so I wear these all winter in the house. I have flat feet and they are so comfortable (after some time to break them in). Love love love them!

title: I love these sandals
text: I love these sandals! I have plantar fasciitis and can manage it well by using high-quality sandals with cushioning and arc support like these in the summer months.

title: BEST slippers for plantar fasciitis!
text: These are the BEST slippers you can buy if you have plantar fasciitis! Seriously, if you suffer from it, click buy now and thank me later. These were the first slippers I could wear all day without excruciating pain. I actually prefer these over my tennis shoes for going on long walks as they have the best support. Since finding these tide slippers I have tried many different styles in the orthaheel brand but for some reason none of them have the same support (even some of their other slipper designs don't have the same feel as this tide line). When you first try them on they will feel weird, the arch will feel like it is too high but wear them around the house for a couple hours at a time and your feet will thank you!

title: I thought these shoes would be soft support, but ...
text: I thought these shoes would be soft support, but they are so hard I can't wear them. They look cute but the shoe itself is made of hard plastic.

title: Love, love
text: Love, love, love these shoes. Yes they are expensive, but they are cute and make my feet NOT hurt. So worth the cost! I've suffered with Achilles tendinitis for the longest time and these shoes are the only way I can go about my day without pain. I live in the South, so I wear these practically year around. I will purchase another pair come Spring without hesitation.

title: My favorite! I wear them year round...even in winter as house shoes instead of slippers. Love!!!
text: I love these flip flops. Great feeling on my feet and definitely the best I have worn in the flip flop category. I wear them in the winter, too, (as house shoes instead of slippers) since those never have any arch support. Yes, they are a bit pricey but I gladly pay it since I have yet to find anything even close to the support and comfort I have found with these shoes. I have tried many other types and brands but really can’t say anything comes close to my favorite vionic tidal II

title: I have tried many like sandals over the years
text: I have tried many like sandals over the years, even the original Dr. Scholls with the wooden soles. also have plantar faciitis - thankfully not an issue for seceral yrs due to adequate footwear. I am well aware that sandals such as these can take some getting used to! Have worn these for 2hrs /day over the past week. I find these most uncomfortable. Especially on the top where the straps are. I am size 9.5 and bought a 10 . They are too long but straps tight. Will update if things change

title: Great flip flops!
text: Finally! A flip flop with a good arch support! This is my second pair of Vionic thongs! They are well made and last years! Fit true to size.

title: Very satisfied with the Vionic Tide ll sandal!
text: It's a great sandal and feels comfortable. I got it mostly for home as I think going bare foot is not supposed be good for high arches. Feels supportive.

title: Give It Time
text: I have very painful arthritic feet and I am always looking for a comfortable shoe. I have been wearing Skecher flip flops with the cushy footbed for several years. The problem with them is the lack of support and that they stretch out quickly and become too loose. I was disappointed in these Vionics at first because they don’t have a soft footbed. I decided to stick with them though and before long my back and hip pain were less than before. Now after a couple of weeks, the footbed cradles my foot and it doesn’t feel as hard as it did at first. Time will tell how long they last and if I remain happy with them. Right now, I would buy them again, especially at the sale price I paid.

title: No more Plantar Fasciitis!
text: Love all the Tide glides. I order an 8 for my 8 1/2 wide foot. Perfect fit. Haven't had any more flare ups of plantar fasciitis since I started wearing these year round nearly 2 years ago.

title: very comfortable right from the start
text: Fit well, very comfortable right from the start, but I don't much care for the look. Got these because I HAD to have a navy pair of sandals for an event and wanted comfortable which reviews indicated these were.

title: wider than another Vionic medium width shoe I own
text: I have to return these because they are too large. I ordered a medium width, same as the Vionic Bella II which I also just bought. The Bella's fit fine but these are too wide. My feet slide towards the outside of the shoe strap and are clunky and awkward while walking. The footbed also feels heavy. Maybe it's the different material used than on the Bella, I don't know. But one day after receiving them in the mail, I'm returning them. I feel unsafe, like I'm going to trip over them or something. On the plus side, though, they are well made. The arch support feels high and not very comfortable, but that could be because my foot is sliding around too much and not proper position on the footbed.

title: I wanted to like it
text: I have a pair of Vionic slippers that are very comfortable, so I figured the same would be for these flip flops. While the arch support is there, I found the shoes to be too wide for my fit (and I'd say I'm between normal-wide) and my foot kinda rubbed the sole because of this. I had to return them.

title: They don’t last long
text: These are my third pair and they are not cheap sandals! The other two pairs lasted over a year and a half on me. This particular pair I noticed is not as well made. After less than 3 months the sole is separating from the foot bed. I’m really disappointed in this pair and hesitate to buy another for this amount of money. They used to be made so well. Not so much anymore.

title: Vionic Love
text: Being diagnosed with fallen arches and having to be braced for months, then placed in orthotics I was worried how I was going to get through the summer... well these allowed me to do it in cute style. I love these flip-flops & I also have 2 pair of slippers my feet couldn't survive without them! Love Vionic!

title: my favorite. I am not easy to please when it ...
text: I've bought several pairs of these now and they are by far, my favorite. I am not easy to please when it comes to shoes of any type due to numerous foot surgeries, so for me to give a 5 star rating, it's a rating you can count on!

title: At first the support made my feet feel a bit fatigued but after wearing them a few days now my feet feel much better. The size 6
text: My podiatrist suggested this brand (along with a few others). It has a substantial arch support which my feet need to hopefully correct my issues. At first the support made my feet feel a bit fatigued but after wearing them a few days now my feet feel much better. The size 6 was spot on. Plan to look at some other styles in this brand.

title: Blisters!
text: My feet rub in these shoes and cause blisters in odd places. Like my instep. Had to stop wearing them.

title: Best Flip Flop Ever Made if You Need Arch and Heel Support
text: LOVE THESE and will buy several pairs in different colors. I can literally go walking in them for hours. they run just a tad wider than normal but it's fine, I'd rather have a little extra room. I hate narrow flip flops where the edge of your foot rolls over. These are sturdy, safe and extremely comfortable. PERFECT for my plantar fasciitis. Gives instant relief and prevents flare ups. Fantastic.

title: Already have 4 pairs. Wish I could get this ...
text: Already have 4 pairs. Wish I could get this style in some other colors. My old ones have been shifted to yard work.

title: Great with plantar facitis to wear any time !
text: Love these Sandles 24/7! Great with plantar facitis issues and they go everywhere with me !!

title: Comfortable to a point
text: these are good shoes, not great, just good. looks is nothing remarkable, also not bad. Very comfortable, but the problem is with the length. I ware 9.5M, got it and exchanged for 9M. Still somewhat loose. Somewhat loose is good but even size 9 still more than desired. I will keep them for comfort, less1 star for looks and the length issue.

title: Yes, I am forced to admit, these are worth the price!
text: I hesitate to admit it. Slippers at this price are a stretch for me. Did not want to like them. When I ordered I hoped to say, "See, I told you they couldn't be that good' and then return them. They are on my feet as I write. They are on my feet every moment I am home. Warm in cold temps. Cool in warmer temps. Always comfy. Usually without socks, sometimes with--doesn't matter. Love the leather. Fit and feel and look great. Okay, I will admit it...these are worth it. If they are not durable, I may change my mind, and I will update this review. Have worn them almost three months so far with little signs of wear and tear. My last pair of leather slippers lasted about 5 years of daily wear. I am expecting as much and more of these. These are even more comfortable, so here's hoping. I'd say try them and return them them if you don't like them. But be warned...you will.

title: A perfect winter slipper/shoe
text: Great relaxed fit for my wide feet. The step-in option, where the back of the shoe folds down is a great design. Super comfortable and warm up in the mountains where I live at 10,000 ft. A great product!

title: Greatest shoes I have worn.
text: I absolutely love these shoes. This is my 4th pair. My last pair lastest almost 8 years before wearing through the bottom of the sole. The most comfortable shoes I am familiar with. Love them.

title: Update Nov. 24, 2018
text: As shown in my review, these slippers were great. For about 10 months. Now the inserts on one foot slides to the left causing me to walk on the outside of my foot. I will need to purchase other slippers as this is a poor design causing your foot to hurt when you walk in them. I just received these today. When I put them on, my big toe on one foot was touching. I wear a 9 1/2 W. The first line of the description says to order one size down. So I ordered a 9. These have a wide toe box, and plenty of room for a wide foot. After about an hour wearing these they somehow adjusted to fit perfectly. The foot bed is great. By far the best slippers I have ever worn. Okay, it is July 1st. I wear these at all times I am at home. Still love them.

title: Great covers for feet when you need them!
text: Great covers for feet! Option to have heel up or down and the leather insole make these unique in my experience.

title: Pretty nice
text: These are pretty nice, the shearling is not very thick/full. So that may help slippers not feel tight, but in very cold areas, it may not be as warm as expected. The insole is removable which is nice, and pretty thick. One thing I'm not totally happy about is the felt footbed, I thought it would be nice but there's a weird feeling on the bottom of my feet. All surrounding is soft wool but the bottom is harder/firm felt... just a bit odd. Overall I'm still happy with them, especially getting 50% off on black-Friday, otherwise at $130 or so, I may not be super happy. I'm in San Diego, inside temp of home 65*-72*, and these are great, my other w/ synthetic shearling all around made my feet sweat too much. These don't as much, but they have gotten a little damp and I just pull the liner out overnight or take them off for a short time.

title: really comfortable!
text: Seems to run slightly wide, albeit not long. I added a very thin insole to the outstanding gel insole that comes with the slipper, and it works great. Shockingly comfortable, not sure on durability so will see how this holds up. But so far impressed! Worth the money. --Addendum so far holding up great, water resistant and NOT STAINING (step up over my uggs). Remain extremely comfortable to walk in, when these wear out am buying another pair. Strong work Olukai!

title: This shoe is worth every penny...
text: I've been looking at this shoe for the better part of a year on Amazon, loving the style but not loving the pricetag. I finally pulled the trigger and ordered these and I LOVE these shoes. They are worth every penny. - These are made in the USA with genuine leather which is why they are more expensive than Chinese made cheapos. - They do run large. I normally wear a size 14 and ordered a 14. They are comfortable but much more roomy than other shoes. I'd still order them true to size but expect extra room. If this isn't your thing than size down. - These shoes look awesome with jeans, khakis and even make good summer shoes with shorts. However if you're not going to wear socks I do recommend sizing down. - These are so comfortable and light. These are the closest thing to feeling like you don't have shoes on at all.

title: Shipping Concern
text: While I liked these shoes, be care with regard to, 'shipping returns'. I am a prime member and have never had the need to return anything before, but they're too small and there are no other sizes to choose. The order claims to be a Prime order, but I am being charged $5.01 to return the item. This is the first time I have been unsatisfied with Prime

title: Double hit
text: Bought these for my son who loved them so much I got a pair for my husband who wears them all day long in the house. Great buy and am so pleased I made a perfect pick for two of my best men.

title: An immediate favorite and amazingly comfortable!
text: LOVE LOVE LOVE my OLUKAI Moloa Slippers! Amazingly comfortable and fit like a glove... warm and stylish! I can’t get enough of these slippers would definitely recommend to others. For what it’s worth, I can’t wait to put them on each day... Mahalo Olukai!!

title: High Quality
text: The slippers fit perfectly, and don't slip on the heels like many brands do. The removable insoles are extra thick and comfortable.

title: Comfy and very nice leather.
text: Love these. They ain't beautiful but man are they comfy and great quality. The real sheep fur lining is not too hot for Texas summers but very warm in the winter.

title: Best part is the insert / great for plantar fasciitis feet
text: Well made. Wearing outside to take dogs out for couple months and bottoms show no wear. Really like that there is a padded insert like a Dr Scholls type thing. Could easily replace with something else if inside wears.

title: great slippers, extremely warm
text: Love these slippers, I can only wear them for a couple of hours at a time because they are so warm that they start to make my feet sweat. they are super comfortable and are well crafted. I have two other pairs of olukai shoes and their customer service has been great whenever there have been any issues with their products. highly recommended

title: Very nice slippers!!
text: I really enjoy these except for one item (and the reason for 4 of 5 stars) - they don’t breath at all!! They are comfortable, warm, nice sole for a indoor & outdoor shoe. BUT - the material is waxed / treated to the point were they are a sweat shop and then have a bit of an odor issue within just a few days wearing for 3-4 hours a day.

title: Great shoe, great price, quick service
text: I ordered a size that was too big and they were Very quick to submit a return/refund. I ordered the next pair and they were perfect. Thank you.

title: If my husband could give 10 stars he would
text: My husband said he loves the feel, comfortable and sturdy. They keep his feet warm, but not not sweaty. HE HIGHLY RECOMMENDS! Would definitely order again.

title: The everything shoe--apparently
text: Bought these for my husband--named above (the owner of the account)--and he loves them (in as much as men love shoes). I judge not by what he says, but by the fact that these were supposed to be casual work/dress shoes and he wears them with everything--even around the house. In fact, I have to ask him to find other shoes to wear so he won't ruin them for the intended purpose. I foresee more of these in our future.

title: Very happy
text: These look good and fit well. They are worth every dollar and they are well made.

title: Great!
text: Awesome!!! Great fit! I wear a 91/2 and ordered the 10, very comfortable, they do get warm but a light pair of footies takes care of the sweaty feet. Great quality, great arch support

title: These grew on me. Very happy now.
text: At first I thought they were a little to big. I was thinking of a shoe fit rather than a slipper fit. These are super comfortable and provide protection when waling over uneven surfaces. After a month or so of daily wearing I seen no signs of wear or breaking down. I got them on sale and think that at that price they provide good value for money. At full price I'd probably still be happy, but less enthusiastic about my purchase.

title: Best casual shoe I have ever owned
text: I am a teacher and I have worn these great every day for over a year now. Extremely comfortable and great looking. I like slipping them on quickly during my morning rush and the fold-down backs are cool when getting mail or taking out garbage. The older they get the cooler they look. The soles have some wear but these things have lasted better than any others I have bought.... even Clarks.

title: Love them! Like slippers.
text: Perfect. Love them. Like dress slippers! I usually wear a 9.5W. Ordered a 10M. Fit perfectly.

title: Great shoes
text: I wear a pair of their flip-flops I love the arch support and friend had a pair of these shoes and said they were extremely comfortable. I agree they are a great pair shoes. I would recommend.

title: These things are very comfortable and convenient!
text: We have all tile flooring in our house and it is rough to do house work in just socks or barefooted. These things are comfortable and provide enough cushion to keep my feet from hurting! I love that I can quickly slip them on by stepping on the back, and I also love being able to pull the back up later. Highly recommend!

title: Great slippers
text: Bought these as a Christmas gift. They were right on the mark. Comfort, high quality and great sole.

title: Durable, comfortable, versatile.
text: Best pair of shoes I've ever owned. I got almost three years of use out of these things when I'm usually lucky to have a pair of shoes last 6 months. I use them for business casual, casual, and recreational situations. These shoes do a great job balancing comfort while still maintaining some feel of the ground.

title: Three Stars
text: Order at least 1 maybe 1.5 sizes smaller than your normal, they are big and wide.

title: Comfortable from the first step!
text: The shoes were very comfortable from the moment I put them on. They provide excellent support and are roomy enough to wear cotton athletic socks.

title: No Joy in this pair.
text: I'm a years-long devoted Skechers customer and I don't want to leave a negative review but I paid and wasted money on this pair of Joy shoes so I'm leaving this negative review. The right-foot shoe was good but the left-foot shoe was poorly sewn and left me with foot and leg pain. The pair had minimal sole cushioning. I'm disappointed but reminded that we get what we pay for and $40.00 is what I paid and I won't be doing that again.

title: Nice Walking Shoes
text: I really love these shoes only wish I would have noticed that you had to tie them. I have some old ones and they slip on and off not tying but they look like you tie them. I do like the width and comfort of these shoes.

title: Very comfy
text: These are a replacement for the other pair I wore out. I absolutely love them. They are very comfy and I don't feel fatigued after wearing them all day. They are true to size for me. 6 1/2

title: they look good
text: like the fit and comfort they are light weight probably not for standing all day if u are on the thick side

title: Skechers has a brand new fan
text: I've been wearing all kinds of orthopedic shoes for the last couple of years. My feet hurt constantly. Sometimes so badly that I can't even walk. I love these shoes. I forget I have shoes on. I'm an official Skechers fan now

title: Very comfortable.
text: Very comfortable light and flexible walking shoe. I own these in 2 other colors and I love them.

title: Love these.
text: They are true to size. I love these. I had this same shoe before and wore them for 2 years so when they wore out inside i replaced them with the same.

title: Love Them!
text: I have been searching for a pair of tennis shoe that was comfortable and wide enough to feet my feet as a women. Just because my feet are on the large side why should I have to buy a man's shoe I like to look like a woman at all time and my feet should to. These are perfect and as they say "It is just what the doctor ordered". Thank you Sketchers!

title: Nice and comfy
text: I walk roughly 7 out of 10 hours of my shift at a casino on the floor and they have been comfortable the whole time.

title: So comfy!
text: I bought these shoes for work because I needed something with more support while standing/walking for 12+ hours a shift. For the past few months I have worn adidas and my feet felt bruised when I got home. These shoes are so light, breathable, and squishy! These are my first pair of Skechers and I will definitely be buying more! I love them!

title: Athletic Shoes
text: I love these shoes. Today (7/18/19) was the first time I wore them and they are sooooooo comfortable.

title: Heaven to walk in!
text: I love how stretchy and comfortable this shoe is! Wide and super supportive. I have knee problems and having a good shoe really helps!

title: Comfortable shoe
text: I’ve had sketchers before, this was a different style for me but they are so comfortable. I walk regularly and need a good walking shoe and these do a great job for me. I have the arch support I need, plenty of room for my feet and light weight... all pluses in my book!

title: Comfortable!
text: Very good for health care workers and people that stand for long hours on their feet.

title: Extremely comfortable!
text: I am very happy with these shoes. I have bad feet and these allow me to walk for 45 min every day without pain. When I first tried them on I had a thinner sock on and they felt a bit loose but once I put on a regular sock they fit just right. I wish Skechers in general were more fashionable looking but since they feel so good I don't care.

title: Perfect comfort work shoes! Slip resistant and great support.
text: I have looked for the perfect work shoe as I am on my feet for 8 hrs a day. I have tried many brands and styles. These are amazing! My legs and feet aren't tired at the end of the day. Thank you!!

title: So comfortable
text: I work in retail, mostly cashiering. I stand in one spot for several hours at a time. Occasionally walking around and stocking things, but mostly just standing. I was wearing vans and converse at first until one day after an eight hour shift I noticed how sore my feet were. After searching for comfortable shoes that didn’t cost me a hundred dollars, I settled on these. I’m really glad I did!! They’re attractive and SO COMFORTABLE. Makes me wonder why I’ve gone so long wearing shoes that were anything less than really comfortable. Cute enough that I wore them out with my regular attire when I wasn’t working as well. These shoes are dissolving my resistance towards sketchers as a brand for dorky adults or elementary school students. I’m a trendy young adult and these are my new fav pair of shoes. I wear size 7 for converse chucks (5 in men’s) and 7 in vans. I moved up a half size for these ones because I planned on wearing really thick socks with them for even more cushioning. It’s a great combo! Thick socks + these = no sore feet.

title: Comfortable
text: I was hoping for more arch support. But they're pretty comfortable so I kept them

title: I love these.
text: These are stylish and very comfortable. I've even worn them with dress pants. I purchased a 7W. Recommended for those wanting light weight footwear. Wipe clean.

title: All day long on these shoes.
text: I really like these walking-casual shoes. Well done, very comfy. Based on reviews I ordered half a size up.

title: Good Shoes Overall
text: Fairly comfortable and looks great. Still miss my GoRun 600s though because these are a hair tight in the toes and a hair low/loose in the ankles.

title: Very comfortable
text: I bought an 8.5 the shoe first comfortably and gives my poor flat feet the support they need. I walk several miles a day at work so these are a blessing

title: Great comfy shoe
text: On my 3rd pair of these. On my feet 16 hours a day, with problem feet (bunions, corns). These shoes make it bearable.

title: Hurt my heels, but comfortable
text: These shoes fit a little big on me, rubbed my heel raw, but were comfy on the bottom. I would not buy them again.

title: Great skechers shoe
text: I haven't worn my shoes much but they are comfortable as Skechers are. You can't go wrong with Skechers.

title: Fantastic shoes.
text: I already have a pair of these and wanted another for when the first pair gets too worn which is not happening any time soon but ya never know if it will still be available. These shoes are so comfortable and wear sell and look grand. Thanks.

title: Very Comfortable
text: These are very comfortable. The heel is not skid resistant, which is the only flaw. Skid resistant is important to me because I was in an accident and am learning to walk again. I would buy these again.

title: Great
text: I love this sneaker. I also have it in light grey. Has great comfort and I love the color.

title: supportive yet soft and flexible

I'm keeping them because they are all right but I'm not very impressed. I guess you get what you pay for.

Cute and comfortable sneaker though well worth the money so I would buy them again but sizing up when I do.

But they just hurt too much and it really is too bad because I like the design of these shoes, the holes and easy water draining are genius, but my left foot is just too injured to wear these. text: Comfortable shoe. I wore these to Greece for vacation. I really should have worn them more to get a more” loose comfortable “ fit as I did lots of walking. Overall satisfied with these shoes. Thank you.

title: Super Cute
text: Love these! super nice, I got them as a gift but the box came completely destroyed through the mail. Other than that they are PERFECT!

title: Narrow shoe
text: I was disappointed in these shoes. I have had 3 previous pairs by the same brand that fit perfectly, but this shoe is very narrow and uncomfortable.

title: Cute bite a little narrow
text: Very cute. Really loved the color but ended up being too narrow for my feet. The other Malibu had more room in the toe area. So I returned these.

title: My first pair of blowfish
text: I was looking for an easy slip on shoe and these are perfect. Fits normal. I have a fairly narrow foot and ordered my usual size. My only issue is the bottom is super slippery the first time I wore. I almost slipped a few times, but after wearing a few times it’s gone away. Love them and will be ordering more!

title: I don't get the fuss
text: These are okay- but they were a little small, a little narrow, except in the heal where they were super wide. Hardly had any shape to them, like a converse but converse seem to fit better. I didn't like the weird fit so I gave them to my teenage daughter, who also doesn't love them. We don't have wide feet, so it's kind of weird.

title: Wonderful, fun and stylish
text: Fun shoes, well-made and stylish. Even though they offer absolutely no support for your feet, they are fun to wear if you're not doing a lot of walking. Still enjoy them very much! I got the blue--nice color!

title: So comfortable!!!
text: These are super comfy and have great style and along with quality materials. I could not be happier. Highly recommend.

title: Wife loves them
text: Got these for my wife as a gift and she loves them. They look great and she's had them a few months now and they're still wearing well.

title: Very narrow tennis shoe
text: I usually love Blowfish shoes but these tennis shoes unfortunately are very narrow and we’re way too tight for my feet. They are cute though.

title: Adorable shoes, but runs about a half size larger than normal
text: These shoes are adorable! I wear a size 10 and that is what I ordered. It is about a half size too big, but they are sooo adorable! I have average width feet and they fit a tiny bit snug on the sides. I would not recommend these shoes if you have wide feet.

title: LOVE these shoes; they are my go-to spring shoes
text: I saw these shoes at Shoe Carnival and had to have them. I usually wear an 8.5, but sometimes need a 9 depending on how the shoe is made. The 8.5s fit great! But they were $40 (plus tax). Looked on Amazon and the Smokey Gray were $27 (with free Prime shipping). Ordered them and when they arrived I wore them out to run errands. They are crazy-comfortable and I wear them everywhere. I should have bought some really low-profile, no-show socks for flats, but I didn't. The first time they got dirty, I scrubbed them with a damp washcloth and dried with a blow drier. That didn't get all of the dirt out, so I think I need to put them in a mesh laundry bag (used for washing delicate items) and wash them on a delicate cycle and air (or blow) dry. I love these shoes and would definitely order them again.

title: For looks
text: Super cute, comfortable but not for working out. I wear them to work for looks, if I had to stand a lot, I would not wear them.

title: not comfortable
text: I have Sketcher shoes that I love, but these hiking boots are just are not comfortable. Should have done more research

title: Didn't last long
text: Ok not much cushion on foot bed. Wanted for work but not enough cushion for someone on feet for 8 hours on concrete. Didn't hold up very long either went was only wearing casually

title: Nice Boot - Comfortable - Good Looking - A Winner!
text: My everyday work boot. Good ankle protection. Memory foam insole is a must for me as I have slight neuropathy(numbness) on the soles of my feet. So comfortable! Thank you Skechers!

title: Good Boots
text: Well put together boots. The traction on the sole, although not non-slip, gives good traction on ice and snow. I can't verify the waterproof aspect, since I haven't worn them in rain, but my feet stay dry in snow. As far as comfort.... I mean it's a boot not a sneaker. They have padding in them, but for as much as I walk everyday I ended up putting a cushion insert in mine. I wear an 11 1/2 and they fit perfectly, even with the insert. For me, at least. I can see having them for years as they're very well built.

title: Easy on, very comfortable
text: The first thing I noticed, was how easy they slipped on! The shoelace goes around two hooks, rather than through eyelets at the top. So, when the lace is out of this hooks, the top of the shoe opens so wide it’s like putting on a pair of slippers. Your feet just fall into the shoe. They are tall enough to provide good ankle support and they seem to be a little wider than others. Works well with heavy socks.

title: Damaged during first try on
text: First of all these boots are great looking, but when my husband went to try them on to make sure they fit, the very top hook fell off. I don’t think we’ll be getting another pair to replace them.

title: comfortable upon 1st fit.
text: Took out of packaging and expected stiff break in period. Was surprised I could put them on and wore them the entire day without any break-in. Well made and air pillow inserts.

title: Very nice boots
text: I live in Florida sand use these as work boots for yard work, digging, etc They look good, are comfortable and fit well at a reasonable price

title: Some of the best boots I've worn
text: I can't use these for work, but I wish I could. These blow my Keen steel-toes out of the water and put them to shame. These boots are built good and durable and very comfortable. I wish these came in steel toe. Sketchers would have a lifelong customer... The laces could be a bit longer. That's the only complaint I can think of. Overall, very good bootsz

title: China Shoes Don't Fit
text: Shoes made in China usually don't fit. I take a size 11 and this boot was both too narrow and too small. This had to be returned. Either go to a shoe store and try the shoe on, or else buy American if possible.

title: Too narrow for a wide foot
text: These seemed to be built very well and they are good looking. However, I was sort of fooled when the description says "comfort fit" and expected them to fit a wide foot. Nope. They were sort of heavy too.

title: To small!!
text: To small by a half size.Going to reorder again.Seems to be well made.Hope the next pair fits me.

title: I would buy these again
text: I am super happy with these boots. I purchased them 4 months ago to replace some expensive Wolverines. So far, they have been fantastic. They still look great and feel comfortable.

title: Great value, a little small...
text: Very nice and comfortable shoes. Seem to run a little small compared to other Sketchers boots. Great value!

title: This woman LOVESLOVES these boots!!!
text: I run a donkey sanctuary and am on my feet all day. I have plantar fasciitis and have tried many, more expensive brands. As a woman, finding boots that have a wider toe box and waterproof and comfortable without spending a small fortune is near impossible. These boots are so comfortable and have allowed me to feel good for my 12+ hour days. Really, you can't go wrong with Skechers! I wish I had thought of this brand sooner as I would have saved myself a lot of money. I've been wearing these for over a month and they still feel awesome. I wear a woman's size 9 and got these in an 8 and they fit perfectly.

title: Terrific boot for the money
text: My husband loves these boots! I bought him a size larger than normal, so he can wear heavy socks in the winter. They look great and are waterproof. The price is outstanding and he says they are VERY comfortable.

title: Is this a joke?
text: I really liked these boots for one week before on of the eyelets broke. Absolutely ridiculous that the eyelet only lasted a week or so. I have worn the boots less that 10 days before it broke. Do not recommend!!

title: Feets well
text: Very comfortable I bought 140$ carhartt boots because I wanted something fancy but not worth it uncomfortable and then I ordered this boots i had pair of skechers before is very comfortable very good and cheap

title: Very Satisfied
text: So far I'm very happy with these boots! Extremely comfortable, great fit. Now to see how long they last!

title: Extremely comfortable and light weight boots
text: I have had these boots for 11+ months now and finally the seams at the toe guards are failing. I wear them almost everyday as I am a Contractor and not tiny, either-260lbs. They have held up well considering their cost. I did have to replace recently the shoe laces broke as one broke. When new, I sprayed them with a waterproofing silicone spray and to date had no problems with them leaking. Due to my age I no longer have a lot of natural padding left on my feet, so I have greatly appreciated how comfortable these boots are to wear all day long. I also have wide feet and the 13W size fits me perfectly. I tend to wear out toes on other boots when on all fours and this, too, was where these boots eventually failed. I would refrain from using your boot toe to ply up anything as that was what caused the seams/sewing on the toe guard to eventually fail. I plan to buy another pair of these boots.

title: Nice looking boot, recommend
text: Nice looking boot. I ordered half size larger because I wear thick socks....fits perfect. Seems comfortable. The support seems just average, or average plus. Time will tell on durability and waterproofing. For the price, I'd recommend. So far, so good. I'll update after the winter.

title: So far so good
text: So far so good! Super comfy! I coated them with 2 coats of sealer and for sure they are waterproof. Tons of rain today and feet stayed toasty dry! Very warm!

title: You won’t be disappointed, they are terrific!!!
text: Just put them on to see how they feel, and walked around. I was super impressed!! Love them. Now, I don’t know about long term wear, will have to wait and see. Almost feel like buying another pair. It’s so hard to find thing you like. Also great colors, really sharp looking too.

title: Great for a walking around job...
text: These are great for my job which is mostly walking around all day. The water-proofing is nice since I often need to walk outdoors in inclement weather. I would not recommend these for a standing job, however. There are better options out there for that kind of work.

title: Waterproof slippers with laces
text: Love/hate product. These boots have no identity in my view. because the have little support even sized properly. If squishy = comfort they are a plus. I like to wear my slippers but I would not like to walk very far in them. They would not be a good choice for work unless your job doesn't require much physical activity,

title: SUPER COMFORTABLE CHUKKAs
text: Best, most comfortable boots I've ever owned. I didn't know they had 'memory foam' in them. Don't know if that what helps, but these just don't wear like 'new' boots that need breaking in. Sized right. I got the khaki, which is a really smart looking color - never tried that color before. Shipment was very fast from this vendor. They look good too. I've had several comments on what nice looking boots I have. But the biggie is the comfort. Love it!

title: Nice and warm!
text: Bought these for a trip, but roads were closed due to weather. My husband wore these out during a cooler day and said @these are really warm”. They fit perfect. I ordered a size 10.5 his normal size.

title: Size does matter...
text: I wear a 10 in all Skechers except, it seems, these. I have about 4 pairs of various Sketchers in my closet, all size 10. I have worn Sketchers for about 20 years now, all size 10. Usually they are not something I have to try on to make sure they fit. So you can image my disappointment when I got these and they were too small. Apparently in this model I needed at least a 10.5. What changed Sketchers? I know it's not my feet.

title: Skechers shoes
text: I wear 91/2 wide . Hiking shoes fit perfectly. Not to tight or not to loose. Always dead on, that’s Skechers!

title: Good value
text: 22 yo son says they’re, “excellent! Comfy, waterproofing is so good!” He works at a camp multi-season, just got them this fall, very happy after about a month!

title: Not wroth $54..needXsocks,no support,not warm but OK
text: not much support,and needed an extra pr of socks to fit just right, but nice looking boot,don't think they will be too warm.Thin soles not worth the $$.

title: Happy Feet!
text: I have worn several kinds of boots over the years but these boots are the best by far. Very comfortable. Cannot wait to wear them this winter. Happy Feet!

title: great slipper
text: I loved this slipper, however my first pair was a 1/2 size to small. No worries they fixed it right away. Good to go!

title: these are not good for people with a high instep.
text: I had to cut the elastic on both sides to even get these onto my feet. I do have a high instep, but was not expecting to struggle this much with a short boot. They work alright for what I needed with the elastic cut, but my size 10 feet fit fine in them once I got them on.

title: Not as warm as my other Sketcher Boot
text: I thought it was the same as what I have, they are in taupe and get really dirty, so I ordered a brown, but they have lining but not as thick as my others, I'm so bummed, now I can't find my kind anywhere, looked all over the internet:(

title: Cute shoes
text: These are really cute shoes. They aren’t bulky at all, and they do keep your feet warm. The soles provide good traction for walking in moderate snowy, icy conditions, but keep in mind they aren’t actual snow boots. The only negative is that there is little to no arch support so if you’ll be walking any distance, these would not be the shoes for you. They work very well for short distances where you want warmth and some traction under your feet.

title: Terrible awful worst ever
text: These boots are almost impossible to put on - to the point of being painful. In reverse, once on, they are almost impossible to take off. The opening is much too small. They have no arch support so they are uncomfortable to wear after a very short period of time. With all that said, they'll probably last a lifetime because I can't wear them. My suggestion to those considering buying them: don't do it. (One star was too generous and simply because this site does not allow for zero stars.)

title: Comfy booties
text: I really like Sketchers brand shoes, boots, sandals.... Always comfortable and supportive. These booties are warm, cozy & comfortable. I've worn them several times and love them. Can't go wrong with Sketchers. I would definitely recommend.

title: Very comfortable shoe boots.
text: I've never worn any Sketchers shoes before but if all of their shoes feel like this, then I am fast becoming a convert. I ordered the Chukka Boot in Chocolate because they were on sale (I don't know if these were returned because they were WAY cheaper than the other colors). If they were returned, they weren't worn at all; shoe appeared and felt brand new. Anyway, they were easy to pull on and slip off. They are protected with Scotchgard. They are VERY comfortable, cushiony and warm. These will be my go-to during cold, non-snowy days. I actually wore these while out shopping today and they are the most comfortable shoes I've ever worn during shopping excursions.

title: Warm, comfy, stylish and easy to clean!
text: I was concerned about the slip-on style, but we did TONS of walking in snowy and icy (& muddy snow) conditions, with temps in the teens to thirties and they were so warm and comfy and easy to clean. They’re a great shoe! Love, love, love!

title: Great for RA sufferers!
text: So comfortable! I got these because I wanted an easy on/easy off ankle boot that was good in rain and comfortable to walk in. These check all the boxes! True wide with cushy support! I’m buying a second color!

title: bought to wear with all my maxi dresses
text: I am size 9 and that is what I bought...fits a tad snug going in because of those bands on the sides but I dont think I need to cut them as some people have...just need to work in pushing my foot in. Once in feels like a slipper and I love the dainty look of the narrow toe area and the bit of faux fur around the top edge. Will work well with dresses which is one reason I bought this style. I am a huge Skechers fan and at 73yrs old they seem to be the best fit for my arthritis knees and legs and sometimes bad back. The price was great also...less expensive than anywhere else on line. I haven't worn them out and about since I got them yesterday but I cannot imagine them being uncomfortable....do hope I can walk a mile in them though...will see. The arch fit shoes really work for that.

title: The comfort, the quality, the fit....perfection
text: Right out if the box, These boots feel like my favorite warm house shoes ! I could not be more satisfied! At the end of the day, my feet are not at all tired, and I can wear them all day and night. Love them!

title: Most comfortable boots
text: Most comfortable boots I own , absolutely love them, I did get the wide an glad I did, must buy, I don’t know how warm they are yet but my sister has worn them for the past 3 years and swears they are very warm in the winter

title: Warm boots.
text: Nice boot. I wear a 8 1/2. Ordered a 9 Big but fit well with socks. Warm. But have no arch support.

title: Very Nice Boots, Challenging to Put On
text: With no zippers or other openings, they take a long time to put on! The opening is so snug that getting my foot all the way in is very challenging. Once on they are comfortable although a bit tight across the top. Good support and very sturdy. Nice for a long day of walking around town. Good quality construction, look very nice dressed up or casual.

title: Not the same.
text: Extremely tight and I buy this brand all if the time. They are not as good as what they replaced. Would not purchase again.

title: Sooo comfortable
text: I love Skechers and these are a very casual streamlined look, not bulky on the feet. Warm and comfortable.

title: Nice boots
text: I just got them today but they look good, appear to be well made and feel good on. The sole feels like it will be good on the ice... time will tell. If anything they could be a bit wider or be made in an "extra wide" size.

title: I like them but....
text: I like them, however, I wish they were a little darker in color. These shoes were going to be my throw on and go shoes ....I am hoping I do not have to keep them clean like a pair of white tennis shoes. We shall see.

title: I Love These Boots!
text: These boots are so comfortable! I ordered a pair of Sketcher boots last year, and I liked them, but these are even better! Versatile - great with jeans or casual slacks. I wear them all day and evening. They're great for the outdoors, too! Warm and comfy! Highly recommend.

title: Great Boots! Very Comfy! Be sure to get 1/2 size bigger
text: GREAT BOOTS! So comfy, they feel like walking on clouds! Note: but at least 1/2 size bigger. I usually take 7 1/2 but a size 8 would’ve been PERFECT for different types of sock wear.

title: Cute and comfy
text: Needed warmer shoes for winter that I could also wear all day inside. These do the trick!

title: Great little boot
text: Love this boot, except for one design flaw. They are almost impossible to get on!! They need a tab at the back, or more elastic at the sides...they barely stretch an inch. I ended up cutting the elastic off on one side of each shoe so I could get them on. Now they are great! Other than that I would have given them 5 stars!

title: Go up a full size for wide feet with thick socks
text: I have wide feet with high insteps. My feet can be very hard to fit. I usually wear a 9 W even though it's a touch long just to accommodate the width of my feet. I have even bought 9 XW before also with good results. I'm planning on wearing thick socks with these boots. Some other reviews mentioned this boot being cut smaller than previous models. With that info I decided to go up a full size to a 10 W and they fit perfectly. The insole of the boots is a very short fur almost like a velvet which is much more comfortable. The insole is nice and cushy. The opening of the boot closes over your ankle with elastic to keep it shut and the elastic stretches the opening open to get your foot in. I feel confident that this will be a good choice for a lot of walking this winter.

title: Not like other Skecher's boots, opening for foot is too narrow.
text: I want to return these but it looks like I'd be charged for the return shipping. I've bought about 10 pair of Skecher's boots over the past few years and I've never had this issue before. The opening is much too narrow and the elastic does not stretch at all. I would have to cut the elastic band to get my foot through the opening. Very disappointed.

title: Opening too narrow!
text: Maybe if there was a zipper on the side it would have helped. I ordered my usual Skechers shoe size but this boot was too small, both the opening and the overall snugness.

title: Lining not fleece
text: The only thing I don’t like is that it does not have the fleece lining. It’s a faux fur therefore not as soft and warm. Still warm enough for Houston TX

title: Nice looking boot
text: Nice looking boots but the hole at the top was so small I could not even get my foot in. Very disappointed.

title: Great walking boot!
text: I go shopping in these boots! I feet and legs feel better when i wear them. warm and cozy too

title: You get what you pay for..
text: Absolutely no support, feels cheaply made. Would be fine for wearing to take out the trash, but I wouldn't suggest wearing them for much longer.

title: Fits perfect!
text: I was worried about the reviews but it’s fit very well, my size is 6 and I bought 6 navy blue and the shoes are perfect !

title: Cute Sandals
text: Cute. Doesn't slip off your feet. The back support was a great improvement. I bought size 8.5 which is my usual size. Not for long walks though. No cushion. But great for a lunch meet.

title: new staple item in my closet!
text: I love these sandles to the point that have become one of the staple items in my closet. They are extremely easy to put on and have the perfect amount of tightness in the elastic to cup comfortably to your foot. I enjoy the green color as it is not common in footwear and can give a fun flair to a boring outfit. I recommend getting your true size!! I ended up buying a 7 when I am normally a 7.5 and the back of my foot slides just a bit on the back. It doesnt bother me though and isnt noticable when wearing them.

title: So comfortable and nice
text: It is the best Sandal which I have had forever... It is so beautiful and comfortable. I bought it during the day for my office. My feet can breathe during the day. Also, it has a very strong bag for carrying which helps me put the sandal in my carrier during the trips. It is my favorite sandal. Definitely, I will buy other models in this brand. Thanks

title: Sandalup :) Comfortable
text: Inexpensive but cute, comfortable and very versatile. ordered 2 pairs. black fit a bit better even though same size as Navy blue. I think the added leather piece on black makes for a better fit. But they are definitely worth the price!

title: Worth it for the price
text: Amazing product for the price! I’m a size 9 and these fit true to size. I needed sandals that adhered to my company’s requirements. These look cute and save my pricier shoes from bad weather damage. Not the most comfortable though.

title: Very comfortable
text: I can wear these all day . It’s like having no shoes on. However there is so support so if you aren’t comfortable barefooted you might not be comfortable wearing these for a long period of time.

title: Comfortable, stays on.
text: The shoes are comfortable, do not pinch or hurt. The elastic conforms to my foot, and stays put. Pretty good product, good price.

title: Fits true to size, but they’re slippery inside!
text: So these are a nice pair of shoes. I have high arches and there’s little support, but they’re not uncomfortable. The one problem is the material of the part of the shoe that touches your feet is VERY slick. If your feet are sweaty, or if, like me, you’ve spent the winter wearing thick socks over lotioned-feet, you’ll put these on, take a step, and your feet will slip around. The elastic straps don’t hold your feet tight against the inside of the shoe. By curling my toes I’m sort of able to keep from sliding around in the shoes. I suspect by the end of summer when my feet are all callused again, these shoes’ll be fine.

title: So Comfortable
text: I ordered the style that's the same color all over(NOT the brown strap-be aware that there's two different types!) A few people said they ran big but I just went with my normal 8.5 size and they fit perfectly. I have worn them three times already and can honestly say these are the most comfortable sandals I own. They don't cause any painful rubbing and your foot doesn't slide all over the place when wearing them. I have a black pair and will probably be ordering more colors. I'm hoping that although they're on the cheap side, that they last but so far so good!

title: Cute for the price, but low quality.
text: You get what you pay for. These are definitely cute, but don't expect them to hold up for very long. If you have wide feet, these are not for you. My feet are just a little wide, and these are almost too narrow. They also aren't the most comfortable, because your feet kind of slide around in them-- this is coming from a woman who doesn't wear heels, and is super conscious about how shoes affect spinal health. I wore these about a dozen times for 2-3 hours at a time, and then I had to toss them.

title: Cute and good quality for the price
text: Needed some navy sandals for this summer and these have been great - the elastic makes them fit well without being too hot or rubbing on my foot in any way and they're really cute - I've gotten several compliments on them. I'm normally a size 6.5 or 7. I ordered the 6.5 and they fit great. My only complaint is that the sole is a little more yellow than brown, more so than it looks in the picture, but to me it's really no big deal. I recommend these for sure!

title: Cute
text: Super cute sandals and great for the price. Not best quality but regular cute sandals. I love them!

title: I don't like shoes so I go minimalist as much as possible
text: I don't like shoes so I go minimalist as much as possible. These just wrap around perfectly and work great for my job as a receptionist. I love them but again, no arches which I love.

title: Cute shoe
text: Cute, stretchy but snug, lightweight. Not a supportive long-day on your feet sandal but nice for going out and dressing up. Bought the tan and the green.

title: Great go get 1
text: This is my vacation wear. I love the fit I wear a 9w but I took a 10 fits perfectly. Go get 1 guys.

title: Versatile and fits great
text: Love these shoes! So versatile and fits great with the elastic. My only complaint it the leather at the toe gets scraped up easily when I walk.

title: Great buy!
text: These sandals are great! Everyone compliments me on them; they are comfortable and secure, plus they have a nice variety of colors. They came in a nice reusable plastic bag where you can store shoes whenever you travel, so that’s a plus. I like these brown ones cause you can use them daily since they can match almost any outfit for a casual look. I’m usually a 7 1/2 and that’s the size that I bought and they fit perfect. - ¡Estas sandalias están padrísimas! Cuando las uso recibo muchos cumplidos debido al estilo de estas; son muy cómodas y seguras, además que tienen una buena variedad de colores dependiendo de lo que estés buscando. Adicionalmente, venían dentro de una bolsa plástica reutilizable que puede utilizarse para colocar zapatos al viajar. Yo compré las sandalias café, puesto que fácilmente pueden combinarse con cualquier atuendo, dando un look casual para el diario. Yo normalmente soy talla 7 1/2 americano, siendo esta la talla que compré y me quedaron perfecto.

title: Comfortable and Well-made
text: The construction of the shoes is solid and not cheap-looking. The design of the shoe is simple, and will complement pants and shorts, and casual skirts and dresses. Just ordered another pair in beige to wear this summer.

title: Cute and comfy
text: [[VIDEOID:e88f924b766732fccc69071cbeb9a4d5]] Super cute and surprisingly comfortable. Was on my feet all day and no soreness.

title: Cute
text: These sandals are very cute but I find that my foot gets pushed off the sole when I walk.

title: Love these! They look casual but you can dress ...
text: Love these! They look casual but you can dress them up if needed. They are a little bit tight so if you have a thicker foot maybe not the best choice; also if you're thinking between two sizes, get the bigger size.

title: Good Stretchiness
text: The elastic is not so tight that your feet swell. If your foot is wide, do not order these. The style is very flattering.

title: Love
text: I bought these to replace some sandals I had to throw away, and these are perfect! Very comfortable.

title: These run true to size and are comfortable.
text: It was hard to give these sandals an honest rating because they are elastic bands and when they were delivered one ankle band was a little bigger than the other. So one seemed loose but the other fit perfectly. I had already worn them and didn't think I should return but I would not have known how they fit unless I actually had worn them. Check them for quality when you first get them and if they seem off, send them back for a refund.

title: Great!!!
text: I’m between 5 and 6 so got both. 6 was a better and more comfy fit. I can’t wait to wear them on vacation they are so light and comfortable and look good with every outfit! I want more!

title: Not a good quality
text: I wore these for maybe a month before the Bolton’s started cracking and had to be thrown out.

title: Very cute and comfortable. Only downside is they're not meant for a ...
text: Very cute and comfortable. Only downside is they're not meant for a day of walking. If you wear them all day like I did (to work for 8 hours, then out to dinner) your feet will start to feel sore. But for the price, great shoes. I even received a few compliments my first day wearing them!

title: Nice sandals
text: This is my second time ordering these sandals. My first pair lasted for years and only needed to be replaced because my new puppies got ahold of them.

title: Perfect gift
text: I loved my moccasins from this same brand, so I got this pie for my husband. He’s not really a slipper guy and prefers to wear shoes all the time, but I’ve caught him wearing these weekend mornings, which means he likes them.

title: Far too small
text: I ordered one size up, but still too small. Will try ordering a pair 2 sizes up. They do look good.

title: Warm & fuzzy
text: No more cold feet. A little snug, can't wear my normal socks with them. Should have ordered the size 12.

title: Quality slippers
text: I ordered these slippers for my dad, they are of good quality and are very warm, which he wanted, as well as nice looking.

title: Super comfortable

text: Been buying Vionic products for several years and love them for my flat feet and plantar fasciitis issues. The straps on these attach slightly farther back on the foot bed than my other Vionic sandals and they just didn't feel comfortable, so got returned. Too bad- they looked really nice.

title: Painful Thong
text: These might be OK for some people, but I had to return them because the thong was placed wrong and the strap dug into my the sides of my toes. It was very frustrating because the shoe was pretty and the footbed was great. However, if the point of an orthopedic shoe is comfort, the thong issue spoiled the whole thing for me. Glad Amazon has such a generous return policy, though. It was quick and easy to try them on and send them back.

title: So cute
text: I am always happy with how cute and stylish Vionic shoes are when I wear them. People comment all the time, which is amazing considering how little I worry about fashion. It's always a nice surprise.

title: Comfortable sandal shoes
text: So, I bought this for my trip and my best friend ended up using it because they were comfortable and the feet were in pain.

title: Supportive arch
text: Great shoe and is comfortable! It supports the arch and helps with other foot issues. Stylish too.

title: Uncomfortable arch support
text: The footbed in these feels uncomfortable. At least for my feet the arch support seems to be in the wrong place:( The style is cute though. I would have kept them if they were more comfortable.

title: One Star

They are going back. Sadly, the cost is too much I think for the quality of the materials. I would expect an equivalent to leather, but the straps are hard plastic.

title: Waste of money

Feels like much less support and feels like I may trip .The one sandal gave me a blister and this never happened with any other of my vionics (3 vionic sneakers, 4 sandals). I was such a big proponent of vionic as wearing tbe sneakers and sandals full time really currected my bunions. Vionic convinced me of wearing built-in orthotic support but vionic profuct is not what it use to be. I will look for another orthotic brand.

I very happy with the comfort for that purpose and short trips to walk the dogs or go to the garbage dumpster. But to wander aimlessly while shopping not so much. text: I hate to say this, but these shoes are literally the worse pair of shoes I've ever owned. And I've owned a looot of cheap shoes. The shoe is sturdy and tough, and I haven't had any problems with the metal or velcro like others. At first I loved how soft and springy the shoe was. after a day or so, the insole stops being soft, it just figuratively disappears and you're left walking on the hard plastic soles. My pinky toes went numb on the 3rd day of wearing this shoe. I gave it a week, my pinky toes feelings came back on the weekends when I wasn't wearing them. But as soon as I go back to work during the week, my pinky toes get numb once more.

Though designated extra wide (4E), these shoes are still uncomfortably narrow in the toe box. Also, as other reviewers have mentioned, the sraps are much shorter than I would expect on this style of footwear. I have a fairly high arch and occasionally need extra room when wearing thicker socks. (A little more strap is often a necessity for me). Though not what I would consider particularly bad the memory foam in the footbeds doesn't seem quite as comfortable as I've come to expect from this company. Regrettably I had to return these shoes. As much as I like Sketcher products, I seriously doubt I will reorder this model.
